title: Meghalaya Temple Recipes
tagline: Fifty-seven sattvic recipes for institutional cooking, written for ISKCON Shillong

recipes.name: Sha Saw
recipes.sub: Red tea taken without milk, the cup that is handed to every visitor
recipes.sub_l: Ka sha khlem dud, kaba ai ïa baroh ki nongwan

method.en: Boil the water with the ginger and bay leaf for five minutes before the leaf goes in.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka um bad ka sying bad ka sla tejpat san minit da nangta buh ïa ka sla sha.

method.en: Take the pot off the fire, put the tea in, and cover it exactly four minutes.
method.l: Pynsngiah ïa ka khiew na ka ding, buh ïa ka sha, bad khang ïa ka saw minit.

method.en: Tea boiled with the leaf in it turns bitter and no sugar will cover that.
method.l: Ka sha kaba khlaw bad ka sla ka long ba khaw; ym don sini ban khang ïa kata.

method.en: Strain it into the drum through a cloth, not a wire sieve.
method.l: Sait ïa ka sha sha ka drum da ka jaiñ, ym da ka chalni tynrai.

method.en: Sweeten in the drum and keep it covered. Held open it goes flat within the hour.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sini ha ka drum bad khang ïa ka. Lada khlem khang ka pat ka jah ka jingsngew.

recipes.why: The Khasi cup is red tea and not milk tea, and it is what a household puts in front of anyone who comes through the door. At ₹9 a glass it is the cheapest item in this book and needs no dairy at all.
recipes.why_l: Ka sha Khasi ka long ka sha saw, ym ka sha dud, bad kane ka dei kaba ai ïa u nongwan ha iing. Ha ₹9 ka glass ka long kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot, bad ym donkam dud.

recipes.name: Sha Sying
recipes.sub: Milk tea boiled long with the state's own ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ka sha dud kaba khlaw slem bad ka sying jong ka ri

method.en: Crush the ginger on a stone rather than grating it; a grater gives juice and no fibre.
method.l: Dup ïa ka sying ha ka maw, ym kher; ka kher ka ai um tang bad ym ai ka jrong.

method.en: Boil the water and ginger fifteen minutes until the water has taken the heat of it.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka um bad ka sying shi phew san minit haduh ba ka um ka ïoh ka jingpyrthat.

method.en: Add the tea, then the boiled milk, and hold it below a boil.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sha, nangta ka dud bakhlaw, bad ai ïa ka ba ym khlaw shuh.

method.en: Once it boils again the milk skin thickens and the last glasses come out grey.
method.l: Lada ka khlaw biang, ka snieh dud ka long bakhraw bad ki glass baneiwa ki long ba iong.

method.en: Sugar last, and taste before it goes to the counter.
method.l: Ka sini ha kaba kut, bad kylli ïa ka jingsngew da nangta phah sha ka counter.

recipes.why: Meghalaya grows ginger on every slope and it costs a third here of what it costs off the hill. This is the tea for a cold Shillong morning, and it holds two hours in a covered drum.
recipes.why_l: Ka Meghalaya ka bit sying ha baroh ki lum bad ka dam ka long shi bynta lai na kaba ha lum. Kane ka dei ka sha ïa ka step basyiar ha Shillong, bad ka lah shong ar por ha ka drum bakhang.

recipes.name: Soh Niamtra ka Um
recipes.sub: Khasi mandarin pressed with ginger and black salt
recipes.sub_l: Ka soh niamtra badup bad ka sying bad ka mluh iong

method.en: Boil the sugar into a thin syrup with two litres of water and cool it before anything joins it.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka sini bad ar litar um ban long um sini, bad pynsyiar da nangta buh ki kiwei.

method.en: Peel the fruit and pull the white pith off every segment.
method.l: Bit ïa ka snieh bad shet noh ïa ka bakhuid balieh na baroh ki bynta.

method.en: Press by hand. A machine cuts the seeds and the whole drum turns bitter.
method.l: Dup da ka kti. Ka mesin ka ot ïa ki symbai bad ka drum baroh ka long ba khaw.

method.en: Mix juice, syrup, chilled water, ginger, lemon and black salt, and taste.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka um soh, um sini, um basyiar, sying, soh mynken lieh bad mluh iong, bad kylli.

method.en: Ice goes into the glass at the counter, never into the drum.
method.l: Ka ïit ka leit ha ka glass ha ka counter, ym shym ha ka drum.

recipes.why: The Khasi mandarin carries the state's GI tag and comes off the Sohra and Jaintia slopes from November to January at half its plains price. It is the cheapest way that fruit reaches a hundred people.
recipes.why_l: Ka soh niamtra Khasi ka don ka GI jong ka ri bad ka mih na ki lum Sohra bad Jaintia na November haduh January ha shi bynta ar jong ka dam ha madan. Kane ka long ka lynti bakhyndiat dam tam ban ai ïa kata ka soh sha shi spah ngut.

recipes.name: Sha Kynbat
recipes.sub: Hill herbs steeped without tea leaf, drunk at the end of a meal
recipes.sub_l: Ki kynbat lum ba la buh ym bad ka sla sha, ban dih ynda kaba bam

method.en: Bruise the lemongrass with a stone and do not chop it. Chopped, it releases everything in two minutes and the last ten litres out of the vessel taste of hot water.
method.l: Nam ia ka jasyiar bad u mawlain, ym dei ban ot. Ynda la ot, ka pyllait baroh ha ar minit, bad ki khadar litar baneh na ka blang ki sngew kum ka um bakhraw.

method.en: The tulsi goes in with the fire off. Boiled, a tulsi leaf turns the whole vessel bitter and twenty litres cannot be sweetened out of it.
method.l: Ki sla tulsi ki dep haba la pynjot ia ka ding. Haba la pyndih, ka sla tulsi ka pynsngewkhaw ia ka blang baroh, bad ym lah ban pynsngewduna ia ki 20 litar da ka gur.

method.en: Jaggery and not sugar. In Risaw the Iewduh gur is forty rupees a kilo against sixty for sugar, and it carries the ginger better.
method.l: Ka gur ym ka chini. Ha u Risaw ka gur Iewduh ka long saw phew tyngka ha ka kilo, ha ka hyndrei khyllilih tyngka ka chini, bad ka pdiang bhabha ia ka sying.

method.en: Strain it twice through a cloth. Lemongrass leaves a fine hair that floats and nobody drinks a tea with hairs standing in it.
method.l: Sait ia ka ar sien da ka jaiñ. Ka jasyiar ka sa buh ki snier bariw ba ki kyllon, bad ym don uno uno ba dih ia ka sha bad ki snier ha ka.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head, and it needs no tea leaf at all. Lemongrass grows in every Khasi kper and the ginger is the only thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: Hynniew tyngka ha u briew, bad ym donkam ia ka sla sha shuh. Ka jasyiar ka mih ha ka kper Khasi baroh, bad ka sying tang ka dei kaba thied.

recipes.name: Um Sohphie
recipes.sub: Sohphie boiled down with jaggery and served cold
recipes.sub_l: Ki sohphie ba la pyndih bad ka gur, ban ai basyllok

method.en: Take the stones out before the fruit goes near the fire. A sohphie stone boiled ten minutes turns the whole vessel bitter.
method.l: Kbieng noh ki symbai shaphang ba ka soh ka dep sha ka ding. Ka symbai sohphie ba la pyndih khadar minit ka pynsngewkhaw ia ka blang baroh.

method.en: Boil it twenty minutes and no more. Sohphie past that point loses the sourness it is drunk for and becomes a plain sweet water.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka 20 minit tang, ym shuh. Ka sohphie ba palat ka jaka kata ka sa duh ia ka jingsngewthiang ba ka dih na ka, bad ka long tang ka um basngai.

method.en: Black salt and not white. A sohphie drink without it is flat and the whole hall leaves half a glass.
method.l: Ka mluh iong ym ka mluh basaw. Ka um sohphie ba ym don kata ka long basngai, bad ka iing baroh ka sa pynsngi shynna ka glas.

method.en: Serve it cold. Warm, a sohphie um tastes of the pot and in Jymmang the hall is at thirty degrees and nobody will take a warm glass.
method.l: Ai ia ka basyllok. Bakhraw, ka um sohphie ka sngew kum ka blang, bad ha u Jymmang ka iing ka long 30 degri bad ym don uno uno ban pdiang ka glas bakhraw.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. Sohphie is on every Iewduh cart in Risaw at seventy rupees a kilo, and this is the drink a Shillong hall asks for by name.
recipes.why_l: Phra phew sien tyngka ha u briew. Ki sohphie ki don ha ka gari Iewduh baroh ha u Risaw ha hynniew phew tyngka ka kilo, bad kane ka dei ka jingdih ba ka iing Shillong ka kwah da ka kyrteng.

recipes.name: Sha Dud
recipes.sub: Black tea boiled with milk and a bruised cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Ka sha iong ba la pyndih bad ka dud bad ka elaichi banam

method.en: Boil the water and the tea leaf first and the milk after. Milk from the start and five hundred grams of leaf gives a vessel the colour of a wall.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka um bad ka sla sha shaphang, bad ka dud ynda. Ka dud na kaba sdang bad ka sla shiteph ki pynlong ia ka blang kum ka rongkyrmen jong ka jingding.

method.en: Bruise the cardamom and do not powder it. A powdered cardamom gives everything in the first minute and the last glasses out of the vessel have nothing.
method.l: Nam ia ka elaichi, ym dei ban pynbadup. Ka elaichi babadup ka ai baroh ha ka minit banyngkong, bad ki glas baneh na ka blang ki ym don ei ei.

method.en: Four minutes on the boil after the milk and no longer. A tea boiled ten minutes is bitter and eight litres of milk is wasted in it.
method.l: Saw minit ha kaba pyndih ynda ka dud, ym shuh. Ka sha ba la pyndih khadar minit ka sngewkhaw, bad phra litar dud ki duh ha ka.

method.en: Strain it into the counter urn and not into glasses. Tea standing on the leaf goes bitter in twenty minutes however good it was.
method.l: Sait ia ka sha ha ka blang ba ai, ym sha ki glas. Ka sha ba shong halor ka sla ka sngewkhaw ha 20 minit, la ka la long babha kumno ruh.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head. It is the tea a Khasi kitchen is judged by; a Nongkrem morning without it is remembered for the wrong reason.
recipes.why_l: Khyndai phew tyngka ha u briew. Kane ka dei ka sha ba ki briew ki khmih da ka ia ka rukom shet Khasi; ka step Nongkrem ba ym don ka ki kynmaw namar ka daw kaba sniew.

recipes.name: Um Sohiong
recipes.sub: Black cherry crushed cold, strained and sweetened
recipes.sub_l: Ki sohiong ba la nam basyllok, la sait bad la pynsngai

method.en: Crush the sohiong cold and never on the fire. Heat takes the purple out of it and a grey sohiong um is not what the hall came for.
method.l: Nam ia ki sohiong basyllok, ym shym halor ka ding. Ka jingbakhraw ka rah noh ia ka rong iongdum jong ka, bad ka um sohiong barongkhraw kam dei kaba ka iing ka la wan sha ka.

method.en: Strain it through two cloths. The skin of a sohiong is thick and a single cloth leaves a sediment that sits at the bottom of every glass.
method.l: Sait ia ka da ki ar jaiñ. Ka snier sohiong ka long bajrong, bad ka shi jaiñ ka pynsah ia ka jingsah kaba shong ha ka khlieh rud jong ka glas baroh.

method.en: Lemon at the counter and not in the vessel. Lemon standing in sohiong for an hour turns the colour and eighteen litres go brown.
method.l: Ka soh niamtra ha ka jaka ba ai, ym ha ka blang. Ka soh niamtra kaba shong ha ka sohiong shi por ka kylla ia ka rong, bad ki 18 litar ki long basaw.

method.en: Six kilos gives eighteen litres and no more. Watered further, a sohiong um is a pink water and the fruit is wasted.
method.l: Hynriew kilo ki ai 18 litar, ym shuh. Haba buh um bun, ka um sohiong ka long tang ka um basaw bad ka soh ka duh.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. Sohiong comes off the Ri Bhoi trees in Naitung for a fortnight only, and a temple that misses it waits a year.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Ki sohiong ki mih na ki dieng Ri Bhoi ha u Naitung ar taiew tang, bad ka mandir kaba shah pyrshah ka sa ap shi snem.

recipes.name: Sha Lakadong
recipes.sub: Lakadong turmeric boiled with black pepper and jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Ka shynrai Lakadong ba la pyndih bad ka sohmynken lang bad ka gur

method.en: Three hundred grams of Lakadong in twenty litres and no more. It carries seven per cent curcumin against two in an ordinary turmeric and a heavy hand makes the vessel undrinkable.
method.l: Lai shiteph gram Lakadong ha 20 litar, ym shuh. Ka rah hynniew shispah bad ka curcumin, ha ka hyndrei ar shispah ha ka shynrai basngai, bad ka kti bajrong ka pynlong ia ka blang kaba ym lah dih.

method.en: The pepper is not for heat and must not be left out. Turmeric without pepper passes through the body and the drink is a colouring.
method.l: Ka sohmynken lang kam dei na ka bynta ka jingsngewpoh, bad ym dei ban pynsah noh. Ka shynrai ba ym don ka sohmynken lang ka leit lypa ia ka met, bad ka jingdih ka long tang ka jingpynrong.

method.en: Boil it fifteen minutes and let it stand off the fire ten more. The standing is where the colour comes out; a hurried vessel is yellow water.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka 15 minit bad pynsah ia ka na ka ding khadar minit shuh. Ka jingsah ka dei ka jaka ba ka rong ka mih; ka blang bakhih ka long tang ka um bastem.

method.en: Serve it warm and never cold. Cold, the turmeric settles to the bottom of the urn and the last twenty glasses carry all of it.
method.l: Ai ia ka bakhraw, ym shym basyllok. Basyllok, ka shynrai ka shong sha ka khlieh rud jong ka blang, bad ki 20 glas baneh ki rah baroh.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head. Lakadong is grown in Jaintia Hills and a temple that buys three hundred grams a week keeps a Laskein field planted.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynniew tyngka ha u briew. Ka Lakadong ka mih ha ki Lum Jaintia, bad ka mandir kaba thied lai shiteph gram ha ka taiew ka pynsah ia ka rep Laskein ba la buh.

recipes.name: Putharo
recipes.sub: Soft rice pancake from batter left to sour overnight
recipes.sub_l: Ka putharo bajem na ka ja badup baba shong miet

method.en: Soak the rice eight hours, drain it, and grind it with the cold cooked rice.
method.l: Sait ïa ka ja phra por, pynduh ïa ka um, bad dup ïa ka bad ka ja bathung basyiar.

method.en: The handful of cooked rice is what makes putharo soft; without it the pancake is leather.
method.l: Ka ja bathung ka dei kaba pynjem ïa ka putharo; khlem ka, ka long kum ka snieh.

method.en: Leave the batter covered eight hours in a warm corner to sour by itself.
method.l: Ai ïa ka ja badup ban shong bakhang phra por ha ka jaka bashyiap ban muriaw da lade.

method.en: Add no yeast and no soda. A Khasi kitchen sours it with the air of the room.
method.l: Wat buh yeast lymne soda. Ka iing thung Khasi ka pynmuriaw da ka lyer jong ka iing.

method.en: Pour a ladle onto a lightly oiled tawa, cover, and lift it out without turning.
method.l: Kynshew shi kiew ha ka tawa bakhyndiat tulsi, khang, bad kyllon noh khlem pynkylla.

method.en: Putharo is white and is meant to be. A browned one has been cooked too long.
method.l: Ka putharo ka long balieh bad ka dei ban long. Kaba saw ka la thung slem eh.

recipes.why: The bread of every Khasi breakfast and of every funeral and feast, eaten with tea or with a black sesame chutney. It needs no wheat and no oven, and four hundred can be made on two tawas by two people.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam step jong baroh ki Khasi, bad jong ka jingïap bad ka jingbam bakhraw, bam bad ka sha lymne ka chutney nei-iong. Ym donkam gohu lymne oven, bad saw spah tylli ki lah ban long da ar ngut ha ar tylli tawa.

recipes.name: Pumaloi
recipes.sub: Powdered rice steamed to a crumb, never boiled
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja badup baba pynkhlaw da ka lyer, ym da ka um

method.en: Soak the rice four hours, drain it well, and grind it dry to a coarse powder.
method.l: Sait ïa ka ja saw por, pynduh bha ïa ka um, bad dup ïa ka ba khlem um ban long badup bakhraw.

method.en: Sieve the powder and sprinkle water over it with the fingers until it just clumps.
method.l: Chalni ïa ka badup bad kynshew um da ki kti haduh ba ka shu ïatai.

method.en: Squeeze a handful; it should hold and then fall apart when touched.
method.l: Dup shi kti; ka dei ban kem bad ka dei ban brop lada phi shim.

method.en: Too much water gives a lump of dough and pumaloi cannot be saved once that happens.
method.l: Bun eh ka um ka ai shi tylli badup jam, bad ka pumaloi ka ym lah pyllait shuh.

method.en: Steam in a khoh or a cloth-lined steamer twenty minutes without stirring once.
method.l: Pynkhlaw da ka lyer ha ka khoh lymne ha ka jaiñ, shi phew minit, khlem pyllun shi sien.

method.en: Break it up with a wooden spoon while hot and serve at once.
method.l: Brop ïa ka da ka kiew dieng ha ba dang shyiap bad ai bam mynta.

recipes.why: Steamed rather than boiled, so it uses a fifth of the fuel a pot of rice needs and no water is thrown away. It is what a Khasi house eats on a working morning and what a temple can put out for two hundred with one steamer.
recipes.why_l: Pynkhlaw da ka lyer, ym da ka um, kumta ka donkam shi bynta san jong ka ding bad ym don um ban thok noh. Kane ka dei kaba bam ki Khasi ha ka step kam, bad kaba ka iing blei ka lah ai ïa ar spah ngut da shi tylli steamer.

recipes.name: Pusla
recipes.sub: Rice and sesame paste steamed in a folded leaf
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja bad ka nei badup baba pynkhlaw ha ka sla

method.en: Roast the black sesame on a low flame until it begins to crack, then grind it warm.
method.l: Syied ïa ka nei-iong ha ka ding bakhyndiat haduh ba ka sdang ban brop, nangta dup ha ba dang shyiap.

method.en: Sesame goes from roasted to burnt in about twenty seconds; take it off early.
method.l: Ka nei ka leit na ba syied sha ba tyllet ha shi phew second; pynsngiah lyngkot.

method.en: Grind the soaked rice separately and mix the two with the jaggery and salt.
method.l: Dup ïa ka ja basait ba lang, bad sumar ïa ki ar bad ka gur bad ka mluh.

method.en: Pass the banana leaf over the fire for a second so it folds without splitting.
method.l: Pynkhia ïa ka sla kait ha ka ding shi second ban ka lah ïap khlem ïai.

method.en: Spoon the paste onto the leaf, fold it into a packet, and tie it with a strip of the leaf.
method.l: Buh ïa ka badup ha ka sla, ïap ïa ka kum ka pakit, bad kyrtong da shi lynter sla.

method.en: Steam twenty-five minutes. Serve in the leaf; it is opened at the plate.
method.l: Pynkhlaw shi phew san minit. Ai bam bad ka sla; ka plie ha ka ding.

recipes.why: Black sesame is the flavour a Khasi tongue looks for first, and this is the cheapest dish that carries two kilos of it. The leaf is the packet, so nothing needs washing and nothing needs a box.
recipes.why_l: Ka nei-iong ka dei ka jingsngew kaba wad shuwa ka thylliej Khasi, bad kane ka dei ka jingbam bakhyndiat dam tam kaba bah ar kilo jong ka. Ka sla ka dei ka pakit, kumta ym donkam sait bad ym donkam bakis.

recipes.name: Putlien
recipes.sub: Rice batter steamed in a sal leaf until it holds a fold
recipes.sub_l: Ka jingnam ja ba la stem ha ka sla sal haduh ba ka pdiang ka jingkup

method.en: Soak the rice six hours and grind it thick. A thin batter runs out of the leaf in the steamer and four hundred leaves come out empty.
method.l: Buh ia ka ja ha ka um hynriew por bad kroh bajrong. Ka jingnam bariw ka tuid noh na ka sla ha ka blang stem, bad ki 400 sla ki mih balotho.

method.en: Warm the sal leaf over the flame a moment before it is folded. A cold leaf cracks along the vein and the batter is in the water.
method.l: Pynbakhraw ia ka sla sal halor ka ding shi por rit shaphang ba la kup. Ka sla basyllok ka pat ïa ka snier bad ka jingnam ka dep sha ka um.

method.en: Twenty minutes in the steamer and take one out to test it. A putlien that sticks to the leaf has four minutes more to go.
method.l: Ar phew minit ha ka blang stem bad rah noh shi tylli ban pyndonkam. Ka putlien kaba shet ha ka sla ka don saw minit shuh.

method.en: Serve them in the leaf and do not unwrap them at the counter. The leaf holds the steam and a putlien out of its leaf is dry inside ten minutes.
method.l: Ai ia ki ha ka sla, ym dei ban pynhiar na ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Ka sla ka bat ia ka jingbakhraw, bad ka putlien ba mih na ka sla jong ka ka long basngai ha khadar minit.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head. The sal leaves are gathered off the Ri Bhoi slope for nothing and seven kilos of rice feeds a hundred at breakfast.
recipes.why_l: Khadsaw tyngka ha u briew. Ki sla sal ki iaid kynthup na ka lum Ri Bhoi ym bad ka dam, bad hynniew kilo ja ki pynbam ia u shispah briew ha ka jingbam step.

recipes.name: Pusaw
recipes.sub: Red rice flour cakes fried flat on a dry griddle
recipes.sub_l: Ki jingbam badup ja basaw ba la syied basngai halor ka tawa

method.en: Melt the jaggery into hot water and pour it on the flour hot. Cold syrup on red rice flour gives a dough that cracks at every edge.
method.l: Pynduh ia ka gur ha ka um bakhraw bad thoh ia ka halor ka badup bakhraw. Ka gur basyllok halor ka badup ja basaw ka ai ka jingnam kaba pat ha ka snier baroh.

method.en: Rest the dough half an hour under a wet cloth. Red rice flour takes its water slowly and a dough worked at once tears on the griddle.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka jingnam shynna por ha khnong ka jaiñ baum. Ka badup ja basaw ka pdiang ia ka um jong ka bashisha, bad ka jingnam ba la trei mynta ka pat halor ka tawa.

method.en: A dry griddle and a brushed spoon of oil after they come off. Oil on the tawa fries the jaggery and four hundred cakes taste burnt.
method.l: Ka tawa basngai bad ka spun tyrso um ba la buh ynda ki mih. Ka tyrso um halor ka tawa ka syied ia ka gur, bad ki 400 jingbam ki sngew kum kiba la duh.

method.en: Press each one down once with the back of a ladle. A pusaw left thick is raw at the centre and it is not seen from the outside.
method.l: Nam ia ka shi tylli shi sien da ka shyieng jong ka kailoi. Ka pusaw ba la pynsah bajrong ka long baiar ha ka dohnud, bad ym shem na shabar.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, no kadai and no deep oil. Red rice comes off a Khasi terrace and a pusaw is what a house eats on a Lber morning.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka kadai bad ka tyrso um bajrong. Ka ja basaw ka mih na ka rep Khasi, bad ka pusaw ka dei kaba ka iing ka bam ha ka step u Lber.

recipes.name: Ja Nei Step
recipes.sub: Overnight rice turned with roasted sesame and green chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja jong ka miet ba la kylla bad ka nei baem bad ka sohmynken

method.en: Use yesterday's rice and not this morning's. Fresh rice goes to paste under a ladle and twenty kilos of it cannot be turned at all.
method.l: Pyndonkam ia ka ja jong ka sngi mynshuwa, ym jong ka step mynta. Ka ja bathymmai ka long kum ka jingnam ha khnong ka kailoi, bad ki 20 kilo ki ym lah ban kylla ei ei.

method.en: Roast the sesame until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. A powdered nei disappears into twenty kilos and nothing is tasted.
method.l: Em ia ka nei haduh ba ki symbai ki iar bad nam bajrong. Ka nei babadup ka duh ha ki 20 kilo bad ym don kaei kaba sngew.

method.en: Break the rice with wet hands before any oil. A ladle breaks the grain; a hand separates it and that is the whole difference.
method.l: Pynkhih ia ka ja da ki kti baum shaphang ba don ka tyrso um. Ka kailoi ka pynkhih ia ka symbai; ka kti ka pynpra ia ka, bad kata ka dei ka jingpher baroh.

method.en: Raw mustard oil turned through at the counter. Heated oil on cold rice sits on the surface and every plate is oily at the top and dry underneath.
method.l: Ka tyrso um baiar ba la kylla ha ka jaka ba ai. Ka tyrso um bakhraw halor ka ja basyllok ka shong halor, bad ka plet baroh ka long batyrso halor bad basngai harud.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head and it uses what would have been thrown. Twenty kilos of last night's rice and a kilo of nei is a breakfast for a hundred at no notice.
recipes.why_l: Shiphew tyngka ha u briew, bad ka pyndonkam ia kaba lah ban shah bred noh. Ki 20 kilo ja jong ka miet mynshuwa bad shi kilo nei ki long ka jingbam step ia u shispah briew ym bad ka jingtip lypa.

recipes.name: Pumaloi Sohiong
recipes.sub: Steamed rice powder folded through with crushed black cherry
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup ja bastem ba la kup bad ki sohiong banam

method.en: Soak the rice four hours, drain it dry and pound it damp. A wet-ground rice steams to a cake and a pumaloi is meant to stay loose in the hand.
method.l: Buh ia ka ja saw por, sait ia ka basngai bad nam ia ka baum. Ka ja ba la kroh baum ka stem kum ka jingbam bajrong, bad ka pumaloi ka dei ban sah bapra ha ka kti.

method.en: Sieve the pounded rice before it goes into the steamer. The lumps that stay in the sieve are what make a pumaloi gritty and there is no fixing it after.
method.l: Sait ia ka ja banam shaphang ba ka dep sha ka blang stem. Ki jingbat kiba sah ha ka jingsait ki dei kiba pynlong ia ka pumaloi kum ka mawlain, bad ym don kaei ban pynbeit ynda.

method.en: The sohiong is crushed cold and folded in off the fire. Steamed with the rice it turns the whole tray the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Ki sohiong ki nam basyllok bad ki kup na ka ding. Haba la stem bad ka ja ki kylla ia ka tre baroh sha ka rong ka lynti baum.

method.en: Eat it within the hour. A pumaloi that has stood two hours is a dry powder and twenty-four kilos of it goes back to the kitchen.
method.l: Bam ia ka ha ka por kata. Ka pumaloi kaba la shong ar por ka long ka badup basngai, bad ki 24 kilo ki phai sha ka rukom shet.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head. Sohiong is on the trees for a fortnight in Naitung and a Nongkrem pumaloi made purple is what a Khasi guest remembers of the year.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha u briew. Ki sohiong ki don ha ki dieng ar taiew ha u Naitung, bad ka pumaloi Nongkrem kaba la pynlong iongdum ka dei kaba u nongwan Khasi u kynmaw jong ka snem.

recipes.name: Upma Sooji
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted dry and turned with the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Ka sooji ba la em basngai bad la kylla bad ki jhur ka ïatiew

method.en: Roast the sooji dry until it smells of it and no further. Under-roasted, six kilos goes to a single lump the moment the water is in.
method.l: Em ia ka sooji basngai haduh ba ka mih ka jingsngi jong ka, ym shuh. Ba ym em biang, ki hynriew kilo ki long tang shi jingbat mynta ba ka um ka dep.

method.en: Two and a half measures of water to one of sooji. Three gives a porridge and two gives a sand and neither can be corrected on the fire.
method.l: Ar bad shynna jingbishar um ha shi jingbishar sooji. Lai ki ai ka jingnam, ar ki ai ka mawsiang, bad ym lah ban pynbeit ia ki bar ki halor ka ding.

method.en: Add the water boiling and never cold. Cold water on hot sooji seizes and the vessel is lumps that no ladle will break.
method.l: Buh ia ka um kaba pyndih, ym shym basyllok. Ka um basyllok halor ka sooji bakhraw ka bat, bad ka blang ka long ki jingbat kiba ym don ka kailoi ban pynkhih.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, five minutes. A sooji that has not stood is raw in the middle and twenty-six kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Na ka ding, buh ka jingkhap, san minit. Ka sooji kaba ym la shong ka long baiar ha ka dohnud, bad ki 26 kilo ki ym lah ban shet biang.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head and it is on the counter in forty minutes. On a Lber morning when the putharo pans are not free, this is what the kitchen sends out.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynniew tyngka ha u briew, bad ka don ha ka jaka ba ai ha saw phew minit. Ha ka step u Lber haba ki blang putharo ki ym long bapra, kane ka dei kaba ka rukom shet ka phah shabar.

recipes.name: Nei-iong ka Chutney
recipes.sub: Black sesame roasted and ground on a stone with chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei-iong basyied badup ha ka maw bad ka sohmynken

method.en: Roast the sesame dry on a low flame, moving it without stopping.
method.l: Syied ïa ka nei ba khlem tulsi ha ka ding bakhyndiat, pyllun khlem sngiah.

method.en: Stop the moment it smells of oil and starts to jump in the pan.
method.l: Sngiah mynta ba ka rngi kum ka tulsi bad ka sdang ban lyngkot ha ka tawa.

method.en: Cool it fully. Ground warm, the oil comes out and the chutney turns to paste.
method.l: Pynsyiar bha. Lada dup ha ba shyiap, ka tulsi ka mih bad ka chutney ka long badup.

method.en: Grind on a stone with the chilli and ginger, coarse enough to still see the seed.
method.l: Dup ha ka maw bad ka sohmynken bad ka sying, bakhraw ban ïoh ïohi ïa ka symbai.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the end, and make it the day it is served.
method.l: Ka mluh bad ka soh mynken lieh ha kaba kut, bad long ïa ka ha ka sngi ba ai bam.

recipes.why: Black sesame is to a Khasi plate what timur is to a hill plate further west, and this is the chutney that goes beside putharo, pumaloi and plain rice alike. At ₹8 a serving it makes a cheap meal worth sitting down to.
recipes.why_l: Ka nei-iong ha ka ding Khasi ka long kum ka timur ha ki lum ha sepngi, bad kane ka chutney ka shong tang ruh bad ka putharo, ka pumaloi bad ka ja. Ha ₹8 ka bynta ka pynlong ïa ka jingbam bakhyndiat dam ban dei ban shong bam.

recipes.name: Sohmynken ka Chutney
recipes.sub: Fire-roasted chilli and tomato pounded with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohmynken bad ka soh niamtra thang basyied ha ka ding, badup bad ka sying

method.en: Roast the tomatoes whole on an open flame until the skin blackens in patches.
method.l: Syied ïa ki soh khlaw baroh ha ka ding kaba plie haduh ba ka snieh ka long ba iong.

method.en: Rub the blackened skin off; do not wash it off or the smoke goes with it.
method.l: Shet noh ïa ka snieh ba iong; wat sait, lada sait ka rngi ding ka leit ruh.

method.en: Roast the chilli a few seconds only, standing back from the smoke.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sohmynken tang shi khyndiat second, bad ieng jngai na ka rngi.

method.en: Pound on a stone, not in a machine. A blade whips air in and the colour goes dull.
method.l: Dup ha ka maw, ym ha ka mesin. Ka mesin ka buh lyer bad ka rong ka jah.

method.en: Fold the coriander in off the stone and salt it last.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sla dhania hadien ba mih na ka maw, bad ka mluh ha kaba kut.

recipes.why: Every Khasi meal has a chilli on the side and this is the form it takes when a hundred people are eating. It costs ₹6 a serving and it is what makes plain pumaloi a meal.
recipes.why_l: Man ka jingbam Khasi ka don ka sohmynken ha ka lieng, bad kane ka dei ka rukom lada shi spah ngut ki bam. Ka dam ₹6 ha ka bynta, bad kane ka pynlong ïa ka pumaloi ban long ka jingbam.

recipes.name: Sying bad Soh Niamtra
recipes.name_l: Ka Chutney Sying bad Soh Niamtra
recipes.sub: Mandarin peel and ginger ground fresh, for the cold months
recipes.sub_l: Ka snieh soh niamtra bad ka sying badup bathymmai, ïa ki bnai basyiar

method.en: Scrape the white pith off the inside of the peel with a spoon; it is all bitterness.
method.l: Kher noh ïa ka bakhuid balieh na ka khlieh jong ka snieh da ka kiew; kata baroh ka long ba khaw.

method.en: Boil the peel two minutes in open water and throw that water away.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka snieh ar minit ha ka um kaba plie bad thok noh ïa kata ka um.

method.en: One boiling takes the bitterness; three take the mandarin smell with it.
method.l: Shi sien ka pynduh ïa ka jingkhaw; lai sien ka pynduh ïa ka rngi soh niamtra ruh.

method.en: Grind peel, ginger and chilli coarse and melt the jaggery through it.
method.l: Dup ïa ka snieh, ka sying bad ka sohmynken bakhraw, bad pynduh ïa ka gur hapoh.

method.en: Finish with salt and lemon. It keeps four days covered, no longer.
method.l: Kut da ka mluh bad ka soh mynken lieh. Ka shong saw sngi bakhang, ym slem shuh.

recipes.why: Sohra sends down more mandarin than the state can eat in December and the peel is thrown by the sackful. This turns the part nobody buys into the sharpest thing on a winter plate.
recipes.why_l: Ka Sohra ka phah bun soh niamtra ha December ban ka ri ka lah bam, bad ka snieh ka thok noh da ki bori. Kane ka pynkylla ïa ka bynta ba ym mand ban long kaba tyngkai tam ha ka ding basyiar.

recipes.name: Sohphie ka Chutney
recipes.sub: Sohphie crushed raw with chilli and a pinch of black salt
recipes.sub_l: Ki sohphie banam baiar bad ka sohmynken bad ka mluh iong khyndiat

method.en: Take the stones out before anything else. A sohphie stone crushed into a chutney is bitter and three kilos cannot be picked over again.
method.l: Kbieng noh ki symbai shaphang ba don kaei kaei shuh. Ka symbai sohphie ba la nam sha ka chutney ka sngewkhaw, bad ki lai kilo ki ym lah ban pynkhmih biang.

method.en: Crush it on the stone and not in a mixer. A mixed sohphie goes to a purple water and a chutney has to be picked up on the finger.
method.l: Nam ia ka halor u mawlain, ym ha ka mixer. Ka sohphie ba la mix ka long ka um iongdum, bad ka chutney ka dei ban pdiang da ka kti khyndiat.

method.en: Roast the chilli and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat only; the pieces are what a Khasi plate looks for beside the ja.
method.l: Em ia ka sohmynken bad nam ia ha ka kti. Ka badup ka ai tang ka jingsngewpoh; ki jingot ki dei kiba ka plet Khasi ka wad hakhmat ka ja.

method.en: Make it on the day. A sohphie chutney is brown by the second morning and no black salt covers it.
method.l: Pynlong ia ka ha ka sngi kata. Ka chutney sohphie ka long basaw ha ka step banar, bad ym don ka mluh iong ban khap ia ka.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head. Three kilos of sohphie makes a hundred portions of the one chutney a Khasi will name before any other.
recipes.why_l: Khyndai tyngka ha u briew. Lai kilo sohphie ki pynlong shispah bynta jong ka shi chutney kaba u Khasi u kyrteng shaphang ba don kaei kaei.

recipes.name: Jhur Tyrso ka Chutney
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves wilted and ground with sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ki jhur tyrso ba la pynduna bad la kroh bad ka nei bad ka sohmynken

method.en: Wilt the leaves in a dry pan two minutes and no more. Boiled, four kilos of tyrso gives a chutney the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Pynduna ia ki sla ha ka blang basngai ar minit tang, ym shuh. Haba la pyndih, ki saw kilo tyrso ki ai ka chutney bad ka rong ka lynti baum.

method.en: Squeeze the wilted leaf dry before grinding. The water that comes out is bitter and a chutney made with it goes back to the kitchen.
method.l: Hiar ia ka sla baduna basngai shaphang ba kroh. Ka um kaba mih ka sngewkhaw, bad ka chutney ba la pynlong bad ka ka phai sha ka rukom shet.

method.en: Roast the sesame separately. Ground raw with the leaf, the nei tastes of nothing and five hundred grams of it is wasted.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bapher. Haba la kroh baiar bad ka sla, ka nei ka sngew ym kaei kaei, bad ka shiteph gram jong ka ka duh.

method.en: Lemon at the counter and not in the grinding. Lemon in a green chutney turns it grey within the hour.
method.l: Ka soh niamtra ha ka jaka ba ai, ym ha kaba kroh. Ka soh niamtra ha ka chutney bathiang ka pynlong ia ka barongkhraw ha ka por kata.

recipes.why: Six rupees a head, the cheapest chutney in this book. In Lber the tyrso is fifteen rupees a kilo at Iewduh and four kilos does a hundred plates.
recipes.why_l: Hynriew tyngka ha u briew, ka chutney kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot. Ha u Lber ka tyrso ka long 15 tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh, bad ki saw kilo ki leh ia u shispah plet.

recipes.name: Sohiong ka Chutney
recipes.sub: Black cherry crushed with chilli, salt and no oil at all
recipes.sub_l: Ki sohiong banam bad ka sohmynken, ka mluh bad ym don ka tyrso um

method.en: Take the stones out with the fingers and not a knife. A knife cuts the flesh away with the stone and three kilos becomes two.
method.l: Kbieng noh ki symbai da ki kti khyndiat, ym da u wait. U wait u ot noh ia ka doh lang bad ka symbai, bad ki lai kilo ki long ar.

method.en: Crush it cold on the stone. Sohiong on any heat loses its purple and a grey chutney is left on every plate.
method.l: Nam ia ka basyllok halor u mawlain. Ka sohiong halor ka jingbakhraw ka duh ia ka rong iongdum jong ka, bad ka chutney barongkhraw ka sah halor ka plet baroh.

method.en: No oil anywhere in it. The fruit carries its own and a spoon of oil turns three kilos into a paste that will not sit on a finger.
method.l: Ym don ka tyrso um hangno hangno ha ka. Ka soh ka rah ka jong ka, bad ka spun tyrso um ka pynlong ia ki lai kilo kum ka jingnam kaba ym sa shong halor ka kti.

method.en: Make it the morning it is served. A sohiong chutney standing a day ferments in the jar and the lid comes off by itself.
method.l: Pynlong ia ka ha ka step ba ai ia ka. Ka chutney sohiong kaba shong shi sngi ka pyllait ha ka jar, bad ka jingkhap ka mih da ka lade.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. Sohiong is on the Ri Bhoi trees for a fortnight in Naitung and this chutney is why a Nongkrem meal is remembered.
recipes.why_l: Khadar tyngka ha u briew. Ki sohiong ki don ha ki dieng Ri Bhoi ar taiew ha u Naitung, bad kane ka chutney ka dei ka daw ba ka jingbam Nongkrem ka shah kynmaw.

recipes.name: Nei bad Sying
recipes.sub: White sesame roasted and ground with a great deal of ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei basaw ba la em bad la kroh bad ka sying kaba bun

method.en: Roast the nei until the seeds jump and take it off at once. Sesame past that point is bitter and a kilo and a half cannot be salvaged.
method.l: Em ia ka nei haduh ba ki symbai ki iar bad rah noh mynta. Ka nei ba palat kata ka sngewkhaw, bad ka shi kilo bad shynna ka ym lah ban pynim biang.

method.en: Seven hundred grams of ginger and it is not a mistake. In a kitchen with no onion the sying is the whole base of this chutney.
method.l: Hynniew shiteph gram sying, bad kam dei ka jingpyrshah. Ha ka rukom shet kaba ym don ka piaz, ka sying ka dei ka basan baroh jong kane ka chutney.

method.en: Grind it warm and it gives up its own oil. That oil is the binding and no mustard oil is needed anywhere in it.
method.l: Kroh ia ka bakhraw bad ka ai ka tyrso um ka jong ka. Kata ka tyrso um ka dei ka jingbat, bad ym donkam ia ka tyrso um hangno hangno ha ka.

method.en: Keep it thick enough to stand on a spoon. A thin nei chutney runs off the ja and the plate is a grey wash.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bajrong biang ban shong halor ka spun. Ka chutney nei bariw ka tuid noh na ka ja, bad ka plet ka long barongkhraw.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head. Nei grows on the Jaintia slopes and this is the chutney that goes beside a plain ja um on a Nohprah day.
recipes.why_l: Shiphew tyngka ha u briew. Ka nei ka mih ha ki lum Jaintia, bad kane ka dei ka chutney kaba iaid lang bad ka ja um basngai ha ka sngi u Nohprah.

recipes.name: Jaiur ka Chutney
recipes.sub: Tree tomato roasted on the flame and crushed with chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ki jaiur ba la em halor ka ding bad la nam bad ka sohmynken

method.en: Roast the jaiur whole on the flame until the skin blisters, then peel it. The skin is thick and left in it is felt on every plate.
method.l: Em ia ki jaiur baroh halor ka ding haduh ba ka snier ka pat, ynda pynhiar noh ia ka. Ka snier ka long bajrong, bad ynda la pynsah ia ka ka shah sngew halor ka plet baroh.

method.en: Roast the chilli beside it on the same flame. Fried in oil it tastes of oil and this chutney has none in it at all.
method.l: Em ia ka sohmynken hakhmat ka halor ka ding kata. Haba la syied ha ka tyrso um ka sngew kum ka tyrso um, bad kane ka chutney kam don ei ei ha ka.

method.en: Crush it in the hand and not a mixer. A jaiur chutney is meant to show the flesh and a mixed one is a soup.
method.l: Nam ia ka ha ka kti, ym ha ka mixer. Ka chutney jaiur ka dei ban pynshem ia ka doh, bad kaba la mix ka long ka soup.

method.en: Salt at the counter and not before. Salted early, three and a half kilos gives up a litre and the bowl is a red water.
method.l: Buh ka mluh ha ka jaka ba ai, ym shaphang. Haba la buh ka mluh bathuh, ki lai bad shynna kilo ki ai shi litar, bad ka kchu ka long ka um basaw.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head. The jaiur tree stands behind half the houses in Ri Bhoi and nobody plants it; three and a half kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Phra tyngka ha u briew. U dieng jaiur u ïeng hadien shynna ki iing ha Ri Bhoi bad ym don uno uno ba buh ia u; ki lai bad shynna kilo ki dam tang ka jingbah.

recipes.name: Dal Shynrai
recipes.sub: Moong dal carrying Lakadong turmeric and nothing to hide it
recipes.sub_l: Ka dal moong bad ka shynrai Lakadong, khlem ei ei ban khang ïa ka

method.en: Dry-roast the dal until it smells of nuts, then wash it in four changes of water.
method.l: Syied ïa ka dal ba khlem tulsi haduh ba ka rngi bha, nangta sait saw sien.

method.en: Boil with the turmeric and skim the grey foam off the first boil.
method.l: Pynkhlaw bad ka shynrai bad kyllon noh ïa ka jingphoh ba iong na ka khlaw banyngkong.

method.en: Add the turmeric at the start, not at the end. Lakadong needs the whole boil to open.
method.l: Buh ïa ka shynrai ha ka sdang, ym ha kaba kut. Ka Lakadong ka donkam ka jingkhlaw baroh.

method.en: Salt only after the dal is soft, or it stays hard however long it boils.
method.l: Buh ïa ka mluh tang hadien ba ka dal ka long bajem, lada em ka shong ba eh.

method.en: Temper the chilli and ginger in ghee and pour it in with the lid ready.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sohmynken bad ka sying ha ka ghee bad kynshew hapoh bad khang mynta.

recipes.why: Lakadong turmeric is Meghalaya's GI crop and carries the highest curcumin of any turmeric grown anywhere. Used at this rate the dal is orange rather than yellow, and that colour is the point.
recipes.why_l: Ka shynrai Lakadong ka dei ka bit GI jong ka Meghalaya bad ka don ka curcumin bakhraw tam ha pyrthei. Lada shong kum kane, ka dal ka long ba saw, ym ba stem, bad kata ka rong ka dei ka jingmut.

recipes.name: Rymbai ka Dal
recipes.sub: The local black bean boiled soft and lightly mashed
recipes.sub_l: Ka rymbai iong jong ka ri, bakhlaw bajem bad badup khyndiat

method.en: Soak the beans twelve hours in plenty of water and throw the soaking water away.
method.l: Sait ïa ki rymbai shi phew ar por ha bun um bad thok noh ïa kata ka um.

method.en: Boil them alone with the turmeric for an hour and a half before anything joins them.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ki ba lang bad ka shynrai shi por bad shi bynta da nangta buh ki kiwei.

method.en: Mash a third of the pot against the side and leave the rest whole.
method.l: Dup shi bynta lai jong ka khiew ha ka lieng bad ai ïa ki kiwei ban long baroh.

method.en: This is what gives the body without making it a paste, which the bean will not forgive.
method.l: Kane ka ai ka jingkhraw khlem pynlong badup, kaba ka rymbai ka ym pyrshang.

method.en: Temper ginger and chilli in ghee, pour it over and cover five minutes.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sying bad ka sohmynken ha ka ghee, kynshew hapoh bad khang san minit.

recipes.why: Rymbai grows between the maize on every Khasi terrace and is what the state used before dal was bought in. It is dearer than moong here but it is the pulse a Khasi kitchen actually knows.
recipes.why_l: Ka rymbai ka bit hapdeng ka riewbah ha baroh ki lyngkha Khasi, bad kane ka dei kaba ka ri ka pyndonkam da nangta thied dal na madan. Ka dam ka jrong khan na ka moong, hynrei kane ka dei ka rymbai kaba ka iing thung Khasi ka tip.

recipes.name: Dal bad Jhur Jaiur
recipes.name_l: Ka Dal bad ka Jhur Jaiur
recipes.sub: Dal finished with mustard greens stirred in at the last
recipes.sub_l: Ka dal kaba kut bad ka jhur jaiur baba buh ha kaba kut

method.en: Boil the dal with turmeric until it is soft, skimming the first foam away.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka dal bad ka shynrai haduh ba ka jem, bad kyllon noh ïa ka jingphoh banyngkong.

method.en: Wash the greens in three changes of water and chop them short, stems and all.
method.l: Sait ïa ka jhur lai sien bad ot lyngkot ïa ka, bad ki jrong ruh.

method.en: Smoke the mustard oil and cool it a little before the ginger goes in.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka tulsi jaiur haduh ba ka rngi bad pynsyiar khyndiat da nangta buh ka sying.

method.en: Raw mustard oil is bitter and that bitterness is what people call a badly cooked dal.
method.l: Ka tulsi jaiur bathymmai ka long ba khaw, bad kata ka jingkhaw ka dei kaba khot ki briew dal babym bha.

method.en: Stir the greens in for the last four minutes only, uncovered.
method.l: Buh ïa ka jhur tang ïa ki saw minit baneiwa, khlem khang.

method.en: Covered, they go the colour of old rope and the dal looks a day old.
method.l: Lada khang, ka jhur ka long kum ka thied barim bad ka dal ka pyni kum ka jong mynhynnin.

recipes.why: Mustard greens are on every Khasi terrace from October to March and cost almost nothing. This is the dish that puts a green on the plate without a second vessel or a second fire.
recipes.why_l: Ka jhur jaiur ka don ha baroh ki lyngkha Khasi na October haduh March bad ka dam ka long khyndiat eh. Kane ka buh ka jhur ha ka ding khlem ka khiew banar bad khlem ka ding banar.

recipes.name: Dal Masoor
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked till the skins split, with tomato
recipes.sub_l: Ka masoor baroh ba la shet haduh ba ki snier ki pat, bad ka jaiur

method.en: Soak the masoor two hours. The whole lentil carries a skin and an unsoaked one is still a bead when the vessel is off the fire.
method.l: Buh ia ka masoor ha ka um ar por. Ka masoor baroh ka rah ka snier, bad kaba ym la buh ka long dang kum ka symbai haba ka blang ka mih na ka ding.

method.en: Salt only after the skins split. Salted early, masoor holds its skin and an hour more on the fire will not open it.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ki snier ki pat. Haba la buh bathuh, ka masoor ka bat ia ka snier jong ka, bad shi por shuh halor ka ding kan ym pynkhang ia ka.

method.en: Tomato in the last ten minutes only. Cooked from the start it goes to a paste and the dal is a soup with no lentil to be seen.
method.l: Ka jaiur ha ki khadar minit baneh tang. Haba la shet na kaba sdang ka long ka jingnam, bad ka dal ka long ka soup bad ym don ka masoor ban shem.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Masoor drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and one that is right in the kitchen is a solid in the hall.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka bariw shuh ban ka dei. Ka masoor ka dih ar phew minit ha ka blang, bad kaba beit ha ka rukom shet ka long bajrong ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse at Iewduh eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time a rymbai takes.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, bad ka masoor ka dei ka jingbam baroh kaba khyndiat dam tam ha Iewduh phra bnai jong ka snem. Ka shet ha shynna ka por ba ka rymbai ka lam.

recipes.name: Dal Moong
recipes.sub: Split moong cooked thin with cumin and a leaf of curry
recipes.sub_l: Ka moong ba la pra ba la shet bariw bad ka jeera bad ka sla curry

method.en: Roast the moong dry five minutes before it is washed. It is what keeps three kilos from going to a single paste and it costs nothing.
method.l: Em ia ka moong basngai san minit shaphang ba sait ia ka. Kata ka dei kaba pynsah ia ki lai kilo na kaba long tang shi jingnam, bad kam dam ei ei.

method.en: Nothing soaks. Moong is the one dal in this store room that goes soft in thirty minutes from dry.
method.l: Ym don kaei ban buh ha ka um. Ka moong ka dei ka shi dal ha kane ka dep kaba long baduna ha lai phew minit na kaba basngai.

method.en: Keep it thin enough to drink. A thick moong dal on a Khasi leaf is eaten with the fingers and nobody finishes it.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw biang ban dih. Ka dal moong bajrong halor ka sla Khasi ka shah bam da ki kti, bad ym don uno uno ba pynlait ia ka.

method.en: The ghee tempering goes over it at the counter. Poured in the kitchen, the smell is gone by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: Ka ghee ba la em ka dep halor ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Haba la thoh ha ka rukom shet, ka jingsngi ka duh haduh ba ka blang ka pyrshah ia ka kper.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head and it is on the counter in forty minutes. It is the dal for the day a Shillong kitchen is short of both time and cooks.
recipes.why_l: Khadphra tyngka ha u briew, bad ka don ha ka jaka ba ai ha saw phew minit. Ka dei ka dal na ka bynta ka sngi ba ka rukom shet Shillong ka duna ka por bad ki nongshet.

recipes.name: Dal Kulai
recipes.sub: Black gram cooked long with ginger and finished with ghee
recipes.sub_l: Ka kulai iong ba la shet slem bad ka sying bad la pyndep bad ka ghee

method.en: Soak it twelve hours and cook it in the soaking water. That dark water is half the colour of the finished dal.
method.l: Buh ia ka ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ka ha ka um kata. Kata ka um baiong ka dei shynna ka rong jong ka dal ba la dep.

method.en: Three hours on a low fire and no shortcut. A kulai boiled hard for one hour is a bead with a broken skin and nothing else.
method.l: Lai por halor ka ding basuk, ym don ka lynti bakhyndiat. Ka kulai ba la pyndih bajrong shi por ka long ka symbai bad ka snier ba pat, ym don kaei kaei shuh.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a kulai hardens and two hours more will not save it.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ka symbai ka long baduna. Haba la buh bathuh, ka kulai ka long bajrong, bad ar por shuh kin ym pynim ia ka.

method.en: The ghee goes in off the fire and is not stirred through. It should sit on the surface where the hall can see it.
method.l: Ka ghee ka dep na ka ding bad ym dei ban kylla ia ka. Ka dei ban shong halor khnang ba ka iing ka lah ban shem ia ka.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. Three and a half kilos of kulai holds a hall through a Nohprah afternoon better than five of any other pulse.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Ki lai bad shynna kilo kulai ki bat ia ka iing lyngba ka mynsiem u Nohprah bhabha ba ki san kilo jong ka jingbam baroh bapher.

recipes.name: Dal Chana
recipes.sub: Chana dal soaked long and cooked to hold its shape
recipes.sub_l: Ka dal chana ba la buh slem ha ka um ban bat ia ka jingiaid jong ka

method.en: Soak it four hours and not two. Chana is the hardest dal in this store room and a short soak means an hour more on the fire.
method.l: Buh ia ka ha ka um saw por, ym ar. Ka chana ka dei ka dal kaba bajrong tam ha kane ka dep, bad ka jingbuh bakhyndiat ka mean shi por shuh halor ka ding.

method.en: This is the one dal in the book where a whole grain is a good sign. Keep it loose and let the chana be seen.
method.l: Kane ka dei ka shi dal ha ka kot kaba ka symbai baroh ka long ka dienjat babha. Pynsah ia ka bapra bad shah shem ia ka chana.

method.en: Skim the froth off in the first ten minutes. Chana froth left in the vessel gives twenty-four litres a taste of soap.
method.l: Rah noh ka jingphuh ha ki khadar minit banyngkong. Ka jingphuh chana ba la pynsah ha ka blang ka ai ia ki 24 litar ka jingsngew kum ka sabon.

method.en: Ghee generously at the end. Chana dal is dry in the mouth and without the ghee a devotee stops halfway down the plate.
method.l: Buh ka ghee bakhraw ha kaba dep. Ka dal chana ka long basngai ha ka shyntur, bad ym bad ka ghee u nongbam u thang ha shynna ka plet.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head and it holds longer than any other dal here. On the morning of a walk to a Nongkrem this is what the kitchen sends out.
recipes.why_l: Khadkhyndai tyngka ha u briew, bad ka bat slem ban ka dal baroh bapher hangne. Ha ka step jong ka jingiaid sha ka Nongkrem, kane ka dei kaba ka rukom shet ka phah shabar.

recipes.name: Dal bad Sohphlang
recipes.sub: Moong dal cooked thin with sohphlang cut in at the end
recipes.sub_l: Ka dal moong ba la shet bariw bad ka sohphlang ba la ot ha kaba dep

method.en: The sohphlang goes in raw in the last four minutes. Cooked twenty minutes it loses the crunch it is put in for and becomes a soft white thing in a yellow dal.
method.l: Ka sohphlang ka dep baiar ha ki saw minit baneh. Haba la shet ar phew minit ka duh ia ka jingkrai ba la buh ia ka na ka bynta ka, bad ka long tang ka jingbam baduna basaw ha ka dal bastem.

method.en: Peel it with the fingers and not a knife. The skin comes away in one piece if it is fresh and a knife takes the flesh with it.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka da ki kti, ym da u wait. Ka snier ka mih shi jingot lada ka long bathymmai, bad u wait u rah noh ia ka doh lang bad u.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the counter. Sesame boiled in a dal for twenty minutes tastes of nothing at all.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Ka nei ba la pyndih ha ka dal ar phew minit ka sngew ym kaei kaei.

method.en: Keep the dal thin. Sohphlang in a thick dal cannot be found by the fingers and three kilos of it is wasted.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka dal bariw. Ka sohphlang ha ka dal bajrong ka ym shah shem da ki kti, bad ki lai kilo jong ka ki duh.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head. Sohphlang is dug on the Khasi slopes and sold at Iewduh in Nohprah, and this is the dal a Khasi guest names as the one thing from home.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha u briew. Ka sohphlang ka shah kynshew ha ki lum Khasi bad ka shah die ha Iewduh ha u Nohprah, bad kane ka dei ka dal kaba u nongwan Khasi u kyrteng kum ka shi kajuh na ka iing.

recipes.name: Kappa
recipes.sub: Garo cassava boiled and mashed with chilli and mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: Ka kappa Garo bakhlaw badup bad ka sohmynken bad ka tulsi jaiur

method.en: Peel the cassava thick and cut the woody core out of every root.
method.l: Kih bakhraw ïa ka kappa bad ot noh ïa ka dieng hapoh na man ka tyllong.

method.en: The core does not soften however long it boils and one piece spoils a whole pot.
method.l: Ka dieng hapoh ka ym jem lada khlaw slem kumno ruh, bad shi tylli ka pynbylla ïa ka khiew baroh.

method.en: Boil in salted water twenty-five minutes until a stick goes through without pushing.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ha ka um bamluh shi phew san minit haduh ba ka dieng ka lah leit hapoh khlem pyllet.

method.en: Drain it at once. Cassava left in its water goes to glue within ten minutes.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka um mynta. Ka kappa kaba shong ha ka um ka long kum ka gundu ha shi phew minit.

method.en: Mash it hot with a wooden pestle, working in the oil, chilli and ginger.
method.l: Dup ïa ka ha ba dang shyiap da ka dieng, bad buh ïa ka tulsi, ka sohmynken bad ka sying.

recipes.why: Cassava is the Garo Hills' own crop and the cheapest starch in any Meghalaya market at ₹22 a kilo. At ₹9 a head this is what to cook when the rice has run out and the hall is already full.
recipes.why_l: Ka kappa ka dei ka bit jong ki Lum Garo bad ka starch bakhyndiat dam tam ha baroh ki iewduh Meghalaya, ₹22 ha shi kilo. Ha ₹9 ha uwei u ngut, kane ka dei kaba thung lada ka ja ka la duh bad ka iing ka la dap.

recipes.name: Ja Um
recipes.sub: Thin rice gruel with ginger, for the sick and for the early hours
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja um bajem bad ka sying, ïa ki briew bapang bad ïa ka step

method.en: Wash the broken rice twice only; washing it more takes the starch this dish is made of.
method.l: Sait ïa ka ja tang ar sien; lada sait bun, ka starch kaba pynlong ïa kane ka jingbam ka leit noh.

method.en: Boil it in the full water from cold, not in water already boiling.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka na ka um basyiar, ym buh ha ka um kaba la khlaw.

method.en: Stir the bottom every five minutes. Broken rice settles and catches faster than whole.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka khyndew jong ka khiew man san minit. Ka ja babrop ka sah ha khyndew bad ka tyllet lyngkot.

method.en: Cook forty minutes until the grain has gone and the water has thickened by itself.
method.l: Thung saw phew minit haduh ba ka symbai ka jah bad ka um ka long bakhraw da lade.

method.en: Ginger and salt at the end, and serve it looser than it looks right.
method.l: Ka sying bad ka mluh ha kaba kut, bad ai bam ba jem khan na kaba pyni bha.

recipes.why: The cheapest page in this book at ₹5.50 a head, and the one a Khasi household falls back on in the last week of a month. It is also what is carried to anyone in the compound who is ill.
recipes.why_l: Ka kot bakhyndiat dam tam ha kane, ₹5.50 ha uwei u ngut, bad kaba ka iing Khasi ka wad ha ka taiew baneiwa jong ka bnai. Kane ruh ka dei kaba bah sha uno uno ha ka iing ba pang.

recipes.name: Jhur Sla
recipes.sub: Whatever green the hillside gave that week, cooked in one pan
recipes.sub_l: Ka jhur kaba ka lum ka ai ha kata ka taiew, bathung ha shi tylli tawa

method.en: Sort the greens into thick stem and soft leaf before anything is lit.
method.l: Bret ïa ka jhur ha ki jrong bakhraw bad ki sla bajem da nangta pynding.

method.en: Give the stems four minutes in the oil before the leaf goes anywhere near it.
method.l: Ai ïa ki jrong saw minit ha ka tulsi da nangta buh ïa ki sla.

method.en: Both in together and the leaf is rope by the time the stem is done.
method.l: Lada buh baroh lang, ki sla ki long kum ka thied ha ba ki jrong ki dang thung.

method.en: Cook uncovered on a high flame. A lid boils them in their own water.
method.l: Thung khlem khang ha ka ding bakhraw. Ka jingkhang ka pynkhlaw ïa ki ha ka um jong ki hi.

method.en: Scatter the roasted sesame over at the very end, off the fire.
method.l: Kynshew ïa ka nei basyied ha kaba kut eh, hadien ba pynsngiah na ka ding.

recipes.why: Meghalaya eats more wild and half-wild greens than any state on this shelf, and none of them costs more than ₹20 a kilo in season. This page has no fixed list on purpose — cook what came down the hill that morning.
recipes.why_l: Ka Meghalaya ka bam bun jhur khlaw bad jhur iing khan na kiwei pat ki ri, bad ym don kaba dam khan na ₹20 ha shi kilo ha ka por jong ka. Kane ka kot ka ym don ka thoh babit — thung ïa kaba wan na ka lum ha kata ka step.

recipes.name: Phan Um
recipes.sub: Potato broken into a thin broth with sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ki phan ba la pynkhih sha ka um bariw bad ka nei bad ka sohmynken

method.en: Boil the phan in the skin and break it by hand after. Peeled before boiling, twelve kilos drinks the water and the broth is thin and grey.
method.l: Pyndih ia ki phan bad ka snier bad pynkhih ia ki da ka kti ynda. Haba la pynhiar shaphang ba pyndih, ki 12 kilo ki dih ia ka um, bad ka um ka long bariw bad barongkhraw.

method.en: Break them and do not cut them. A knife-cut phan holds its edges and the broth never thickens on its own.
method.l: Pynkhih ia ki, ym dei ban ot ia ki. Ka phan ba la ot da u wait ka bat ia ki snier jong ka, bad ka um kan ym long bajrong da ka lade.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it coarse. It is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour anywhere in it.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam bajrong. Kata ka dei kaba pynlong ia ki 26 litar bajrong ym bad ka badup hangno hangno.

method.en: Keep it thin enough to drink off the leaf. A thick phan um is a mash and the hall leaves half of it.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw biang ban dih na ka sla. Ka phan um bajrong ka long ka jingnam, bad ka iing ka pynsah shynna ka.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head, the cheapest wet dish in this book. Phan is in an Iewduh sack every month of the year at twenty rupees a kilo.
recipes.why_l: Phra tyngka ha u briew, ka jingbam baum kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot. Ki phan ki don ha ka khaw Iewduh ha ka bnai baroh jong ka snem ha ar phew tyngka ka kilo.

recipes.name: Rymbai Um
recipes.sub: Beans boiled long with a pinch of soda till they break
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai ba la pyndih slem bad ka soda khyndiat haduh ba ki pat

method.en: A pinch of soda and no more than a pinch. Forty grams in twenty-four litres softens the bean; any more and the whole vessel tastes of soap.
method.l: Ka soda khyndiat tang, ym shuh. Saw phew gram ha ki 24 litar ki pynduna ia ka rymbai; lada shuh ka blang baroh ka sngew kum ka sabon.

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water. The dark water is half the colour of the finished vessel.
method.l: Buh ia ki ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ki ha ka um kata. Ka um baiong ka dei shynna ka rong jong ka blang ba la dep.

method.en: Leave the vessel uncovered while the soda works. Under a lid it froths over and half of twenty-four litres is on the floor.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka blang ba la khang ym katba ka soda ka trei. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ka phuh noh, bad shynna ki 24 litar ki dep ha ka khyndew.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a rymbai hardens and no amount of soda brings it back.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ka rymbai ka long baduna. Haba la buh bathuh, ka rymbai ka long bajrong, bad ka soda katno katno kan ym pynwan phai ia ka.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. Three and a half kilos of rymbai gives a hundred people the protein of a meal and the vessel keeps overnight without a fridge.
recipes.why_l: Khadar tyngka ha u briew. Ki lai bad shynna kilo rymbai ki ai ia u shispah briew ka bha jong ka jingbam, bad ka blang ka sah jong ka miet ym bad ka fridge.

recipes.name: Pathaw Um
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down thin with its own sweetness
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la shet bariw bad ka jingsngai jong ka lade

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a hill pathaw. The skin is what stops fourteen kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka snier lada ka long ka pathaw lum. Ka snier ka dei kaba pynthang ia ki 14 kilo na kaba long tang shi jingnam basaw.

method.en: No sugar and no jaggery. A Risaw pathaw is sweet on its own and sweetened further it is a kheer with chilli in it.
method.l: Ym don ka chini bad ka gur. Ka pathaw u Risaw ka long basngai da ka lade, bad haba la pynsngai shuh ka long ka kheer bad ka sohmynken ha ka.

method.en: Let it fall apart on its own and do not mash it. Pathaw mashed with a ladle goes watery within twenty minutes of standing.
method.l: Shah ia ka ban pat da ka lade, ym dei ban nam ia ka. Ka pathaw ba la nam da ka kailoi ka long baum ha ar phew minit jong ka jingshong.

method.en: Raw mustard oil over it at the counter. Heated oil covers the sweetness and the whole vessel tastes of turmeric.
method.l: Ka tyrso um baiar halor ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Ka tyrso um bakhraw ka khap ia ka jingsngai, bad ka blang baroh ka sngew kum ka shynrai.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head, the cheapest thing on this shelf. In Risaw a Ri Bhoi field gives more pathaw than the kitchen can use and fourteen kilos costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Hynniew tyngka ha u briew, kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka jaka. Ha u Risaw ka rep Ri Bhoi ka ai ka pathaw ba bun ban kaba ka rukom shet ka lah pyndonkam, bad ki 14 kilo ki dam tang ka jingbah.

recipes.name: Bandakobi Jhur
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded and cooked dry in its own water
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi ba la ot bariw bad la shet basngai ha ka um jong ka

method.en: No water at any point. Fourteen kilos of bandakobi gives up three litres in the first ten minutes and that is all it needs.
method.l: Ym don ka um hangno hangno. Ki 14 kilo bandakobi ki ai lai litar ha ki khadar minit banyngkong, bad kata ka dei baroh kaba donkam.

method.en: Cook it uncovered. Under a lid the cabbage steams and the smell reaches the far end of the hall before the vessel does.
method.l: Shet ia ka ba la khang ym. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ka bandakobi ka stem, bad ka jingsngi ka poi sha ka bneng iing shaphang ba ka blang ka poi.

method.en: Two batches in a wide kadai. Fourteen kilos at once steams in its own water however hard the fire is pushed.
method.l: Ar sien ha ka kadai bakhraw. Ki 14 kilo lang ki stem ha ka um jong ki, la ka ding ka long bakhraw katno katno ruh.

method.en: Take it off while a shred still snaps. A cabbage cooked through is grey and eighteen kilos of grey cabbage comes back.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka katba ka jingot ka dang pat. Ka bandakobi ba la shet biang ka long barongkhraw, bad ki 18 kilo bandakobi barongkhraw ki phai.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a head. Bandakobi keeps ten days in a Shillong store room where a green leaf keeps two, and fourteen kilos is a sabji for a hundred.
recipes.why_l: Phra tyngka ha u briew. Ka bandakobi ka sah khadshiphew sngi ha ka dep Shillong ha kaba ka sla bathiang ka sah ar, bad ki 14 kilo ki long ka jhur na u shispah briew.

recipes.name: Jhur Kynbat
recipes.sub: Whatever greens the kper gave, cooked in one vessel with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Kiei kiei ki jhur ba ka kper ka la ai, ba la shet ha shi blang bad ka nei

method.en: Sort the greens into the tender and the tough before anything else. Cooked together, half the vessel is raw and half is grey.
method.l: Pynpra ia ki jhur sha kiba baduna bad kiba bajrong shaphang ba don kaei kaei. Haba la shet lang, shynna ka blang ka long baiar bad shynna ka long barongkhraw.

method.en: The tough stalks go in eight minutes before the leaf. That eight minutes is the whole difference between a dish and a waste of twelve kilos.
method.l: Ki mrad bajrong ki dep phra minit shaphang ba ka sla. Kata ka phra minit ka dei ka jingpher baroh hapdeng ka jingbam bad ka jingduh jong ki 12 kilo.

method.en: No water at all. Twelve kilos of green leaf gives up two litres in the first four minutes.
method.l: Ym don ka um ei ei. Ki 12 kilo sla bathiang ki ai ar litar ha ki saw minit banyngkong.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It is the only thing that makes a plate of mixed greens taste like something planned.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Kata tang ka dei kaba pynlong ia ka plet jhur bapher pher ban sngew kum kaba la pyniaidkhmat.

recipes.why: Seven rupees a head and nothing is bought but the nei. The greens are whatever the kper gave that week and no two vessels of it are the same.
recipes.why_l: Hynniew tyngka ha u briew, bad ym don kaei kaba thied ban ka nei. Ki jhur ki dei kiei kiei ba ka kper ka la ai ha kata ka taiew, bad ym don ki ar blang jong ka kiba long kumjuh.

recipes.name: Phan ha Ghee
recipes.sub: Potato cooked slow in ghee with rock salt, for the fast day
recipes.sub_l: Ki phan bathung sngur ha ka ghee bad ka mluh maw, ïa ka sngi jingdum

method.en: Boil the potatoes in their skins, cool them, and rub the skins off by hand.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ki phan bad ki snieh, pynsyiar, bad shet noh ïa ki snieh da ka kti.

method.en: Press each one under the palm until it cracks but holds together.
method.l: Pyllet ïa man tylli hapoh ka kti haduh ba ka ïai hynrei ka dang kem lang.

method.en: A cracked potato takes the ghee right through; a whole one stays plain inside.
method.l: Ka phan baïai ka shim ïa ka ghee haduh hapoh; kaba dang baroh ka sah ba jem hapoh.

method.en: Cook them in the ghee on the lowest flame twenty minutes, turning twice only.
method.l: Thung ïa ki ha ka ghee ha ka ding bakhyndiat tam shi phew minit, pynkylla tang ar sien.

method.en: Add rock salt, chilli and ginger at the end and no water at any point.
method.l: Buh ïa ka mluh maw, ka sohmynken bad ka sying ha kaba kut, bad wat ai um shi tylli por.

recipes.why: The Ekadashi dish that can be held hot for two hours without going to paste, which matters when the fast is broken at different times. No grain, no lentil, no ordinary salt.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam Ekadashi kaba lah ban buh ba shyiap ar por khlem long badup, kaba dei lada ki briew ki thok ïa ka jingdum ha ki por bym lang. Ym don ja, ym don dal, ym don mluh baroh.

recipes.name: Sohphlang bad Nei
recipes.sub: The Khasi tuber eaten raw, scraped and tossed with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohphlang bam bathymmai, bakher bad baiasumar bad ka nei

method.en: Wash the tubers in three changes of water; they come out of red earth and hold it.
method.l: Sait ïa ka sohphlang lai sien; ka mih na ka khyndew basaw bad ka kem ïa ka.

method.en: Scrape the skin off with a knife rather than peeling it thick.
method.l: Kher noh ïa ka snieh da ka waitlam, ym kih bakhraw.

method.en: Sohphlang is eaten raw and is never cooked. Heat turns it to a soft tasteless thing.
method.l: Ka sohphlang ka bam bathymmai bad ka ym shym thung. Ka jingshyiap ka pynlong ïa ka bajem bad babym rngi.

method.en: Crush the roasted sesame coarse and toss it through with chilli and ginger.
method.l: Dup bakhraw ïa ka nei basyied bad sumar bad ka sohmynken bad ka sying.

method.en: Rock salt and lemon at the counter. Dressed early it weeps and goes limp.
method.l: Ka mluh maw bad ka soh mynken lieh ha ka counter. Lada buh lyngkot ka ai um bad ka jem.

recipes.why: Sohphlang grows nowhere but these hills and is dug from November to February. It is a root and not a grain, so it belongs on a fast day — and it is the one Ekadashi dish here that needs no fire at all.
recipes.why_l: Ka sohphlang ka ym bit ha kawei pat ka jaka lyngba kine ki lum bad ka pyrduh na November haduh February. Ka long ka tyllong, ym ka symbai, kumta ka dei ïa ka sngi jingdum — bad ka dei ka jingbam Ekadashi kaba ym donkam ding shi tylli.

recipes.name: Soh Niamtra bad Dud
recipes.name_l: Ka Soh Niamtra bad ka Dud
recipes.sub: Hung curd folded with mandarin segments and walnut
recipes.sub_l: Ka dud bakyrtong bad ki bynta soh niamtra bad ka soh sniang

method.en: Hang the curd in a double cloth four hours in a cool room, not overnight.
method.l: Kyrtong ïa ka dud ha ar tylli jaiñ saw por ha ka iing basyiar, ym shi miet baroh.

method.en: Curd hung too long turns to cheese and then needs cream to come back.
method.l: Ka dud bakyrtong slem eh ka long kum ka cheese bad ka donkam cream ban wan biang.

method.en: Beat the sugar into the hung curd until it is smooth and holds a peak.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka sini hapoh ka dud haduh ba ka long bajem bad ka ieng ba jrong.

method.en: Pith each mandarin segment and fold them in whole at the last moment.
method.l: Shet noh ïa ka bakhuid balieh na man ka bynta bad buh ïa ki baroh ha kaba kut eh.

method.en: A broken segment bleeds and the whole tray is water within the hour.
method.l: Shi bynta baïai ka ai um bad ka tray baroh ka long um ha shi por.

recipes.why: Mandarin is at its cheapest in December, which is when the winter Ekadashis fall. Nothing here is cooked, which matters on a day the kitchen is fasting alongside the hall.
recipes.why_l: Ka soh niamtra ka khyndiat dam tam ha December, ha ka por ba ki Ekadashi basyiar ki wan. Ym don ei ei baba thung hangne, kaba dei ha ka sngi ba ka iing thung ruh ka dum lang bad ka iing.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
recipes.sub: Sago soaked to the grain and turned with groundnut and potato
recipes.sub_l: Ka sabudana ba la buh haduh ka symbai bad la kylla bad ka badam bad ki phan

method.en: Wash the sago three times and soak it in water that only just covers it. Sago under two inches of water is a paste by morning.
method.l: Sait ia ka sabudana lai sien bad buh ia ka ha ka um kaba khap tang biang ia ka. Ka sabudana ha khnong ar inch um ka long ka jingnam haduh ka step.

method.en: Six hours is enough here and not the overnight the plains use. A longer soak makes it wetter and a wet sabudana will not separate.
method.l: Hynriew por ki biang hangne, ym ka miet baroh kum ba ki bri ki pyndonkam. Ka jingbuh baslem ka pynlong ia ka baum shuh, bad ka sabudana baum kan ym pynpra.

method.en: Roast the groundnut, skin it and crush it coarse. Whole groundnut rolls off the spoon and the crushed part stops the sago sticking.
method.l: Em ia ka badam khyndew, pynhiar ia ka snier bad nam bajrong. Ka badam baroh ka wir noh na ka spun, bad ka bynta banam ka pynthang ia ka sabudana na kaba shet.

method.en: Rock salt only and taste it at the pan. On a fast day the difference matters to the devotee even where it does not to the cook.
method.l: Ka mluh mawlain tang, bad sngew ia ka ha ka blang. Ha ka sngi jingdih ym, ka jingpher ka don ka akor ia u nongbam la kam don ia u nongshet.

recipes.why: Twenty-seven rupees a head. It is the Ekadashi dish a Shillong kitchen can make with nothing that grew in the hills, which matters in Nohprah.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew hynniew tyngka ha u briew. Kane ka dei ka jingbam Ekadashi kaba ka rukom shet Shillong ka lah pynlong ym bad kaei kaba la mih ha ki lum, kaba don ka akor ha u Nohprah.

recipes.name: Rajgira ka Roti
recipes.sub: Amaranth flour rolled between sheets and fried in ghee
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup rajgira ba la lan hapdeng ki ar jaiñ bad la syied ha ka ghee

method.en: Mashed boiled potato is what binds this dough. Rajgira flour alone has nothing to hold it and the roti falls apart on the way to the kadai.
method.l: Ki phan bapyndih banam ki dei kiba bat ia kane ka jingnam. Ka badup rajgira marwei ka ym don kaei ban bat ia ka, bad ka roti ka pat ha ka lynti sha ka kadai.

method.en: Roll each one between two greased sheets and never on an open board. Rajgira dough sticks to everything and tears on the lifting.
method.l: Lan ia ka shi tylli hapdeng ki ar jaiñ batyrso, ym shym halor ka phlang bakhang. Ka jingnam rajgira ka shet ha kaei kaei bad ka pat haba la pynkhih.

method.en: Keep the ghee below smoking. Rajgira browns in half the time wheat does and a dark roti tastes of burnt flour.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka ghee harud ka jingphuh. Ka rajgira ka long basaw ha shynna ka por ba ka gohum ka lam, bad ka roti baiong ka sngew kum ka badup baduh.

method.en: Fry to order in lots of twenty. A rajgira roti is soft within fifteen minutes and cannot be brought back.
method.l: Syied kat ba la kwah, ar phew ha shi sien. Ka roti rajgira ka long baduna ha 15 minit, bad ym lah ban pynwan phai ia ka.

recipes.why: Forty-two rupees a head, most of it the ghee, and on a day when oil is not taken there is no honest way to make it cheaper.
recipes.why_l: Saw phew ar tyngka ha u briew, ka bun jong ka ka dei ka ghee; bad ha ka sngi ba ym bam ia ka tyrso um, ym don ka lynti bashisha ban pynkhyndiat dam ia ka.

recipes.name: Makhana ha Dud
recipes.sub: Fox nuts roasted in ghee and cooked down in milk
recipes.sub_l: Ki makhana ba la em ha ka ghee bad la shet ha ka dud

method.en: Roast the makhana in ghee until it snaps between the fingers. Unroasted it turns to sponge in the milk and there is nothing to chew.
method.l: Em ia ki makhana ha ka ghee haduh ba ki pat hapdeng ki kti. Haba ym la em, ki long kum ka sponge ha ka dud bad ym don kaei ban khait.

method.en: Break half of it coarse and leave half whole. The broken half thickens the vessel and the whole half is what is eaten.
method.l: Pynkhih bajrong ia shynna bad pynsah shynna baroh. Ka shynna banam ka pynlong ia ka blang bajrong, bad ka shynna baroh ka dei kaba bam.

method.en: Reduce the milk by a fifth before the makhana goes in. Makhana in cold milk drinks it up and the vessel never thickens on its own.
method.l: Pynduna ia ka dud da ka san bynta shaphang ba ki makhana ki dep. Ki makhana ha ka dud basyllok ki dih noh ia ka, bad ka blang kan ym long bajrong da ka lade.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes only. Added early it stops the makhana softening and it stays rubbery.
method.l: Ka chini ha ki khadar minit baneh tang. Haba la buh bathuh ka pynthang ia ki makhana na kaba long baduna, bad ki sah kum ka rabar.

recipes.why: Forty-six rupees a head. Makhana is dear but a kilo and a half does twenty litres, and on a Nirjala Ekadashi it is the only sweet the hall can be given.
recipes.why_l: Saw phew hynriew tyngka ha u briew. Ki makhana ki dam jrong hynrei ka shi kilo bad shynna ka leh 20 litar, bad ha ka Nirjala Ekadashi kane tang ka jingbam basngai kaba lah ban ai ia ka iing.

recipes.name: Pathaw ha Ghee
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked dry in ghee with rock salt and pepper
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la shet basngai ha ka ghee bad ka mluh mawlain

method.en: Ghee and not mustard oil. On a fast day the oil is not taken and the ghee is what makes fourteen kilos of pathaw worth eating.
method.l: Ka ghee, ym ka tyrso um. Ha ka sngi jingdih ym, ym bam ia ka tyrso um, bad ka ghee ka dei kaba pynlong ia ki 14 kilo pathaw ban dei ban bam.

method.en: Cut it in large cubes and keep the skin on. A small dice dissolves and eighteen kilos is an orange paste with nothing to find in it.
method.l: Ot ia ka ha ki jingot bakhraw bad pynsah ia ka snier. Ki jingot barit ki duh, bad ki 18 kilo ki long ka jingnam basaw bad ym don kaei ban shem ha ka.

method.en: No water and no lid. Under a lid a pathaw steams and eighteen kilos is a wet dish that cannot be served on a fast day.
method.l: Ym don ka um bad ka jingkhap. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ka pathaw ka stem, bad ki 18 kilo ki long ka jingbam baum kaba ym lah ban ai ha ka sngi jingdih ym.

method.en: Cumin and pepper only, and rock salt. Any masala on a fast day sends the plate back and a Khasi kitchen keeps the two jars apart.
method.l: Ka jeera bad ka sohmynken lang tang, bad ka mluh mawlain. Ka masala hangno hangno ha ka sngi jingdih ym ka pynphai ia ka plet, bad ka rukom shet Khasi ka pynsah ia ki ar jar bapher.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head. In Risaw the pathaw costs the carrying and this is the Ekadashi dish that does not need a single thing bought off a plains truck.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew tyngka ha u briew. Ha u Risaw ka pathaw ka dam tang ka jingbah, bad kane ka dei ka jingbam Ekadashi kaba ym donkam ia shi kajuh na ka lori bri.

recipes.name: Sabudana ka Kheer
recipes.sub: Sago pearls cooked slow in milk with cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Ki symbai sabudana ba la shet basuk ha ka dud bad ka elaichi

method.en: A kilo and a half in eighteen litres and no more. Sago swells to five times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: Shi kilo bad shynna ha 18 litar, ym shuh. Ka sabudana ka heh san sien ka jingjrong jong ka, bad ki ar kilo ki long ka blang kaba ym lah ban thoh.

method.en: Wash it three times and add it dry to the boiling milk. Soaked sago in milk goes to a single lump that no ladle will break.
method.l: Sait ia ka lai sien bad buh ia ka basngai ha ka dud kaba pyndih. Ka sabudana ba la buh ha ka um bad ynda ha ka dud ka long tang shi jingbat kaba ym don ka kailoi ban pynkhih.

method.en: Stir the bottom every three minutes. Sago sinks and eighteen litres of milk burns under it without a smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Kylla ia ka khlieh rud ha ka lai minit baroh. Ka sabudana ka shong harud, bad ki 18 litar dud ki duh ha khnong ka ym bad ka jingsngi ban poi sha u nongshet.

method.en: Sugar in the last ten minutes. Added early, the pearl stays hard at the centre and the whole vessel is gritty.
method.l: Ka chini ha ki khadar minit baneh. Haba la buh bathuh, ka symbai ka sah bajrong ha ka dohnud, bad ka blang baroh ka long kum ka mawsiang.

recipes.why: Thirty-three rupees a head. It is the one Ekadashi sweet a Shillong kitchen can put out for a full hall, and a kilo and a half of sago does it.
recipes.why_l: Lai phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Kane ka dei ka shi jingbam basngai Ekadashi kaba ka rukom shet Shillong ka lah ban ai ia ka iing baroh, bad ka shi kilo bad shynna sabudana ka leh ia ka.

recipes.name: Pukhlein
recipes.sub: Rice flour and jaggery fried into a dark chewy disc
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup ja bad ka gur basyied ban long ba iong bad bajem

method.en: Melt the jaggery in the water, strain it through a cloth, and cool it fully.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka gur ha ka um, sait da ka jaiñ, bad pynsyiar bha.

method.en: Straining is not optional; raw jaggery carries grit that will crack your teeth.
method.l: Ka jingsait ka dei; ka gur bathymmai ka bah maw kaba lah ban ïai ïa ki bniat.

method.en: Work the cool syrup into the rice flour to a dough softer than a roti dough.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka um gur basyiar bad ka badup ja ban long bajem khan na ka badup roti.

method.en: Rest it thirty minutes, then pat each one out thin between wet palms.
method.l: Ai ïa ka shi phew lai minit, nangta pyllet ïa man tylli bajem hapdeng ki kti baum.

method.en: Fry at 160°C, low and slow, turning once. Hot oil browns it before the middle cooks.
method.l: Syied ha 160°C, bakhyndiat bad sngur, pynkylla shi sien. Ka tulsi bashyiap eh ka pynsaw shuwa ba ka hapdeng ka thung.

method.en: Drain on wire, not on paper. Pukhlein sweats and paper sticks to it.
method.l: Pynduh ha ka tynrai, ym ha ka pathai. Ka pukhlein ka ai um bad ka pathai ka ïai ha ka.

recipes.why: The sweet that appears at every Khasi festival and market stall, and the one thing a Shillong queue recognises before it is told what it is. It keeps two days, so it can be fried the evening before a programme.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam basngai kaba mih ha man ka sngi bakhraw Khasi bad ha man ka dukan iewduh, bad kaba ka lyngka Shillong ka tip shuwa ba phi ong ïa ka kyrteng. Ka shong ar sngi, kumta ka lah syied ha ka miet shuwa jong ka kam.

recipes.name: Phan Syied
recipes.sub: Potato slices in a rice-flour batter, fried to order
recipes.sub_l: Ki phan baot ha ka badup ja, basyied ha ka por ba donkam

method.en: Slice the potato the thickness of a little finger and soak the slices in cold water.
method.l: Ot ïa ka phan kum ka bakhraw jong ka kti bakhyndiat bad sait ha ka um basyiar.
