method.en: Soaking takes the surface starch off, and that starch is what makes the batter slide.
method.l: Ka jingsait ka pynduh ïa ka starch ha bar, bad kata ka starch ka pynchip ïa ka badup.

method.en: Dry each slice on a cloth before it meets the batter.
method.l: Pynsngai ïa man tylli ha ka jaiñ da nangta buh ha ka badup.

method.en: Make the batter thin enough to see the potato through it, not thick.
method.l: Pynlong ïa ka badup ba jem ban ïoh ïohi ïa ka phan lyngba ka, ym bakhraw.

method.en: Fry at 175°C in small lots and never pile them while hot.
method.l: Syied ha 175°C ha ki bynta bakhyndiat bad wat khreh ïa ki ha ba dang shyiap.

recipes.why: What a Shillong bazaar stall sells all afternoon, and the snack that a hall arriving early can be given in twenty minutes. Rice flour rather than gram flour, because rice flour is half the price here.
recipes.why_l: Kaba die ki dukan iewduh Shillong lyngba ka sngi, bad ka jingbam kaba lah ai ïa ka iing kaba wan lyngkot ha shi phew minit. Ka badup ja, ym ka badup rymbai, naba ka badup ja ka dam shi bynta ar hangne.

recipes.name: Jhur Syied
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetable fritters bound with gram flour and turmeric
recipes.sub_l: Ki jhur baiasumar basyied bad ka badup rymbai bad ka shynrai

method.en: Shred everything to the same thickness so nothing is raw when the rest is done.
method.l: Ot ïa ki baroh kum shi rukom ban ym don kaba dang thymmai lada ki kiwei ki la thung.

method.en: Salt the shredded vegetables and wait ten minutes for them to give their water.
method.l: Buh mluh ha ki jhur baot bad ap shi phew minit ban ki ai ïa ka um jong ki.

method.en: Use that water and no other to bind the flour. Added water makes a batter and this is not one.
method.l: Pyndonkam tang ïa kata ka um ban sumar bad ka badup. Ka um babuh ka pynlong badup jem, bad kane ym dei kata.

method.en: Drop loose spoonfuls in at 170°C; do not shape them into balls.
method.l: Buh ïa ki kiew bajem ha 170°C; wat pynlong ïa ki kum ki tylli barit.

method.en: Fry until the sound in the pan drops away, which is when the water has gone.
method.l: Syied haduh ba ka riam ha ka tawa ka sngiah, kata ka por ba ka um ka la duh.

recipes.why: The one snack here that clears the vegetable store, and the one that can take whatever came off the truck. It costs ₹20 a plate and holds an hour, which most fried things do not.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam kaba pynkhuid ïa ka iing jhur, bad kaba lah shim ïa kaba wan na ka lorry. Ka dam ₹20 ha ka ding bad ka shong shi por, kaba ki jingbam basyied ki ym shym long.

recipes.name: Pakora Bandakobi
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded, squeezed dry and fried in a thick batter
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi ba la ot, la hiar basngai bad la syied ha ka badup bajrong

method.en: Shred, salt and leave twenty minutes, then squeeze with both hands. Five kilos gives up a litre and it has to come out or the batter will not hold.
method.l: Ot, buh ka mluh bad pynsah ar phew minit, ynda hiar da ki ar kti. Ki san kilo ki ai shi litar, bad ka dei ban mih; lymda ka badup kan ym bat.

method.en: A handful of rice flour in the batter is what makes the coat crisp. Besan alone gives a soft skin that goes limp in ten minutes.
method.l: Ka shi kti badup ja ha ka badup ka dei kaba pynlong ia ka snier bakrai. Ka chana marwei ka ai ka snier baduna kaba jah ha khadar minit.

method.en: No water at all in the batter. The cabbage gives up enough after the squeezing and any added is a pakora that will not hold together.
method.l: Ym don ka um ei ei ha ka badup. Ka bandakobi ka ai biang ynda la hiar, bad kaba la buh shuh ka long ka pakora kaba ym sa bat lang.

method.en: Fry in lots of forty and strain the oil between them. Bits that fall off the first lot burn and colour every pakora after them.
method.l: Syied saw phew ha shi sien bad sait ia ka tyrso um hapdeng ki. Ki jingot kiba wir na ka sien banyngkong ki duh bad ki pynrong ia ka pakora baroh ynda ki.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Bandakobi is thirty rupees a kilo at Iewduh in Nohprah and five kilos of it becomes eight hundred pakora.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew. Ka bandakobi ka long lai phew tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh ha u Nohprah, bad ki san kilo ki long phra shiteph pakora.

recipes.name: Pakora Sohmynken
recipes.sub: Long green chillies slit, seeded and fried whole in batter
recipes.sub_l: Ki sohmynken bajrong ba la pat, la kbieng ki symbai bad la syied baroh

method.en: Slit each chilli down one side and scrape the seeds out. The seed is the heat and a hall will not eat six hundred of them with the seed left in.
method.l: Pat ia ka sohmynken shi liang bad kbieng noh ki symbai. Ki symbai ki dei ka jingsngewpoh, bad ka iing kan ym bam ia ki hynriew shiteph lada ki symbai ki sah.

method.en: Choose the long pale chilli and not the small dark one. The small chilli of these hills is four times the heat and nobody can be warned in time.
method.l: Jubab ia ka sohmynken bajrong basaw, ym kaba rit baiong. Ka sohmynken barit jong kine ki lum ka long saw sien ka jingsngewpoh, bad ym lah ban sneng uno uno ha ka por.

method.en: Dry every chilli on a cloth before it meets the batter. A wet chilli slides out of the batter in the oil and fries bare.
method.l: Pynsngai ia ka sohmynken baroh halor ka jaiñ shaphang ba ka ïatiew bad ka badup. Ka sohmynken baum ka tuid noh na ka badup ha ka tyrso um bad ka syied balotho.

method.en: Ajwain in the batter and no cumin. In a chilli pakora the cumin is lost and the ajwain is what is smelt when the basket is opened.
method.l: Ka ajwain ha ka badup, ym ka jeera. Ha ka pakora sohmynken ka jeera ka duh, bad ka ajwain ka dei kaba sngi haba la pynkhang ia ka shang.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. Four kilos of chilli is a snack for a hundred, and at a Shad Suk Mynsiem counter it goes before any other tray.
recipes.why_l: Khadphra tyngka ha u briew. Ki saw kilo sohmynken ki long ka jingbam na u shispah briew, bad ha ka jaka ba ai jong ka Shad Suk Mynsiem ka iaid shaphang ka tre baroh bapher.

recipes.name: Pakora Pathaw
recipes.sub: Pumpkin grated, squeezed and fried ragged in a thick batter
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la khriah, la hiar bad la syied ha ka badup bajrong

method.en: Grate, salt and leave twenty minutes, then squeeze hard. Five kilos gives up a litre and a wet batter cannot be dropped in oil at all.
method.l: Khriah, buh ka mluh bad pynsah ar phew minit, ynda hiar bajrong. Ki san kilo ki ai shi litar, bad ka badup baum ka ym lah ban buh ha ka tyrso um ei ei.

method.en: No water in the batter. The pathaw gives up enough after the squeezing and anything added is a pakora that will not hold.
method.l: Ym don ka um ha ka badup. Ka pathaw ka ai biang ynda la hiar, bad kaei kaba la buh shuh ka long ka pakora kaba ym sa bat.

method.en: Drop them with the fingers and not a spoon. A pathaw pakora should be ragged; a neat ball of it fries raw in the middle.
method.l: Buh ia ki da ki kti khyndiat, ym da ka spun. Ka pakora pathaw ka dei ban long bapher pher; ka jingnam babeit ka syied baiar ha ka dohnud.

method.en: Fry on a medium flame right through. Pumpkin needs longer than a cabbage and a hot kadai browns the outside while the inside is raw.
method.l: Syied halor ka ding bahapdeng haduh ba dep. Ka pathaw ka donkam ka por baslem ban ka bandakobi, bad ka kadai bakhraw ka pynsaw ia shabar katba ka bynta shapoh ka dang iar.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head, and in Risaw the pathaw is the cheapest thing on an Iewduh cart. This is the tray a kitchen can put out at no notice.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynsan tyngka ha u briew, bad ha u Risaw ka pathaw ka dei kaba khyndiat dam tam halor ka gari Iewduh. Kane ka dei ka tre kaba ka rukom shet ka lah ban ai ym bad ka jingtip lypa.

recipes.name: Pakora Rymbai
recipes.sub: Soaked beans ground coarse and fried as fritters
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai ba la buh ha ka um, la kroh bajrong bad la syied

method.en: Soak the rymbai eight hours and grind it coarse with almost no water. A wet grinding gives a batter that spreads flat in the oil and never becomes a fritter.
method.l: Buh ia ki rymbai ha ka um phra por bad kroh bajrong ym bad ka um. Ka jingkroh baum ka ai ka badup kaba pra bariw ha ka tyrso um bad kan ym long ka pakora.

method.en: Grind it coarse and leave some beans half broken. A smooth batter is a bhajia; the broken beans are what a rymbai pakora is asked for.
method.l: Kroh bajrong bad pynsah ki rymbai shynna bapat. Ka badup baduna ka long ka bhajia; ki rymbai bapat ki dei kiba ki briew ki kwah na ka pakora rymbai.

method.en: Beat the ground batter five minutes with the hand before frying. It takes air and seven hundred fritters come out light instead of heavy.
method.l: Nam ia ka badup ba la kroh san minit da ka kti shaphang ba syied. Ka pdiang ia ka lyer, bad ki hynniew shiteph pakora ki mih baduna ym bajrong.

method.en: Fry in lots of thirty and strain between them. Bits of bean that fall off burn black and colour every fritter after them.
method.l: Syied lai phew ha shi sien bad sait hapdeng ki. Ki jingot rymbai kiba wir ki duh baiong bad ki pynrong ia ka pakora baroh ynda ki.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head. Four kilos of rymbai gives seven hundred fritters and the protein of a meal in a tray of snacks.
recipes.why_l: Khadkhyndai tyngka ha u briew. Ki saw kilo rymbai ki ai hynniew shiteph pakora bad ka bha jong ka jingbam ha ka tre jingbam basyied.

recipes.name: Pukhlein Nei
recipes.sub: Rice flour and jaggery dough with sesame, deep fried
recipes.sub_l: Ka jingnam badup ja bad ka gur bad ka nei, ba la syied ha ka tyrso um

method.en: Melt the jaggery into hot water and pour it on the flour hot. Cold syrup on rice flour gives a dough that cracks at every edge.
method.l: Pynduh ia ka gur ha ka um bakhraw bad thoh ia ka bakhraw halor ka badup. Ka gur basyllok halor ka badup ja ka ai ka jingnam kaba pat ha ka snier baroh.

method.en: Roast the nei before it goes in. Raw sesame in a pukhlein tastes of nothing and eight hundred grams of it is wasted.
method.l: Em ia ka nei shaphang ba ka dep. Ka nei baiar ha ka pukhlein ka sngew ym kaei kaei, bad ka phra shiteph gram jong ka ka duh.

method.en: Rest the dough half an hour and shape it warm. Rice flour dough gone cold cannot be pressed into a disc without cracking.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka jingnam shynna por bad pynlong ia ka bakhraw. Ka jingnam badup ja ba la long basyllok ka ym lah ban nam sha ka jaka babiang ym bad ka jingpat.

method.en: Fry two at a time on a medium flame. A pukhlein swells and two hundred in a kadai at once come out as one sheet.
method.l: Syied ar tylli ha shi sien halor ka ding bahapdeng. Ka pukhlein ka heh, bad ki ar shiteph lang ha ka kadai ki mih kum shi jaiñ.

recipes.why: Twenty-seven rupees a head. The pukhlein on this shelf is the plain one; this is the Shad Suk Mynsiem version and the nei is worth the extra rupees.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew hynniew tyngka ha u briew. Ka pukhlein halor kane ka jaka ka dei kaba basngai; kane ka dei ka jong ka Shad Suk Mynsiem, bad ka nei ka biang ia ki tyngka bajrong.

recipes.name: Usoi ka Achar
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot soured in its own juice, then put up in oil
recipes.sub_l: Ka usoi bamuriaw ha ka um jong ka hi, nangta buh ha ka tulsi

method.en: Take only shoots cut that morning; a day-old shoot is woody at the base and bitter through.
method.l: Shim tang ïa ka usoi baba ot ha kata ka step; kaba shong shi sngi ka long dieng ha khyndew bad ka khaw baroh.

method.en: Strip the sheaths, shred the shoot fine and pack it hard into a jar.
method.l: Kih noh ïa ki snieh, ot lyngkot ïa ka usoi bad khreh ba eh ha ka khiew.

method.en: Press until the shoot's own juice rises over it. No water is added at any point.
method.l: Pyllet haduh ba ka um jong ka usoi hi ka mih halor. Ym buh um shi tylli por.

method.en: Juice standing over the shred is the whole method; a dry jar moulds instead of souring.
method.l: Ka um kaba ieng halor ka dei ka rukom baroh; ka khiew basngai ka pynmih ñiawthiah, ym ka muriaw.

method.en: Leave it covered in the shade seven days, then mix with turmeric, chilli and cold oil.
method.l: Ai ïa ka bakhang ha ka jingiap hynniew sngi, nangta sumar bad ka shynrai, ka sohmynken bad ka tulsi basyiar.

recipes.why: Shoots are cut only from June to September and half the wet dishes in this book want them. A season's jars are what let the kitchen cook usoi in February.
recipes.why_l: Ka usoi ka ot tang na June haduh September bad shi bynta ar jong ki jingbam baum ha kane ka kot ki donkam ïa ka. Ki khiew jong shi por bit ki dei kiba pynlah ïa ka iing thung ban thung usoi ha February.

recipes.name: Sohiong ka Jam
recipes.sub: Black cherry cooked down with its own stones for setting
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohiong bathung bad ki symbai jong ka hi ban pynkem

method.en: Simmer the fruit in the water twenty minutes until the flesh leaves the stone.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka soh ha ka um shi phew minit haduh ba ka doh ka phah ïa ka symbai.

method.en: Pull the stones out by hand and tie a dozen of them in a cloth bag.
method.l: Kyllon noh ïa ki symbai da ka kti bad kyrtong shi phew ar tylli ha ka jaiñ.

method.en: Boil that bag with the pulp; the stones carry the pectin that sets this jam.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa kata ka jaiñ bad ka doh; ki symbai ki bah ka pectin kaba pynkem ïa ka jam.

method.en: Take the bag out and squeeze it back into the pot before the sugar goes in.
method.l: Kyllon noh ïa ka jaiñ bad dup ïa ka sha ka khiew shuwa ba buh ka sini.

method.en: Boil hard until a spoonful wrinkles on a cold plate, then bottle at 85°C.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ba eh haduh ba shi kiew ka long baïai ha ka ding basyiar, nangta buh ha 85°C.

recipes.why: Sohiong carries the state's GI tag and falls in August by the sackful in the Khasi and Jaintia hills, unsellable within a week. Put up now it is on the bread at every guest breakfast for the rest of the year.
recipes.why_l: Ka sohiong ka don ka GI jong ka ri bad ka hap ha August da ki bori ha ki lum Khasi bad Jaintia, bad ka ym die shuh hadien shi taiew. Lada buh mynta, ka sah ha ka jingbam step jong ki nongwan lyngba ka snem baroh.

recipes.name: Sohphie ka Achar
recipes.sub: Bay berry salted, dried a day and put up in mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohphie bamluh, basngai shi sngi bad babuh ha ka tulsi jaiur

method.en: Take firm berries only; a soft sohphie has begun to ferment on the tree.
method.l: Shim tang ïa ki soh baeh; ka sohphie bajem ka la sdang ban muriaw ha ka dieng.

method.en: Rub the salt in and leave them on a cloth in full sun a whole day.
method.l: Shet ïa ka mluh hapoh bad ai ïa ki ha ka jaiñ ha ka sngi baroh shi sngi.

method.en: Bring them in at dusk. A night of dew undoes the whole day's drying.
method.l: Wallam ïa ki hapoh ha ka miet. Shi miet ka um miet ka pynbylla ïa ka jingsngai jong ka sngi baroh.

method.en: Smoke the mustard oil and cool it completely before it touches the fruit.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka tulsi jaiur haduh ba ka rngi bad pynsyiar bha shuwa ba ka shim ïa ki soh.

method.en: Warm oil cooks the berry and the achar goes soft in a week; cold oil keeps it a year.
method.l: Ka tulsi bashyiap ka thung ïa ka soh bad ka achar ka jem ha shi taiew; ka tulsi basyiar ka pyllait shi snem.

recipes.why: Sohphie is picked wild across the Khasi hills in May and sold on every roadside for two weeks, then not seen again for a year. This is the one way to have it on the table in December.
recipes.why_l: Ka sohphie ka pyrduh khlaw ha ki lum Khasi ha May bad ka die ha man ka lynti ar taiew, nangta ka ym ïohi shuh shi snem. Kane ka long ka lynti marwei ban don ïa ka ha ka ding ha December.

recipes.name: Sohmynken ka Achar
recipes.sub: Green chillies slit, salted and set in mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: Ki sohmynken bathiang ba la pat, la buh ka mluh bad la buh ha ka tyrso um

method.en: Slit each chilli and salt it two days in the sun before the spice goes on. Those two days draw out the water that would otherwise spoil the jar.
method.l: Pat ia ka sohmynken baroh bad buh ka mluh ar sngi ha ka sngi shaphang ba ka masala ka dep. Kata ki ar sngi ki rah noh ia ka um kaba lada ym ka sa pynduh ia ka jar.

method.en: Roast the fenugreek before it is crushed. Raw methi is what makes an achar bitter three weeks in and nothing takes it out after.
method.l: Em ia ka methi shaphang ba nam. Ka methi baiar ka dei kaba pynlong ia ka achar bakhaw ynda lai taiew, bad ym don kaei ban rah noh ia ka ynda.

method.en: Heat the mustard oil to smoking and let it go cold before it is poured. Raw mustard oil in a jar turns the achar bitter within a month.
method.l: Pynbakhraw ia ka tyrso um haduh ba ka phuh bad shah ia ka ban long basyllok shaphang ba thoh. Ka tyrso um baiar ha ka jar ka pynlong ia ka achar bakhaw ha shi bnai.

method.en: Keep the oil above the level of the chilli and use a dry spoon every time. One wet spoon spoils six kilos.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka tyrso um halor ki sohmynken bad pyndonkam ka spun basngai ha ka por baroh. Ka shi spun baum ka pynduh ia ki hynriew kilo.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a kilo of achar and it keeps four months. In Naitung the Iewduh chilli is forty rupees a kilo and four kilos is a jar for the whole winter.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha ka kilo achar, bad ka sah saw bnai. Ha u Naitung ka sohmynken Iewduh ka long saw phew tyngka ka kilo, bad ki saw kilo ki long ka jar na ka ïatiew baroh.

recipes.name: Soh Niamtra ka Achar
recipes.sub: Citrus cut in wedges and salted down a month before use
recipes.sub_l: Ki soh niamtra ba la ot bad la buh ha ka mluh shi bnai shaphang ba pyndonkam

method.en: Cut them and put them in salt alone for a month before any spice goes near them. This is not an achar that can be made on the day it is wanted.
method.l: Ot ia ki bad buh ia ki ha ka mluh marwei shi bnai shaphang ba ka masala ka poi hakhmat ki. Kane kam dei ka achar kaba lah ban pynlong ha ka sngi ba la kwah ia ka.

method.en: Weigh the fruit down under a stone so the brine covers it. Any wedge standing above the brine grows a white skin and has to be thrown.
method.l: Nam ia ka soh harud u mawlain khnang ba ka um mluh ka khap ia ka. Ka jingot kaba ïeng halor ka um mluh ka mih ka snier basaw bad ka dei ban shah bred noh.

method.en: Keep the white pith out. The pith is the bitterness in a citrus and it does not go away in a jar however long it stands.
method.l: Kbieng noh ia ka bynta basaw shapoh. Kata ka bynta ka dei ka jingsngewkhaw ha ka soh niamtra, bad kan ym duh ha ka jar la ka shong slem katno katno.

method.en: The spices go on cold and never into a hot pan with the fruit. Heat at this stage turns a citrus achar bitter and there is no recovering it.
method.l: Ki masala ki dep basyllok, ym shym ha ka blang bakhraw lang bad ka soh. Ka jingbakhraw ha kane ka jaka ka pynlong ia ka achar soh niamtra bakhaw, bad ym don ka lynti ban pynbeit.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a kilo and it keeps two years. A temple that salts down five kilos in Nohprah has achar till the next Nohprah.
recipes.why_l: Khadar tyngka ha ka kilo, bad ka sah ar snem. Ka mandir kaba buh san kilo ha ka mluh ha u Nohprah ka don ka achar haduh u Nohprah ba wan.

recipes.name: Sying ka Achar
recipes.sub: Ginger cut in matchsticks and set in lemon juice, no oil
recipes.sub_l: Ka sying ba la ot bariw bad la buh ha ka um soh niamtra, ym don ka tyrso um

method.en: Scrape the skin with a spoon and never peel it with a knife. The layer just under the skin is where the whole smell sits.
method.l: Khriah ia ka snier da ka spun, ym shym pynhiar ia ka da u wait. Ka bynta harud ka snier ka dei ka jaka ba ka jingsngi baroh ka shong.

method.en: Cut in matchsticks and not rounds. A round of ginger is too much in one mouthful and the jar goes untouched on the counter.
method.l: Ot bariw kum ki symbai, ym kum ki jingot babiang. Ka jingot sying babiang ka long bun ha shi jingbam, bad ka jar ka sah ym shah shukor ha ka jaka ba ai.

method.en: No oil and no heat at any point. The lemon juice is the whole preservative and it works only if the jar is dry and the ginger is dry.
method.l: Ym don ka tyrso um bad ka jingbakhraw hangno hangno. Ka um soh niamtra ka dei ka jingbat baroh, bad ka trei tang lada ka jar ka long basngai bad ka sying ka long basngai.

method.en: Leave it a week in the sun before it goes to the counter. On the day it is made it is ginger and salt; the week is when it becomes an achar.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka shi taiew ha ka sngi shaphang ba ka leit sha ka jaka ba ai. Ha ka sngi ba la pynlong ka long tang ka sying bad ka mluh; ka taiew ka dei kaba ka long ka achar.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a kilo, and it is the one thing on a heavy Khasi leaf that will settle a stomach after a tungrymbai.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha ka kilo, bad ka dei ka shi kajuh halor ka sla Khasi bajrong kaba pynsuk ia ka kpoh ynda ka tungrymbai.

recipes.name: Sohbrap ka Jam
recipes.sub: Passion fruit pulp cooked down with sugar to a set
recipes.sub_l: Ka doh sohbrap ba la shet bad ka chini haduh ba ka bat

method.en: Keep half the seeds and strain the rest out. Seedless, a sohbrap jam looks like a bought one; all the seeds and it cannot be spread.
method.l: Pynsah shynna ki symbai bad sait noh ki bapher. Ym bad ki symbai, ka jam sohbrap ka khmih kum kaba la thied; bad ki symbai baroh ka ym lah ban pra.

method.en: Test it on a cold plate every four minutes near the end. A sohbrap jam goes from loose to hard in ninety seconds and there is no warning.
method.l: Pyndonkam ia ka halor ka plet basyllok ha ka saw minit baroh haba kloi ban dep. Ka jam sohbrap ka kylla na bapra sha bajrong ha khyndai phew second, bad ym don ka jingsneng.

method.en: Lemon in the last minute. It is what stops five kilos of sugar crystallising in the jar by the second month.
method.l: Ka soh niamtra ha ka minit baneh. Kata ka dei kaba pynthang ia ki san kilo chini na kaba long kum ka mawsiang ha ka jar ha ka bnai banar.

method.en: Fill the jars hot and close them hot. A jam cooled in the pan and then jarred grows a skin on the top within a fortnight.
method.l: Pyndap ia ki jar bakhraw bad khang ia ki bakhraw. Ka jam kaba la pynsyllok ha ka blang bad ynda la buh ha ka jar ka mih ka snier halor ha ar taiew.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a kilo of jam and it keeps a year. Sohbrap grows over every Ri Bhoi fence and eight kilos costs the picking.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha ka kilo jam, bad ka sah shi snem. Ki sohbrap ki mih halor ka jingkhang Ri Bhoi baroh, bad ki phra kilo ki dam tang ka jingkhied.

recipes.name: Jhur Tyrso ka Achar
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf and stalk salted down in a jar for a fortnight
recipes.sub_l: Ka sla bad ka mrad tyrso ba la buh ha ka mluh ha ka jar ar taiew

method.en: Wilt the leaves a full day in the sun before they go in the jar. A fresh leaf in salt ferments in three days and the jar swells.
method.l: Pynduna ia ki sla shi sngi ha ka sngi shaphang ba ki dep ha ka jar. Ka sla bathymmai ha ka mluh ka pyllait ha lai sngi, bad ka jar ka heh.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it is the part that keeps its bite for a fortnight.
method.l: Ot ia ka mrad lang bad ym dei ban shah bred noh. Ka mrad ka dei ka lai bynta jong ka jingjrong, bad ka dei ka bynta kaba bat ia ka jingkrai ar taiew.

method.en: Press it down with a stone so the brine covers it. Any leaf above the brine grows a white skin and the whole jar has to be thrown.
method.l: Nam ia ka harud u mawlain khnang ba ka um mluh ka khap ia ka. Ka sla hangno hangno halor ka um mluh ka mih ka snier basaw, bad ka jar baroh ka dei ban shah bred noh.

method.en: Eat it within a fortnight. This is not a year achar; the leaf goes soft after two weeks and the jar smells of it.
method.l: Bam ia ka ha ar taiew. Kane kam dei ka achar shi snem; ka sla ka long baduna ynda ar taiew, bad ka jar ka sngi kum ka.

recipes.why: Eight rupees a kilo, the cheapest jar on this shelf. In Lber the tyrso is fifteen rupees a kilo and seven kilos is a fortnight of achar.
recipes.why_l: Phra tyngka ha ka kilo, ka jar kaba khyndiat dam tam halor kane ka jaka. Ha u Lber ka tyrso ka long 15 tyngka ka kilo, bad ki hynniew kilo ki long ar taiew achar.

recipes.name: Kadhi Shynrai
recipes.sub: Curd and gram flour cooked slow, orange with Lakadong
recipes.sub_l: Ka dud bad ka badup rymbai bathung sngur, ba saw da ka Lakadong

method.en: Whisk the gram flour into the cold curd with no water until not one lump is left.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka badup rymbai hapoh ka dud basyiar khlem um haduh ba ym sah shi tylli badup jam.

method.en: Add the water only after it is smooth. Flour dropped into liquid lumps for good.
method.l: Buh ïa ka um tang hadien ba ka long bajem. Ka badup babuh ha ka um ka jam bad ka ym wan biang.

method.en: Bring it up stirring in one direction and leave it uncovered until it has boiled once.
method.l: Pynkhlaw bad pyllun sha shi lynti bad ai ïa ka khlem khang haduh ba ka khlaw shi sien.

method.en: A covered kadhi splits on the way up and no stirring joins it again.
method.l: Ka kadhi bakhang ka ïai ha ba ka shyiap bad ym don jingpyllun ban pynkhih ïa ka biang.

method.en: Simmer forty minutes until it coats the back of a ladle.
method.l: Pynkhlaw sngur saw phew minit haduh ba ka ïai ha ka khlieh jong ka kiew.

method.en: Temper chilli and ginger in ghee and pour it over at the counter, not in the kitchen.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sohmynken bad ka sying ha ka ghee bad kynshew halor ha ka counter, ym ha ka iing thung.

recipes.why: Lakadong at this rate turns a plains dish into a Meghalaya one, and the colour tells a hall what it is before it is tasted. It also improves overnight, so it can be cooked the evening before a large day.
recipes.why_l: Ka Lakadong ha kane ka jingshong ka pynkylla ïa ka jingbam madan ban long ka jong ka Meghalaya, bad ka rong ka ong ïa ka iing shuwa ba kylli. Ka bha khan ruh hadien shi miet, kumta ka lah thung ha ka miet shuwa jong ka sngi bakhraw.

recipes.name: Dud bad Soh Kaji
recipes.name_l: Ka Dud bad ka Soh Kaji
recipes.sub: Cucumber drained and set in beaten curd with roasted sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ka soh kaji baduh um ha ka dud bapyllun bad ka nei basyied

method.en: Peel and seed the cucumber, dice it, and drain it in a colander fifteen minutes.
method.l: Kih bad kyllon noh ïa ki symbai na ka soh kaji, ot ïa ka, bad pynduh um shi phew san minit.

method.en: Beat the curd smooth and salt it before anything solid goes in.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka dud haduh ba ka long bajem bad buh mluh shuwa ba buh ei ei baeh.

method.en: Salting the finished tray drags water out of the cucumber within ten minutes.
method.l: Lada buh mluh ha ka tray bakut, ka um ka mih na ka soh kaji ha shi phew minit.

method.en: Fold the cucumber in and scatter the ground sesame over the top.
method.l: Buh ïa ka soh kaji hapoh bad kynshew ïa ka nei badup halor.

method.en: Keep it below 10°C until it goes out, and make it within two hours of serving.
method.l: Buh ïa ka hapoh 10°C haduh ba ka leit, bad pynlong ïa ka hapoh ar por ba ai bam.

recipes.why: Against a chilli chutney and a plate of pumaloi this is the only cooling thing on the tray. Sesame rather than cumin, because sesame is what a Khasi tongue expects in curd.
recipes.why_l: Ha ka ding kaba don ka chutney sohmynken bad ka pumaloi, kane marwei ka pynsyiar. Ka nei, ym ka jeera, naba ka nei ka dei kaba ka thylliej Khasi ka ap ha ka dud.

recipes.name: Dud bad Jhur Tyrso
recipes.name_l: Ka Dud bad ka Jhur Tyrso
recipes.sub: Blanched local greens chopped fine and folded through curd
recipes.sub_l: Ka jhur tyrso bakhlaw lyngkot, baot lyngkot bad babuh ha ka dud

method.en: Drop the greens into boiling water for ninety seconds only, then into cold water.
method.l: Buh ïa ka jhur ha ka um bakhlaw tang khyndai phew second, nangta sha ka um basyiar.

method.en: The cold water is what keeps them green; without it the tray is the colour of hay.
method.l: Ka um basyiar ka dei kaba pyllait ïa ka rong bathang; khlem ka, ka tray ka long kum ka phlang basngai.

method.en: Squeeze them dry in a cloth and chop them as fine as the knife will go.
method.l: Dup ïa ki ha ka jaiñ haduh ba ki sngai bad ot lyngkot kum ba ka waitlam ka lah.

method.en: Beat the curd with the salt, then fold the greens, chilli and ginger through it.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka dud bad ka mluh, nangta buh ïa ka jhur, ka sohmynken bad ka sying hapoh.

method.en: Sesame on top at the counter so it is still loud when it is eaten.
method.l: Ka nei halor ha ka counter ban ka dang riam ha ba bam.

recipes.why: Tyrso is on every Khasi terrace through the cold months and costs almost nothing. Blanched rather than raw, it is the one green a hundred people will eat in curd without complaint.
recipes.why_l: Ka tyrso ka don ha baroh ki lyngkha Khasi lyngba ki bnai basyiar bad ka dam ka long khyndiat eh. Lada pynkhlaw lyngkot, ym bam bathymmai, kane ka dei ka jhur marwei kaba shi spah ngut ki bam ha ka dud khlem jingpyrshang.

recipes.name: Kadhi Pakora
recipes.sub: Gram flour pakora dropped into a sour curd kadhi at the counter
recipes.sub_l: Ki pakora badup chana ba la buh ha ka kadhi dud basngewthiang

method.en: The curd should be a day old and sour. Fresh curd gives a kadhi that tastes of besan and of nothing else, and the sourness is the whole dish.
method.l: Ka dud ka dei ban long shi sngi bad basngewthiang. Ka dud bathymmai ka ai ka kadhi kaba sngew tang kum ka badup chana, bad ka jingsngewthiang ka dei ka jingbam baroh.

method.en: Whisk the besan into cold curd and get every lump out before any heat. A lump that reaches hot kadhi never breaks up again.
method.l: Kylla ia ka badup chana ha ka dud basyllok bad rah noh ka jingbat baroh shaphang ba don ka jingbakhraw. Ka jingbat kaba poi sha ka kadhi bakhraw kan ym pat shuh.

method.en: Boil it a full forty minutes before the pakora go in. A kadhi cooked twenty minutes tastes raw however good the curd was.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka saw phew minit babiang shaphang ba ki pakora ki dep. Ka kadhi ba la shet ar phew minit ka sngew baiar, la ka dud ka la long babha kumno ruh.

method.en: Drop the pakora in ten minutes before serving and no earlier. An hour in the kadhi and they are paste and the vessel is a besan soup.
method.l: Buh ki pakora khadar minit shaphang ba ai, ym bathuh. Shi por ha ka kadhi bad ki long ka jingnam, bad ka blang ka long ka soup badup chana.

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees a head. The plain kadhi on this shelf is the everyday one; this is the Shad Suk Mynsiem version and worth the extra six rupees.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew shi tyngka ha u briew. Ka kadhi basngai halor kane ka jaka ka dei ka jong ka sngi baroh; kane ka dei ka jong ka Shad Suk Mynsiem, bad ka biang ia ki hynriew tyngka bajrong.

recipes.name: Dud bad Bandakobi
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded raw into curd with roasted cumin
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi baiar ba la ot sha ka dud bad ka jeera baem

method.en: Shred the bandakobi fine, to the size of a matchstick. A chopped cabbage in curd is chunks and half the bowl comes back.
method.l: Ot ia ka bandakobi bariw, haduh ka jingheh ka symbai. Ka bandakobi ba la ot bajrong ha ka dud ka long ki jingot bakhraw, bad shynna ka kchu ka phai.

method.en: Whisk the curd with the water first and get it smooth before the cabbage goes in. Lumps of curd will not break once there is anything solid in the vessel.
method.l: Kylla ia ka dud bad ka um shaphang bad pynlong ia ka baduna shaphang ba ka bandakobi ka dep. Ki jingbat dud ki ym pat haba don kaei kaei bajrong ha ka blang.

method.en: Roast the cumin dry and crush it coarse, do not use a powder. A raita is a plain thing and the cumin is the only interest it has.
method.l: Em ia ka jeera basngai bad nam bajrong, ym pyndonkam ka badup. Ka raita ka long ka jingbam basngai, bad ka jeera tang ka dei ka jingsngewbha jong ka.

method.en: Mix the cabbage in at the counter and not in the kitchen. Cabbage in curd for an hour smells through the hall and the smell is why people leave a raita.
method.l: Kylla ia ka bandakobi ha ka jaka ba ai, ym ha ka rukom shet. Ka bandakobi ha ka dud shi por ka sngi lyngba ka iing, bad kata ka jingsngi ka dei ka daw ba ki briew ki pynsah ia ka raita.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head and no fire under it. Bandakobi keeps ten days in a Shillong store room where a green leaf keeps two.
recipes.why_l: Khadlai tyngka ha u briew, bad ym don ka ding harud ka. Ka bandakobi ka sah khadshiphew sngi ha ka dep Shillong ha kaba ka sla bathiang ka sah ar.

recipes.name: Dud bad Phan
recipes.sub: Potato boiled, broken by hand and folded into thin curd
recipes.sub_l: Ki phan bapyndih, la pynkhih da ka kti bad la kup sha ka dud bariw

method.en: Boil the phan in the skin and break it by hand. A knife-cut potato in curd keeps its edges and the raita never takes hold of it.
method.l: Pyndih ia ki phan bad ka snier bad pynkhih ia ki da ka kti. Ka phan ba la ot da u wait ha ka dud ka bat ia ki snier jong ka, bad ka raita kan ym pdiang ia ka.

method.en: Let it go completely cold before it meets the curd. Warm potato splits ten kilos of curd before the vessel reaches the counter.
method.l: Shah ia ka ban long basyllok babiang shaphang ba ka ïatiew bad ka dud. Ka phan bakhraw ka pynpat ia ki 10 kilo dud shaphang ba ka blang ka poi sha ka jaka ba ai.

method.en: Black salt as well as salt. A potato raita without black salt tastes of nothing and twenty litres comes back half eaten.
method.l: Ka mluh iong lang bad ka mluh. Ka raita phan ba ym don ka mluh iong ka sngew ym kaei kaei, bad ki 20 litar ki phai shynna bam.

method.en: Keep it shallow and cold. A deep vessel of raita warms from the middle out and sours before the line has passed.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw bad basyllok. Ka blang raita bajrong ka bakhraw na ka dohnud shabar, bad ka sngewthiang shaphang ba ka lynti briew ka pyrshah.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head. Phan is in a Shillong store room every month of the year and this is the raita for a Nohprah day when there is nothing fresh to grate.
recipes.why_l: Khadlai tyngka ha u briew. Ki phan ki don ha ka dep Shillong ha ka bnai baroh jong ka snem, bad kane ka dei ka raita na ka sngi u Nohprah haba ym don kaei bathymmai ban khriah.

recipes.name: Dud bad Pathaw
recipes.sub: Pumpkin steamed, cooled and folded through salted curd
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw bastem, la pynsyllok bad la kup sha ka dud bad ka mluh

method.en: Steam the pathaw and do not boil it. Boiled, five kilos drinks a litre of water and the raita is thin whatever is done to it.
method.l: Stem ia ka pathaw, ym dei ban pyndih ia ka. Haba la pyndih, ki san kilo ki dih shi litar um, bad ka raita ka long bariw la la leh kaei kaei ia ka.

method.en: Cut it in cubes and steam them apart from each other. Piled in the steamer they crush under their own weight and there is nothing to find on the plate.
method.l: Ot ia ka ha ki jingot bad stem ia ki bapher pher. Haba la pynsun ha ka blang stem ki nam lade da ka jingjrong jong ki, bad ym don kaei ban shem halor ka plet.

method.en: Let it go completely cold. Warm pathaw splits ten kilos of curd faster than a warm potato does.
method.l: Shah ia ka ban long basyllok babiang. Ka pathaw bakhraw ka pynpat ia ki 10 kilo dud bakhih ban ka phan bakhraw.

method.en: A pinch of black salt against the sweetness. A pathaw raita without it tastes like a sweet dish that came to the wrong end of the counter.
method.l: Ka mluh iong khyndiat pyrshah ka jingsngai. Ka raita pathaw ba ym don ka ka sngew kum ka jingbam basngai kaba la poi sha ka bneng bapher jong ka jaka ba ai.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. In Risaw the pathaw costs the carrying and this is the raita a kitchen makes when the cabbage has run out.
recipes.why_l: Khadar tyngka ha u briew. Ha u Risaw ka pathaw ka dam tang ka jingbah, bad kane ka dei ka raita kaba ka rukom shet ka pynlong haba ka bandakobi ka la dep.

recipes.name: Kadhi Rymbai
recipes.sub: Sour curd kadhi with soft beans cooked into it
recipes.sub_l: Ka kadhi dud basngewthiang bad ki rymbai baduna ba la shet ha ka

method.en: Cook the rymbai separately and add it soft. A raw bean in a kadhi will not cook at all; the sourness stops it and two hours changes nothing.
method.l: Shet ia ki rymbai bapher bad buh ia ki baduna. Ka rymbai baiar ha ka kadhi kan ym shet ei ei; ka jingsngewthiang ka pynthang ia ka, bad ar por kin ym kylla ei ei.

method.en: Half the besan a plain kadhi takes. The beans thicken twenty-six litres on their own and the full weight of besan makes a paste.
method.l: Shynna ka badup chana ba ka kadhi basngai ka lam. Ki rymbai ki pynlong ia ki 26 litar bajrong da ki lade, bad ka jingjrong baroh jong ka badup chana ka pynlong ia ka jingnam.

method.en: Stir in one direction until it comes to the boil, then leave it. A kadhi splits in the first four minutes or not at all.
method.l: Kylla ia ka sha shi liang haduh ba ka pyndih, ynda pynsah ia ka. Ka kadhi ka pat ha ki saw minit banyngkong, ym pat ei ei.

method.en: Salt after the boil and not before. Salted curd on the way up splits eight kilos before the vessel is warm.
method.l: Buh ka mluh ynda ka pyndih, ym shaphang. Ka dud bad ka mluh haba ka kyllon ka pat ia ki phra kilo shaphang ba ka blang ka long bakhraw.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head, and it is a dal and a kadhi in one vessel. On a day the kitchen is short of pots this is what goes on the board.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha u briew, bad ka long ka dal bad ka kadhi ha shi blang. Ha ka sngi ba ka rukom shet ka duna ki blang, kane ka dei kaba dep halor ka phlang thoh.

recipes.name: Khichdi Shynrai
recipes.sub: Rice and moong cooked down together, deep orange with Lakadong
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja bad ka moong bathung lang, ba saw eh da ka Lakadong

method.en: Dry-roast the moong until it smells of nuts, then wash it with the rice.
method.l: Syied ïa ka moong ba khlem tulsi haduh ba ka rngi bha, nangta sait lang bad ka ja.

method.en: Put the turmeric in with the water at the start and not at the end.
method.l: Buh ïa ka shynrai lang bad ka um ha ka sdang, ym ha kaba kut.

method.en: Lakadong stirred in late tastes raw and sits on the tongue like chalk.
method.l: Ka Lakadong babuh lyngkot ka rngi bathymmai bad ka shong ha ka thylliej kum ka maw.

method.en: Boil uncovered fifteen minutes, then cover and hold it low for fifteen more.
method.l: Pynkhlaw khlem khang shi phew san minit, nangta khang bad ai ïa ka ha ka ding bakhyndiat shi phew san minit.

method.en: Temper ginger and chilli in ghee and stir it through at the end.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sying bad ka sohmynken ha ka ghee bad sumar hapoh ha kaba kut.

method.en: Keep it looser than it looks right; rice drinks water for ten minutes after the fire is off.
method.l: Ai ïa ka ba jem khan na kaba pyni bha; ka ja ka dih um shi phew minit hadien ba ka ding ka jah.

recipes.why: One pot, one fire, ninety minutes from sack to plate. It is also the plainest way to put Lakadong in front of a hundred people, which is what this state would want them to taste.
recipes.why_l: Shi tylli khiew, shi tylli ding, khyndai phew minit na ka bori sha ka ding. Kane ruh ka long ka lynti bakhuid tam ban buh ïa ka Lakadong hakhmat shi spah ngut, kaba kane ka ri ka kwah ba ki kylli.

recipes.name: Khichdi Rymbai
recipes.sub: Rice with the local bean, thick enough to hold its shape
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja bad ka rymbai jong ka ri, bakhraw ban kem ïa ka rukom jong ka

method.en: Soak the beans overnight and boil them alone until they are nearly soft.
method.l: Sait ïa ki rymbai shi miet bad pynkhlaw ïa ki ba lang haduh ba ki shu jem.

method.en: Beans started with the rice give a pot of split skins over mush.
method.l: Ki rymbai baba sdang lang bad ka ja ki ai shi khiew snieh baïai halor ka badup.

method.en: Fry tomato, ginger and turmeric in the ghee, then add the drained beans.
method.l: Syied ïa ka soh khlaw, ka sying bad ka shynrai ha ka ghee, nangta buh ïa ki rymbai baduh um.

method.en: Add the washed rice and the boiling water over both.
method.l: Buh ïa ka ja basait bad ka um bakhlaw halor ki ar.

method.en: Rest it ten minutes off the fire before it is stirred, or the grain breaks.
method.l: Ai ïa ka shi phew minit hadien ba pynsngiah na ka ding shuwa ba pyllun, lada em ka symbai ka brop.

recipes.why: Rymbai is what a Khasi field grows between the maize, and this khichdi holds on a plate rather than running. That is what a sitting pangat needs and what a wet khichdi never gives.
recipes.why_l: Ka rymbai ka dei kaba bit ha ka lyngkha Khasi hapdeng ka riewbah, bad kane ka khichdi ka kem ha ka ding, ka ym tuid. Kata ka dei kaba donkam ka pangat babiang bad kaba ka khichdi baum ka ym shym ai.

recipes.name: Khichdi Jhur
recipes.sub: Moong khichdi carrying whatever the hill sent that week
recipes.sub_l: Ka khichdi moong kaba bah ïa kaba ka lum ka phah ha kata ka taiew

method.en: Sort the vegetables into hard and soft before the fire is lit.
method.l: Bret ïa ki jhur ha kiba eh bad kiba jem shuwa ba pynding.

method.en: Roast the moong dry, wash it with the rice, and boil both with the turmeric.
method.l: Syied ïa ka moong ba khlem tulsi, sait lang bad ka ja, bad pynkhlaw baroh bad ka shynrai.

method.en: Put the hard vegetables in at ten minutes and the soft ones at twenty.
method.l: Buh ïa ki jhur baeh ha ka shi phew minit bad kiba jem ha ka shi phew minit ar.

method.en: All in at once and the pot is green paste before the rice is done.
method.l: Lada buh baroh lang, ka khiew ka long badup bathang shuwa ba ka ja ka thung.

method.en: Temper ginger in ghee and stir it in at the end.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sying ha ka ghee bad sumar hapoh ha kaba kut.

recipes.why: The dish that clears the vegetable store on a Monday, and the one page here with no fixed list. It is what to cook when the Shillong truck has come late and the menu has to move.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam kaba pynkhuid ïa ka iing jhur ha ka Sngi Lyngkot, bad ka kot marwei kaba ym don ka thoh babit. Kane ka dei kaba thung lada ka lorry Shillong ka wan lyngkot bad ka menu ka dei ban kylla.

recipes.name: Khichdi Nei
recipes.sub: Rice and moong cooked soft and finished with roasted sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja bad ka moong ba la shet baduna bad la pyndep bad ka nei baem

method.en: Four parts water to one of grain and let it go soft. This is not a pulao; a khichdi with separate grains has failed at what it was for.
method.l: Saw bynta um ha shi bynta ja, bad shah ia ka ban long baduna. Kane kam dei ka pulao; ka khichdi bad ki symbai bapher pher ka la duh ia ka daw jong ka.

method.en: Roast the nei until the seeds jump and crush it coarse. A powdered nei disappears into thirty-eight kilos and nothing is tasted.
method.l: Em ia ka nei haduh ba ki symbai ki iar bad nam bajrong. Ka nei babadup ka duh ha ki 38 kilo bad ym don kaei kaba sngew.

method.en: The nei goes in with the fire off. Boiled in the vessel for twenty minutes a kilo of sesame gives up its oil and tastes of nothing.
method.l: Ka nei ka dep haba la pynjot ia ka ding. Haba la pyndih ha ka blang ar phew minit, ka shi kilo nei ka ai noh ka tyrso um jong ka bad ka sngew ym kaei kaei.

method.en: Raw mustard oil over each plate at the counter. In a Khasi khichdi that spoon of uncooked oil is what a ghee would be elsewhere.
method.l: Ka tyrso um baiar halor ka plet baroh ha ka jaka ba ai. Ha ka khichdi Khasi kata ka spun tyrso um baiar ka dei kaba ka ghee ka long ha ki jaka bapher.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head, one vessel and one cook. A kilo of nei gives thirty-eight kilos of khichdi the fat it needs without a rupee of ghee.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew tyngka ha u briew, shi blang bad shi nongshet. Ka shi kilo nei ka ai ia ki 38 kilo khichdi ka jingtyrso ba ka donkam ym bad ka shi tyngka ghee.

recipes.name: Khichdi Pathaw
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked into the khichdi until it thickens it
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la shet sha ka khichdi haduh ba ka pynlong ia ka bajrong

method.en: Cut the pathaw large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and forty kilos is orange with nothing to find in it.
method.l: Ot ia ka pathaw bakhraw, shi inch shi liang. Ki jingot barit ki duh, bad ki 40 kilo ki long basaw bad ym don kaei ban shem ha ki.

method.en: The pathaw goes in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: Ka pathaw ka dep haba ka ja ka la shet shynna. Na kaba sdang ka duh; ha kaba dep ka long baiar ha ka dohnud.

method.en: The pathaw is what thickens this khichdi and no flour is needed. Six kilos in forty is the whole measure.
method.l: Ka pathaw ka dei kaba pynlong ia kane ka khichdi bajrong, bad ym donkam ia ka badup. Ki hynriew kilo ha ki 40 ki dei ka jingbishar baroh.

method.en: Keep it looser than it should be. Pathaw drinks for twenty minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a solid in the hall.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw shuh ban ka dei. Ka pathaw ka dih ar phew minit ynda la pynjot ia ka ding, bad kaba beit ha ka rukom shet ka long bajrong ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head. Six kilos of pathaw takes the place of a kilo of dal and in Risaw it costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Khadphra tyngka ha u briew. Ki hynriew kilo pathaw ki dep ha ka jaka ka shi kilo dal, bad ha u Risaw ki dam tang ka jingbah.

recipes.name: Khichdi Masoor
recipes.sub: Whole masoor cooked with rice until the skins split
recipes.sub_l: Ka masoor baroh ba la shet bad ka ja haduh ba ki snier ki pat

method.en: Soak the masoor two hours. The whole lentil has a skin and an unsoaked one is still a bead when the rice has gone to paste.
method.l: Buh ia ka masoor ha ka um ar por. Ka masoor baroh ka don ka snier, bad kaba ym la buh ka long dang kum ka symbai haba ka ja ka la long ka jingnam.

method.en: Cook the masoor twenty minutes before the rice goes in. Started together, this is a khichdi with hard lentils and broken rice in the same spoon.
method.l: Shet ia ka masoor ar phew minit shaphang ba ka ja ka dep. Haba la sdang lang, kane ka long ka khichdi bad ki masoor bajrong bad ka ja bapat ha ka spun kajuh.

method.en: Tomato in the last ten minutes only. Cooked from the start it goes to a paste and the khichdi has a sour taste nobody can place.
method.l: Ka jaiur ha ki khadar minit baneh tang. Haba la shet na kaba sdang ka long ka jingnam, bad ka khichdi ka don ka jingsngewthiang kaba ym don uno uno ban tip.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Masoor drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and comes to the counter right.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka bariw shuh ban ka dei. Ka masoor ka dih ar phew minit ha ka blang bad ka poi sha ka jaka ba ai babeit.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head, and masoor is the cheapest whole pulse at Iewduh eight months of the year. It cooks in half the time a rymbai takes.
recipes.why_l: Khadkhyndai tyngka ha u briew, bad ka masoor ka dei ka jingbam baroh kaba khyndiat dam tam ha Iewduh phra bnai jong ka snem. Ka shet ha shynna ka por ba ka rymbai ka lam.

recipes.name: Khichdi Sohphlang
recipes.sub: Sohphlang cut in raw at the end so it keeps its crunch
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohphlang ba la ot baiar ha kaba dep khnang ba ka bat ka jingkrai

method.en: The sohphlang goes in raw with the fire off. Cooked twenty minutes it is a soft white thing in a yellow khichdi and four kilos are wasted.
method.l: Ka sohphlang ka dep baiar haba la pynjot ia ka ding. Haba la shet ar phew minit ka long tang ka jingbam baduna basaw ha ka khichdi bastem, bad ki saw kilo ki duh.

method.en: Peel it with the fingers and not a knife. The skin comes away in one piece if it is fresh and a knife takes the flesh with it.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka da ki kti, ym da u wait. Ka snier ka mih shi jingot lada ka long bathymmai, bad u wait u rah noh ia ka doh lang bad u.

method.en: Cut it in matchsticks and not rounds. A round of sohphlang cannot be found in thirty-eight kilos of khichdi and a matchstick can.
method.l: Ot ia ka bariw kum ki symbai, ym kum ki jingot babiang. Ka jingot sohphlang babiang ka ym shah shem ha ki 38 kilo khichdi, bad kaba bariw ka shah.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the counter. Sesame boiled in a khichdi for twenty minutes tastes of nothing at all.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Ka nei ba la pyndih ha ka khichdi ar phew minit ka sngew ym kaei kaei.

recipes.why: Twenty-five rupees a head. Sohphlang is dug on the Khasi slopes and sold at Iewduh in Nohprah, and this is the khichdi a Khasi guest names as the one thing from home.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew san tyngka ha u briew. Ka sohphlang ka shah kynshew ha ki lum Khasi bad ka shah die ha Iewduh ha u Nohprah, bad kane ka dei ka khichdi kaba u nongwan Khasi u kyrteng kum ka shi kajuh na ka iing.

recipes.name: Khichdi Tungrymbai
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean folded into the khichdi off the fire
recipes.sub_l: Ka tungrymbai ba la kup sha ka khichdi na ka ding

method.en: The tungrymbai goes in with the fire off. Boiled twenty minutes it loses the smell it is bought for and becomes an ordinary bean.
method.l: Ka tungrymbai ka dep haba la pynjot ia ka ding. Haba la pyndih ar phew minit ka duh ia ka jingsngi ba la thied na ka bynta ka, bad ka long tang ka rymbai basngai.

method.en: Crush half and leave half whole. The crushed half carries through thirty-eight kilos and the whole half is what a Khasi looks for on the plate.
method.l: Nam ia shynna bad pynsah shynna baroh. Ka shynna banam ka poi lyngba ki 38 kilo, bad ka shynna baroh ka dei kaba u Khasi u wad halor ka plet.

method.en: Cook the khichdi uncovered from the moment the tungrymbai goes in. Under a lid two kilos of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Shet ia ka khichdi ba la khang ym na ka por ba ka tungrymbai ka dep. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ki ar kilo jong ka kin pynlotho ia ka iing.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A tungrymbai is salted in the jar and two hundred grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Sngew shaphang ba ka mluh ka dep. Ka tungrymbai ka don ka mluh ha ka jar, bad ki ar shiteph gram ki la long shuh ban kiba don ki jar ki kwah.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. Tungrymbai is the protein of a Khasi meal and two kilos gives a hundred people what a kilo of paneer would at four times the price.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Ka tungrymbai ka dei ka bha jong ka jingbam Khasi, bad ki ar kilo ki ai ia u shispah briew kaba ka shi kilo paneer kan ai ha saw sien ka dam.

recipes.name: Tungrymbai
recipes.sub: Soybean boiled and wrapped warm until it ferments and strings
recipes.sub_l: Ka rymbai bakhlaw babiang ha ka sla haduh ba ka muriaw bad ka tuid

ing.name: Banana or jackfruit leaf
ing.name_l: Sla kait lymne sla soh phan

method.en: Soak the soybean overnight and boil it until a bean crushes between finger and thumb.
method.l: Sait ïa ka rymbai shi miet bad pynkhlaw haduh ba shi tylli ka dup hapdeng ki kti.

method.en: Drain it well and crack it lightly in a wooden mortar while it is still hot.
method.l: Pynduh bha ïa ka um bad dup khyndiat ha ka thlong dieng ha ba dang shyiap.

method.en: Wrap it in leaves in packets of half a kilo and then in sacking.
method.l: Biang ïa ka ha ki sla ha ki pakit shi bynta ar kilo, nangta ha ka bori.

method.en: Keep it beside the hearth at blood heat for three days — cooler and nothing happens, hotter and it rots.
method.l: Buh ïa ka hakhmat ka ding lai sngi ha ka jingshyiap jong ka snam — basyiar bad ym don ei, bashyiap eh bad ka bylla.

method.en: It is ready when a pinch pulls a white thread and the smell is sharp, not foul.
method.l: Ka la biang lada shi chip ka tuid shi tylli thied balieh bad ka rngi ka tyngkai, ym ka bylla.

method.en: Sun-dry half of it on mats to keep six months; use the rest inside four days.
method.l: Pynsngai shi bynta ar ha ka sngi ban shong hynriew bnai; pyndonkam ïa ki kiwei hapoh saw sngi.

recipes.why: Tungrymbai is the Khasi kitchen's own protein and is normally cooked with pork, which is why the ferment itself has to be made here rather than bought ready-mixed. Eight kilos of bean gives seven of tungrymbai.
recipes.why_l: Ka tungrymbai ka dei ka protein jong ka iing thung Khasi bad ka thung tang bad ka doh sniang, kata ka daw ba ka jingmuriaw ka dei ban long hangne, ym ban thied na iewduh. Phra kilo rymbai ki ai hynniew kilo tungrymbai.

recipes.name: Shynrai Lakadong
recipes.sub: The Jaintia turmeric boiled, dried and ground at home
recipes.sub_l: Ka shynrai Jaintia bakhlaw, basngai bad badup ha iing

method.en: Take rhizomes lifted after the leaf has died back, from November onward.
method.l: Shim ïa ki tyllong baba pyrduh hadien ba ki sla ki la ïap, na November sha shuwa.

method.en: Boil them whole forty minutes until a straw goes through the thickest one.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ki baroh saw phew minit haduh ba ka phlang ka lah leit lyngba kaba khraw tam.

method.en: Boiling is what fixes the colour. Turmeric dried raw goes pale and streaked.
method.l: Ka jingkhlaw ka dei kaba pynshong ïa ka rong. Ka shynrai basngai bathymmai ka long ba lieh bad baïai.

method.en: Dry on mats in full sun ten to twelve days, bringing them in every evening.
method.l: Pynsngai ha ki jaiñ ha ka sngi shi phew haduh shi phew ar sngi, bad wallam hapoh man ka miet.

method.en: It is dry when a rhizome snaps clean instead of bending.
method.l: Ka la sngai lada shi tylli ka brop bha, ym ka kynjah.

method.en: Grind in half-kilo lots and store in glass away from the stove.
method.l: Dup ha ki bynta shi bynta ar kilo bad buh ha ka glass jngai na ka ding.

recipes.why: Lakadong is grown two hours from Shillong and carries the highest curcumin of any turmeric in the world, and buying it ground is how a kitchen ends up with cheap turmeric and a Lakadong label. Twenty kilos fresh gives three kilos of powder that will last the year.
recipes.why_l: Ka Lakadong ka bit ar por na Shillong bad ka don ka curcumin bakhraw tam ha pyrthei; lada thied ka badup, ka iing thung ka ïoh ka shynrai bakhyndiat dam bad ka kyrteng Lakadong tang. Shi phew ar kilo bathymmai ki ai lai kilo badup kiba shong shi snem.

recipes.name: Nei-iong Badup
recipes.sub: Black sesame roasted and ground, the powder six dishes stand on
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei-iong basyied badup, ka badup kaba hynriew jingbam ki ieng halor

method.en: Roast in one-kilo lots, never more. A full pan roasts unevenly and half of it burns.
method.l: Syied ha ki bynta shi kilo, ym bun khan. Ka tawa badap ka syied bym lang bad shi bynta ar ka tyllet.

method.en: Keep it moving the whole time on a low flame.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka lyngba ka por baroh ha ka ding bakhyndiat.

method.en: Take it off when it smells of oil and the seed jumps in the pan.
method.l: Pynsngiah lada ka rngi kum ka tulsi bad ka symbai ka lyngkot ha ka tawa.

method.en: Cool it fully before grinding, or the oil comes out and it cakes into a block.
method.l: Pynsyiar bha shuwa ba dup, lada em ka tulsi ka mih bad ka long shi tylli baeh.

method.en: Grind coarse, not fine. Fine black sesame turns to paste in the jar within a week.
method.l: Dup bakhraw, ym bajem. Ka nei-iong badup bajem ka long badup jam ha ka khiew hapoh shi taiew.

method.en: Store in glass. Six weeks is the useful life; after that it smells of old oil.
method.l: Buh ha ka glass. Hynriew taiew ka por ba bha; hadien kata ka rngi kum ka tulsi barim.

recipes.why: Six dishes in this book call for black sesame and grinding once a month costs a third of buying packets. It is also the only way to know there is nothing else in it.
recipes.why_l: Hynriew jingbam ha kane ka kot ki donkam ïa ka nei-iong bad lada dup shi sien ha shi bnai, ka dam ka long shi bynta lai jong ka jingthied packet. Kane ruh ka long ka lynti marwei ban tip ba ym don ei ei pat hapoh.

recipes.name: Sohmynken Badup
recipes.sub: Dry chilli ground coarse, the only heat a Khasi kitchen keeps
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohmynken basngai ba la kroh bajrong, ka shi jingsngewpoh jong ka rukom shet Khasi

method.en: Sun the chilli two days before it is ground. A chilli with any damp in it clogs the mill and the powder cakes in the tin within a week.
method.l: Buh ia ka sohmynken ha ka sngi ar sngi shaphang ba kroh. Ka sohmynken bad ka jingbaum ha ka ka bat ia ka mill, bad ka badup ka long bajrong ha ka tin ha shi taiew.

method.en: Take the stalks off and keep the seeds in. The seed is where the heat is and a seedless badup is a colouring and nothing more.
method.l: Rah noh ki mrad bad pynsah ki symbai. Ki symbai ki dei ka jaka ba ka jingsngewpoh ka don, bad ka badup ym bad ki symbai ka long tang ka jingpynrong.

method.en: Grind it coarse and never to a dust. A dust burns in the first second of a tempering; a coarse powder gives the kitchen eight seconds to work in.
method.l: Kroh bajrong, ym shym haduh ka mawsiang. Ka mawsiang ka duh ha ka second banyngkong jong ka jingem; ka badup bajrong ka ai ia ka rukom shet phra second ban trei.

method.en: Grind in the open and not in the kitchen. Three kilos of chilli in a mill clears a closed room of everyone in it inside a minute.
method.l: Kroh ha shabar, ym ha ka rukom shet. Ki lai kilo sohmynken ha ka mill ki pynlotho ia ka kamra bakhang na ki briew baroh ha shi minit.

recipes.why: Three hundred and ninety rupees a kilo and it lasts a Khasi kitchen three months. There is no garam masala in a Khasi dish; this powder and the nei are the whole spice shelf.
recipes.why_l: Lai shiteph khyndai phew tyngka ha ka kilo, bad ka sah lai bnai ha ka rukom shet Khasi. Ym don ka garam masala ha ka jingbam Khasi; kane ka badup bad ka nei ki dei ka jaka jingbuh baroh.

recipes.name: Sying Badup
recipes.sub: Ginger dried three days in the sun and milled fine
recipes.sub_l: Ka sying ba la pynsngai lai sngi ha ka sngi bad la kroh bariw

method.en: Slice it thin before it goes in the sun. A whole ginger takes eight days to dry in Shillong and it goes black on the fourth.
method.l: Ot ia ka bariw shaphang ba ka dep ha ka sngi. Ka sying baroh ka lam phra sngi ban long basngai ha Shillong, bad ka long baiong ha ka sngi basaw.

method.en: Three days in the sun and one night in a warm kitchen. A ginger that is not bone dry moulds in the tin within a fortnight.
method.l: Lai sngi ha ka sngi bad shi miet ha ka rukom shet bakhraw. Ka sying kaba ym long basngai babiang ka mih ka jingdup ha ka tin ha ar taiew.

method.en: Eight kilos of fresh ginger gives a kilo and a half of powder. A kitchen that does not know that buys eight and expects eight.
method.l: Ki phra kilo sying bathymmai ki ai ka shi kilo bad shynna badup. Ka rukom shet kaba ym tip kata ka thied phra bad ka ap phra.

method.en: Dry ginger is four times the strength of the fresh root. A hundred grams stands where four hundred of fresh would.
method.l: Ka sying basngai ka long saw sien ka bor jong ka sying bathymmai. Ka shiteph gram ka ïeng ha ka jaka ba ki saw shiteph gram bathymmai kin ïeng.

recipes.why: Six hundred and fifty rupees a kilo of powder, and it is what lets a Jain plate be cooked in the same kitchen on the same morning as everything else.
recipes.why_l: Hynriew shiteph san phew tyngka ha ka kilo badup, bad kata ka dei kaba shah shet ia ka plet Jain ha ka rukom shet kajuh ha ka step kajuh bad kaei kaei bapher.

recipes.name: Garam Masala
recipes.sub: The warm powder for the north Indian dishes on the same menu
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup bakhraw na ka bynta ki jingbam bri halor ka dienjat kajuh

method.en: Roast each spice on its own and not together. A clove is done in forty seconds and a coriander seed takes three minutes; roasted together, half the tin is burnt.
method.l: Em ia ka jingbuh shi tylli shi tylli, ym lang. U laung u dep ha saw phew second bad ka symbai dhania ka lam lai minit; haba la em lang, shynna ka tin ka duh.

method.en: Let every spice go completely cold before it is ground. Warm spice in a mill turns to an oily cake and no sieve takes it apart.
method.l: Shah ia ka jingbuh baroh ban long basyllok babiang shaphang ba kroh. Ka jingbuh bakhraw ha ka mill ka long ka jingbat batyrso, bad ym don ka jingsait ban pynpra ia ka.

method.en: Two kilos and no more at a time. Ground garam masala is at its best for six weeks and a bigger tin smells of dust by the third month.
method.l: Ar kilo tang ha shi sien, ym shuh. Ka garam masala ba la kroh ka long babha tam hynriew taiew, bad ka tin bakhraw shuh ka sngi kum ka mawsiang ha ka bnai balai.

method.en: Add it at the end of the cooking and not the start. A garam masala boiled twenty minutes has given up everything it had.
method.l: Buh ia ka ha kaba dep ka jingshet, ym ha kaba sdang. Ka garam masala ba la pyndih ar phew minit ka la ai noh baroh kaba ka don.

recipes.why: Seventeen hundred rupees a kilo and it lasts six weeks. Half the menu of a Shillong temple is now north Indian and there is no honest way round keeping this tin.
recipes.why_l: Shi hajar hynniew shiteph tyngka ha ka kilo, bad ka sah hynriew taiew. Shynna ka dienjat jong ka mandir Shillong ka long mynta ka jong ki bri, bad ym don ka lynti bashisha ban pynthang ia kane ka tin.

recipes.name: Dhania Badup
recipes.sub: Coriander seed roasted and milled alone, a tin every fortnight
recipes.sub_l: Ki symbai dhania ba la em bad la kroh marwei, shi tin ha ka ar taiew

method.en: Roast it on the lowest flame you can hold. Coriander burns from the inside and a seed that looks right can already be bitter.
method.l: Em ia ka halor ka ding kaba suk tam ba phi lah bat. Ka dhania ka duh na shapoh, bad ka symbai kaba khmih babeit ka lah long bakhaw shu mynta.

method.en: Ground alone and not in a garam masala. Three quarters of the coriander a temple kitchen uses goes into dishes that want no clove in them.
method.l: Kroh marwei, ym ha ka garam masala. Lai bynta na saw jong ka dhania ba ka rukom shet mandir ka pyndonkam ka dep sha ki jingbam kiba ym kwah u laung ha ki.

method.en: Mill it medium and sieve it once. The husk that comes off in the sieve is what floats on a gravy and looks like dust on the surface.
method.l: Kroh bahapdeng bad sait shi sien. Ka snier kaba mih ha ka jingsait ka dei kaba kyllon halor ka jhur baum bad ka khmih kum ka mawsiang halor.

method.en: Three kilos at a time and no more. A dhania badup is at its best for a fortnight and after a month it is a filler.
method.l: Lai kilo ha shi sien, ym shuh. Ka badup dhania ka long babha tam ar taiew, bad ynda shi bnai ka long tang ka jingpyndap.

recipes.why: Two hundred and forty rupees a kilo. Coriander is the one spice a Khasi kitchen uses by the kilo rather than the gram, and milling it in the house is half the price of the packet.
recipes.why_l: Ar shiteph saw phew tyngka ha ka kilo. Ka dhania ka dei ka shi jingbuh ba ka rukom shet Khasi ka pyndonkam da ka kilo ym da ka gram, bad kaba kroh ha ka iing ka long shynna ka dam jong ka packet.

recipes.name: Nei Badup
recipes.sub: White sesame roasted and crushed coarse for the day it is used
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei basaw ba la em bad la nam bajrong na ka sngi ba pyndonkam

method.en: Roast until the seeds jump and take it off at once. Sesame past that point is bitter and three kilos cannot be salvaged.
method.l: Em haduh ba ki symbai ki iar bad rah noh mynta. Ka nei ba palat kata ka sngewkhaw, bad ki lai kilo ki ym lah ban pynim biang.

method.en: Crush it and do not mill it. A milled nei gives up its oil in the machine and what reaches the tin is a dry cake.
method.l: Nam ia ka, ym dei ban kroh ia ka. Ka nei ba la kroh ka ai noh ka tyrso um jong ka ha ka mashin, bad kaba poi sha ka tin ka long ka jingbat basngai.

method.en: Crush it the day it is used and not before. A nei badup holds its oil three days and after that a Khasi dish tastes of nothing.
method.l: Nam ia ka ha ka sngi ba pyndonkam, ym shaphang. Ka badup nei ka bat ka tyrso um jong ka lai sngi, bad ynda kata ka jingbam Khasi ka sngew ym kaei kaei.

method.en: Keep it coarse enough to see the seed. A fine nei badup disappears into a vessel and the whole point of it is that it is felt.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bajrong biang ban shem ia ka symbai. Ka badup nei bariw ka duh ha ka blang, bad ka daw baroh jong ka ka dei ba ka shah sngew.

recipes.why: Three hundred and ninety rupees a kilo. Nei grows on the Jaintia slopes and this powder is what stands in a Khasi kitchen where a cashew or a cream would stand elsewhere.
recipes.why_l: Lai shiteph khyndai phew tyngka ha ka kilo. Ka nei ka mih ha ki lum Jaintia, bad kane ka badup ka dei kaba ïeng ha ka rukom shet Khasi ha ka jaka ba ka kaju ne ka cream kan ïeng ha ki jaka bapher.

recipes.name: Ja Stem
recipes.sub: The yellow rice of a Khasi feast, turmeric and ghee only
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja ba stem jong ka jingbam bakhraw Khasi, tang ka shynrai bad ka ghee

method.en: Wash the rice till the water runs clear, then soak it thirty minutes and drain it.
method.l: Sait ïa ka ja haduh ba ka um ka long bakhuid, nangta sait shi phew lai minit bad pynduh.

method.en: Bloom the turmeric in the hot ghee for twenty seconds before the rice goes in.
method.l: Buh ïa ka shynrai ha ka ghee bashyiap shi phew second shuwa ba buh ïa ka ja.

method.en: Turmeric put into water instead of fat gives a flat yellow and no smell at all.
method.l: Ka shynrai babuh ha ka um, ym ha ka tulsi, ka ai ka rong ba stem babym bha bad ym don rngi.

method.en: Fold the drained rice through the ghee with the ginger, bay and pepper.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka ja baduh um bad ka ghee, ka sying, ka tejpat bad ka sohmynken iong.

method.en: Add boiling water at one and a half to one, cover, and do not lift the lid for eighteen minutes.
method.l: Buh ïa ka um bakhlaw shi bad shi bynta ar sha shi, khang, bad wat plie ïa ka jingkhang shi phew phra minit.

method.en: Rest ten minutes and fork it through. Never stir rice with a ladle.
method.l: Ai ïa ka shi phew minit bad pyllun da ka kanta. Wat pyllun ïa ka ja da ka kiew shi tylli sien.

recipes.why: Ja stem is what a Khasi feast is built on and it is normally the plate that meat is put beside. On its own with a dal and a chutney it is a complete plate, and it costs ₹16 a head.
recipes.why_l: Ka ja stem ka dei kaba ieng halor ka jingbam bakhraw Khasi bad ka dei ka ding ba buh ïa ka doh ha ka lieng. Marwei bad ka dal bad ka chutney ka long ka ding babiang, bad ka dam ₹16 ha uwei u ngut.

recipes.name: Minil
recipes.sub: Garo sticky rice steamed in a leaf, eaten with the fingers
recipes.sub_l: Ka minil Garo bapynkhlaw ha ka sla, bam da ki kti

method.en: Soak the sticky rice six hours at least; overnight is better and it cannot be rushed.
method.l: Sait ïa ka ja minil hynriew por khan; shi miet ka bha khan bad ka ym lah pynlyngkot.

method.en: Drain it a full twenty minutes so no free water goes into the leaf.
method.l: Pynduh um shi phew minit baroh ban ym don um baba leit hapoh ka sla.

method.en: Pass the leaf over a flame for a second so it folds without splitting.
method.l: Pynkhia ïa ka sla halor ka ding shi second ban ka lah biang khlem ïai.

method.en: Fill each packet loosely; sticky rice swells and a tight packet bursts in the steamer.
method.l: Dap ïa man ka pakit ba jem; ka ja minil ka khraw bad ka pakit baeh ka brop ha ka steamer.

method.en: Steam forty minutes. It is never boiled in water at any point.
method.l: Pynkhlaw da ka lyer saw phew minit. Ka ym shym pynkhlaw ha ka um shi tylli por.

recipes.why: The Garo Hills eat minil where the Khasi hills eat plain rice, and it is the one rice here that can be carried in the hand to a field or a programme. It needs no plate and no spoon.
recipes.why_l: Ki Lum Garo ki bam minil ha ba ki lum Khasi ki bam ja, bad kane ka dei ka ja marwei kaba lah bah da ka kti sha ka lyngkha lymne sha ka kam. Ka ym donkam ding bad ym donkam kiew.

recipes.name: Ja Nei
recipes.sub: Plain rice finished with roasted black sesame and ghee
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja bakhuid bakut bad ka nei-iong basyied bad ka ghee

method.en: Cook the rice plain and spread it on trays to stop it cooking further.
method.l: Thung ïa ka ja bakhuid bad kynshew ïa ka ha ki tray ban ka ym thung shuh.

method.en: Warm the ground sesame in the ghee for thirty seconds only, off a high flame.
method.l: Pynshyiap ïa ka nei badup ha ka ghee tang lai phew second, jngai na ka ding bakhraw.

method.en: Sesame held longer than a minute turns bitter and thirty kilos cannot be saved.
method.l: Ka nei kaba shong slem khan na shi minit ka long ba khaw bad lai phew kilo ki ym lah pyllait.

method.en: Fold it through the warm rice with the chilli and salt, using a flat paddle.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka bad ka ja bashyiap, bad ka sohmynken bad ka mluh, da ka dieng bachep.

method.en: Serve within the hour. Cold, the sesame stiffens and the grain goes dry.
method.l: Ai bam hapoh shi por. Lada syiar, ka nei ka eh bad ka symbai ka sngai.

recipes.why: The cheapest way to make a plain pot of rice taste of this state rather than of anywhere. It is what to serve when the sabji is thin and the hall is large.
recipes.why_l: Ka lynti bakhyndiat dam tam ban pynlong ïa shi khiew ja bakhuid ban rngi kum kane ka ri, ym kum kawei pat ka jaka. Kane ka dei kaba ai bam lada ka jhur ka jem bad ka iing ka khraw.

recipes.name: Ja Sohphlang
recipes.sub: Plain rice turned through with raw sohphlang and sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja basngai ba la kylla bad ka sohphlang baiar bad ka nei

method.en: The sohphlang goes in raw and cold. Cooked, it loses the crunch it is put in for and four kilos of it is a soft white thing nobody can name.
method.l: Ka sohphlang ka dep baiar bad basyllok. Haba la shet ka duh ia ka jingkrai ba la buh ia ka na ka bynta ka, bad ki saw kilo ki long tang ka jingbam baduna basaw kaba ym don uno uno ban kyrteng.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual and let it go cold. Warm rice makes the sohphlang sweat and the whole vessel goes wet.
method.l: Shet ia ka ja basngai shuh ban ka rukom bad shah ia ka ban long basyllok. Ka ja bakhraw ka pynum ia ka sohphlang, bad ka blang baroh ka long baum.

method.en: Peel the sohphlang with the fingers and not a knife. The skin comes away in one piece if it is fresh and a knife takes the flesh with it.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka sohphlang da ki kti, ym da u wait. Ka snier ka mih shi jingot lada ka long bathymmai, bad u wait u rah noh ia ka doh lang bad u.

method.en: Turn it with two ladles and lift, do not stir. A rice stirred in a round breaks and thirty kilos is a paste with sohphlang in it.
method.l: Kylla ia ka da ki ar kailoi bad pynkhih halor, ym dei ban kylla ia ka babiang. Ka ja ba la kylla babiang ka pat, bad ki 30 kilo ki long ka jingnam bad ka sohphlang ha ka.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. Sohphlang is dug on the Khasi slopes and this is the rice a Khasi guest names before any other on the shelf.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Ka sohphlang ka shah kynshew ha ki lum Khasi, bad kane ka dei ka ja kaba u nongwan Khasi u kyrteng shaphang ka baroh bapher halor ka jaka.

recipes.name: Ja Tyrso
recipes.sub: Mustard leaf folded into the rice at the end so it stays green
recipes.sub_l: Ka jhur tyrso ba la kup sha ka ja ha kaba dep khnang ba ka sah bathiang

method.en: Chop the tyrso and keep it aside until the rice is done. Cooked from the start, five kilos of it turns thirty kilos the colour of a wet road.
method.l: Ot ia ka tyrso bad pynsah ia ka bapher haduh ba ka ja ka dep. Haba la shet na kaba sdang, ki san kilo ki pynlong ia ki 30 kilo sha ka rong ka lynti baum.

method.en: Fold it in with the fire off and put the lid on four minutes. The heat left in the vessel wilts it and nothing more is needed.
method.l: Kup ia ka haba la pynjot ia ka ding bad buh ka jingkhap saw minit. Ka jingbakhraw kaba sah ha ka blang ka pynduna ia ka, bad ym donkam kaei kaei shuh.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual. The tyrso gives up half a litre when it wilts and a rice already wet is a khichdi by accident.
method.l: Shet ia ka ja basngai shuh ban ka rukom. Ka tyrso ka ai shynna litar haba ka duna, bad ka ja kaba la long baum ka long ka khichdi ym da ka mon.

method.en: Serve within the half hour. Tyrso in a warm vessel goes from green to grey faster than any other leaf on this shelf.
method.l: Ai ia ka ha shynna por. Ka tyrso ha ka blang bakhraw ka kylla na bathiang sha barongkhraw bakhih ban ka sla baroh bapher halor kane ka jaka.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head. In Lber the tyrso is fifteen rupees a kilo at Iewduh and green on a plate in that month is worth putting on the board for its own sake.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynsan tyngka ha u briew. Ha u Lber ka tyrso ka long 15 tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh, bad ka jingthiang halor ka plet ha kata ka bnai ka biang ban dep halor ka phlang thoh na ka bynta ka lade.

recipes.name: Ja Pathaw
recipes.sub: Rice cooked with diced pumpkin so the grains take its colour
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja ba la shet bad ka pathaw ba la ot khnang ba ki symbai ki pdiang ka rong

method.en: Dice the pathaw large, an inch to the side. A small dice dissolves and thirty kilos of rice is orange with nothing in it.
method.l: Ot ia ka pathaw bakhraw, shi inch shi liang. Ki jingot barit ki duh, bad ki 30 kilo ja ki long basaw bad ym don kaei ha ki.

method.en: Put the pathaw in when the rice is half done. From the start it is gone; at the end it is raw in the middle.
method.l: Buh ia ka pathaw haba ka ja ka la shet shynna. Na kaba sdang ka duh; ha kaba dep ka long baiar ha ka dohnud.

method.en: Cook the rice drier than usual. A pathaw gives up water for twenty minutes after the fire is out and a wet vessel is a khichdi.
method.l: Shet ia ka ja basngai shuh ban ka rukom. Ka pathaw ka ai ka um ar phew minit ynda la pynjot ia ka ding, bad ka blang baum ka long ka khichdi.

method.en: No sugar of any kind. A Risaw pathaw is sweet enough to be mistaken for a sweet rice already.
method.l: Ym don ka chini jong ka rukom hangno hangno. Ka pathaw u Risaw ka long basngai biang ban shah pyrshah kum ka ja basngai shu mynta.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head, the cheapest rice in this book. In Risaw a Ri Bhoi field gives more pathaw than the kitchen can use and four kilos colours thirty.
recipes.why_l: Khadsaw tyngka ha u briew, ka ja kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot. Ha u Risaw ka rep Ri Bhoi ka ai ka pathaw ba bun ban kaba ka rukom shet ka lah pyndonkam, bad ki saw kilo ki pynrong ia ki 30.

recipes.name: Ja Dud
recipes.sub: Rice cooled and folded through with salted curd
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja ba la pynsyllok bad la kup bad ka dud bad ka mluh

method.en: The rice has to be completely cold. Warm rice in curd splits six kilos of it before the vessel reaches the hall.
method.l: Ka ja ka dei ban long basyllok babiang. Ka ja bakhraw ha ka dud ka pynpat ia ki hynriew kilo shaphang ba ka blang ka poi sha ka iing.

method.en: Cook the rice softer than usual and break the grain a little. A separate grain will not hold curd and the vessel goes watery at the bottom.
method.l: Shet ia ka ja baduna shuh ban ka rukom bad pynpat ia ka symbai khyndiat. Ka symbai bapher kan ym bat ia ka dud, bad ka blang ka long baum harud.

method.en: Fold it in an hour before the bell and no earlier. Curd in rice for three hours is a sour rice and nobody asked for one.
method.l: Kup ia ka shi por shaphang ba ka jingkhih, ym bathuh. Ka dud ha ka ja lai por ka long ka ja basngewthiang, bad ym don uno uno ba la kwah ia ka.

method.en: Keep a litre of curd back and stir it in at the counter. Rice drinks curd for an hour and the vessel that was right in the kitchen is dry in the hall.
method.l: Pynsah shi litar dud bad kylla ia ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Ka ja ka dih ia ka dud shi por, bad ka blang kaba la beit ha ka rukom shet ka long basngai ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Twenty-one rupees a head and no fire under it at the counter. On a Jymmang day when the hall is at thirty degrees it is the only rice a devotee finishes.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew shi tyngka ha u briew, bad ym don ka ding harud ka ha ka jaka ba ai. Ha ka sngi u Jymmang haba ka iing ka long 30 degri, kane tang ka dei ka ja kaba u nongbam u pynlait.

recipes.name: Ja Jhur
recipes.sub: Rice cooked in one vessel with the winter vegetables
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja ba la shet ha shi blang bad ki jhur ka ïatiew

method.en: Cut every vegetable to the size of a pea. Mixed sizes give a vessel where the carrot is hard and the cauliflower is gone.
method.l: Ot ia ka jhur baroh haduh ka jingheh ka matar. Ki jingheh bapher pher ki ai ka blang ha kaba ka gajor ka long bajrong bad ka phulkobi ka duh.

method.en: The peas go in with the fire off. Cooked from the start they are grey and thirty-two kilos of rice shows every one of them.
method.l: Ki matar ki dep haba la pynjot ia ka ding. Haba la shet na kaba sdang ki long barongkhraw, bad ki 32 kilo ja ki pynshem ia ki baroh.

method.en: One and a half measures of water to one of rice. Two is the plain rice ratio and it gives a vessel that sticks in the ladle.
method.l: Shi jingbishar bad shynna um ha shi jingbishar ja. Ar ki dei ka jingbishar ka ja basngai, bad ka ai ka blang kaba shet ha ka kailoi.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, twelve minutes, and nobody opens it. Every look costs the vessel two minutes of steam.
method.l: Na ka ding, buh ka jingkhap, khadar minit, bad ym don uno uno ba pynkhang ia ka. Ka jingkhmih baroh ka dam ia ka blang ar minit jingstem.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head, one vessel and one cook. On a Nohprah day when the Iewduh has the winter vegetables cheap, this feeds a hundred with no sabji beside it.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha u briew, shi blang bad shi nongshet. Ha ka sngi u Nohprah haba ka Iewduh ka don ki jhur ïatiew bakhyndiat dam, kane ka pynbam ia u shispah briew ym bad ka jhur hakhmat ka.

recipes.name: Ja ka Roti
recipes.sub: Rice flour roti made with boiling water, patted by hand
recipes.sub_l: Ka roti badup ja bapynlong bad ka um bakhlaw, bapyllet da ka kti

method.en: Pour boiling water onto the flour, not the flour into the water.
method.l: Kynshew ïa ka um bakhlaw halor ka badup, ym buh ïa ka badup ha ka um.

method.en: Rice flour has no gluten and only boiling water will make it hold at all.
method.l: Ka badup ja ka ym don gluten bad tang ka um bakhlaw ka pynkem ïa ka.

method.en: Stir it with a stick first, then knead it as hot as the hands can bear.
method.l: Pyllun da ka dieng shuwa, nangta sumar ha ba dang shyiap kum ba ki kti ki lah.

method.en: Pat each roti out between two sheets of plastic; it cracks on a board.
method.l: Pyllet ïa man ka roti hapdeng ar tylli plastik; ha ka dieng ka ïai.

method.en: Cook on a medium tawa without oil, then brush oil on after it comes off.
method.l: Thung ha ka tawa bapdeng khlem tulsi, nangta shet tulsi hadien ba mih.

method.en: Stack them under a cloth. Left open they go hard within twenty minutes.
method.l: Khreh ïa ki hapoh ka jaiñ. Lada plie, ki long ba eh hapoh shi phew minit.

recipes.why: Wheat has to come up from the plains and rice does not, which is why a Khasi kitchen has always made its bread from rice. This is the roti to serve beside a wet jhur when there is no putharo batter standing.
recipes.why_l: Ka gohu ka dei ban wan na madan bad ka ja ka ym, kata ka daw ba ka iing thung Khasi ka pynlong ïa ka roti jong ka na ka ja. Kane ka roti ka dei ban ai bad ka jhur baum lada ym don ka putharo baba shong.

recipes.name: Roti Kappa
recipes.sub: Cassava grated raw and pressed into a griddle cake
recipes.sub_l: Ka kappa bakher bathymmai bapyllet ban long ka roti

method.en: Peel the cassava thick and take the woody core out of every root.
method.l: Kih bakhraw ïa ka kappa bad kyllon noh ïa ka dieng hapoh na man ka tyllong.

method.en: Grate it raw on the coarse side and squeeze the water out in a cloth.
method.l: Kher ïa ka bathymmai ha ka bakhraw bad dup noh ïa ka um ha ka jaiñ.

method.en: Keep that squeezed water. The starch settles at the bottom of it in ten minutes.
method.l: Pyllait ïa kata ka um. Ka starch ka sah ha khyndew jong ka hapoh shi phew minit.
