method.en: Pour the water off and mix that settled starch back in with the rice flour.
method.l: Kynshew noh ïa ka um bad sumar biang ïa kata ka starch bad ka badup ja.

method.en: Press into thin cakes and cook on an oiled tawa four minutes a side.
method.l: Pyllet ban long ki roti bajem bad thung ha ka tawa batulsi saw minit ha man ka lieng.

recipes.why: The Garo Hills' answer to a roti, and it uses no bought flour beyond two kilos. Cassava is ₹22 a kilo against ₹52 for rice flour, which makes this the cheapest bread in the book.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingjubab jong ki Lum Garo sha ka roti, bad ka ym pyndonkam badup bathied khan na ar kilo. Ka kappa ka dam ₹22 ha shi kilo bad ka badup ja ₹52, kata ka pynlong ïa kane ka roti bakhyndiat dam tam ha ka kot.

recipes.name: Roti Nei
recipes.sub: Rice roti with black sesame worked right through the dough
recipes.sub_l: Ka roti ja bad ka nei-iong basumar hapoh ka badup

method.en: Roast the sesame and crush it coarse; whole seed falls out of the dough.
method.l: Syied ïa ka nei bad dup bakhraw; ka symbai baroh ka hap noh na ka badup.

method.en: Mix the crushed sesame into the dry flour before the water goes anywhere near it.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka nei badup bad ka badup basngai shuwa ba ka um ka wan hakhmat.

method.en: Sesame added after the dough is made sits in streaks and tears the roti.
method.l: Ka nei babuh hadien ba ka badup ka la long ka shong baïai bad ka pynïai ïa ka roti.

method.en: Pour on boiling water, stir with a stick, and knead hot.
method.l: Kynshew ïa ka um bakhlaw, pyllun da ka dieng, bad sumar ha ba dang shyiap.

method.en: Pat thin, cook on a dry tawa, and finish thirty seconds on the embers.
method.l: Pyllet bajem, thung ha ka tawa basngai, bad kut lai phew second ha ka ding.

recipes.why: The one roti here that needs nothing beside it, because the sesame is already in it. It is what to give a working party going out to the fields for the day.
recipes.why_l: Ka roti marwei kaba ym donkam ei ei ha ka lieng, naba ka nei ka la don hapoh. Kane ka dei kaba ai ïa ki briew kiba leit trei sha ka lyngkha ïa ka sngi.

recipes.name: Roti Gohum
recipes.sub: Wheat rolled thin and turned on a dry griddle
recipes.sub_l: Ka gohum ba la lan bariw bad la kylla halor ka tawa basngai

method.en: Knead it soft and rest it forty minutes. A wheat dough worked and rolled at once tears in the middle of every fourth roti.
method.l: Nam ia ka baduna bad pynsah saw phew minit. Ka jingnam gohum ba la trei bad la lan mynta ka pat ha ka dohnud jong ka roti basaw baroh.

method.en: A dry tawa and no oil on it. Oil on the griddle fries the flour and four hundred roti come out spotted and heavy.
method.l: Ka tawa basngai bad ym don ka tyrso um halor ka. Ka tyrso um halor ka tawa ka syied ia ka badup, bad ki saw shiteph roti ki mih bad ki jingot bad bajrong.

method.en: Turn each one twice and no more. A roti turned four times is a biscuit and four hundred of them cannot be softened again.
method.l: Kylla ia ka shi tylli ar sien tang, ym shuh. Ka roti ba la kylla saw sien ka long ka biskut, bad ki saw shiteph ki ym lah ban pynduna biang.

method.en: Stack them in a cloth-lined basket and never on a plate. A roti on a metal plate sweats and the bottom of the stack is wet in ten minutes.
method.l: Pynsun ia ki ha ka shang bad ka jaiñ ha ka, ym shym halor ka plet. Ka roti halor ka plet metal ka pynum, bad ka bynta harud jong ka jingsun ka long baum ha khadar minit.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Wheat is not a Meghalaya crop and every kilo comes up the road, so a plain ja carries an ordinary day and this carries a Sunday.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew. Ka gohum kam dei ka rep Meghalaya, bad ka kilo baroh ka wan lyngba ka lynti; kum kata ka ja basngai ka bah ia ka sngi basngai bad kane ka bah ia ka Sngi Bathaw.

recipes.name: Poori
recipes.sub: Wheat rolled small and fried to order in a deep kadai
recipes.sub_l: Ka gohum ba la lan barit bad la syied kat ba la kwah ha ka kadai bajrong

ing.name: Mustard oil in the dough
ing.name_l: Ka tyrso um ha ka jingnam

method.en: The dough is stiff, stiffer than a roti dough. A soft dough drinks oil and five hundred poori come out heavy.
method.l: Ka jingnam ka long bajrong, bajrong shuh ban ka jingnam roti. Ka jingnam baduna ka dih ia ka tyrso um, bad ki san shiteph poori ki mih bajrong.

method.en: A handful of sooji in the flour. It is what keeps a poori crisp for the twenty minutes between the kadai and the plate.
method.l: Ka shi kti sooji ha ka badup. Kata ka dei kaba pynsah ia ka poori bakrai na ki ar phew minit hapdeng ka kadai bad ka plet.

method.en: Rest the dough half an hour and no longer. A dough left an hour goes slack and the poori will not puff.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka jingnam shynna por tang, ym shuh. Ka jingnam ba la pynsah shi por ka long baduna, bad ka poori kan ym heh.

method.en: Fry in lots of twenty and press each one down once with the ladle. That one press makes it rise and a poori pressed twice is flat.
method.l: Syied ar phew ha shi sien bad nam ia ka shi tylli shi sien da ka kailoi. Kata ka shi jingnam ka pynkyllon ia ka, bad ka poori ba la nam ar sien ka long bariw.

recipes.why: Twenty-three rupees a head. This is the roti for a Shad Suk Mynsiem and a wedding; on any other day a plain ja carries the hall for eight rupees.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Kane ka dei ka roti na ka Shad Suk Mynsiem bad ka jingiakhun; ha ka sngi baroh bapher ka ja basngai ka bah ia ka iing ha phra tyngka.

recipes.name: Paratha
recipes.sub: Wheat folded in layers with ghee and turned on a griddle
recipes.sub_l: Ka gohum ba la kup ha ki bynta bad ka ghee bad la kylla halor ka tawa

method.en: The dough is soft here, softer than for a poori. A stiff dough will not take layers and the paratha comes off the tawa as a board.
method.l: Ka jingnam ka long baduna hangne, baduna shuh ban na ka poori. Ka jingnam bajrong kan ym pdiang ki bynta, bad ka paratha ka mih na ka tawa kum ka phlang.

method.en: Ghee between the folds and not in the dough. Ghee kneaded in gives a rich flat bread; ghee folded in gives the layers.
method.l: Ka ghee hapdeng ki jingkup, ym ha ka jingnam. Ka ghee ba la nam shapoh ka ai ka roti bariw babha; ka ghee ba la kup ka ai ki bynta.

method.en: Three folds and no more. Every fold past three is a layer nobody can taste and a minute more on a tawa for three hundred.
method.l: Lai jingkup tang, ym shuh. Ka jingkup baroh ba palat lai ka long ka bynta kaba ym don uno uno ban sngew, bad shi minit shuh halor ka tawa na ki lai shiteph.

method.en: Stack them in a cloth-lined basket. A paratha on a metal plate sweats and the bottom of the stack is wet in ten minutes.
method.l: Pynsun ia ki ha ka shang bad ka jaiñ ha ka. Ka paratha halor ka plet metal ka pynum, bad ka bynta harud jong ka jingsun ka long baum ha khadar minit.

recipes.why: Thirty-two rupees a head, and the ghee is most of it. This is the morning bread of a festival day; on any other morning the hall gets putharo and sha.
recipes.why_l: Lai phew ar tyngka ha u briew, bad ka ghee ka dei ka bun jong ka. Kane ka dei ka roti step jong ka sngi kumhei; ha ka step baroh bapher ka iing ka pdiang ka putharo bad ka sha.

recipes.name: Roti Missi
recipes.sub: Wheat and gram flour together on a dry griddle, no oil in it
recipes.sub_l: Ka gohum bad ka badup chana lang halor ka tawa basngai, ym don ka tyrso um

method.en: Two parts wheat to one of besan and no more besan than that. Half and half gives a roti that cracks on the tawa and cannot be turned.
method.l: Ar bynta gohum ha shi bynta badup chana, ym shuh ban kata. Shynna bad shynna ki ai ka roti kaba pat halor ka tawa bad kaba ym lah ban kylla.

method.en: Knead with warm water. Besan does not take cold water and a cold-kneaded dough is still crumbling twenty minutes later.
method.l: Nam bad ka um bakhraw. Ka badup chana kam pdiang ka um basyllok, bad ka jingnam ba la nam bad ka um basyllok ka dang pat ynda ar phew minit.

method.en: Rest it a full hour. Besan needs the time to take up the water and a dough rolled early tears in the middle of every roti.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka shi por babiang. Ka badup chana ka donkam ka por ban pdiang ia ka um, bad ka jingnam ba la lan bathuh ka pat ha ka dohnud jong ka roti baroh.

method.en: A dry tawa and no oil on it. A missi roti is fried in nothing and an oiled one goes soft in the basket before the line has passed.
method.l: Ka tawa basngai bad ym don ka tyrso um halor ka. Ka roti missi ka syied ym bad kaei kaei, bad kaba bad ka tyrso um ka long baduna ha ka shang shaphang ba ka lynti briew ka pyrshah.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head, no ghee and no kadai. Besan is half the price of wheat at Iewduh and this is the roti a Nohprah day can afford four of.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynniew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka ghee bad ka kadai. Ka badup chana ka long shynna ka dam jong ka gohum ha Iewduh, bad kane ka dei ka roti kaba ka sngi u Nohprah ka lah ai saw tylli.

recipes.name: Roti Phan
recipes.sub: Wheat stuffed with mashed potato and chilli, rolled thick
recipes.sub_l: Ka gohum ba la pyndap bad ki phan banam bad ka sohmynken, la lan bajrong

method.en: The filling must be completely dry and completely cold. A warm filling steams inside the roti and tears it on the tawa.
method.l: Ka jingpyndap ka dei ban long basngai babiang bad basyllok babiang. Ka jingpyndap bakhraw ka stem shapoh ka roti bad ka pat ia ka halor ka tawa.

method.en: Boil the phan in the skin and mash it warm, then let it cool. A potato peeled before boiling drinks water and the filling is wet whatever is done to it.
method.l: Pyndih ia ki phan bad ka snier bad nam ia ki bakhraw, ynda shah ia ki ban long basyllok. Ka phan ba la pynhiar shaphang ba pyndih ka dih ia ka um, bad ka jingpyndap ka long baum la la leh kaei kaei ia ka.

method.en: Equal weights of dough and filling in each one. More filling than that and the roti will not close; less and it is a plain roti with a rumour in it.
method.l: Ka jingjrong bakylliang jong ka jingnam bad ka jingpyndap ha ka shi tylli. Lada ka jingpyndap ka bun shuh, ka roti kan ym khang; lada ka duna, ka long ka roti basngai bad ka khubor ha ka.

method.en: Roll from the centre out and turn the disc a quarter each time. Rolled in one direction the filling gathers at one edge and that edge splits.
method.l: Lan na ka dohnud shabar bad kylla ia ka jingot da ka saw bynta ha ka sien baroh. Haba la lan sha shi liang, ka jingpyndap ka iakynduh ha shi snier, bad kata ka snier ka pat.

recipes.why: Thirty-one rupees a head and it is a meal on its own. On the morning of a long walk a devotee needs no dal beside this and the kitchen saves a vessel.
recipes.why_l: Lai phew shi tyngka ha u briew, bad ka long ka jingbam da ka lade. Ha ka step jong ka jingiaid baslem u nongbam u ym donkam ka dal hakhmat kane, bad ka rukom shet ka pynsah shi blang.

recipes.name: Jhur Tyrso
recipes.sub: Local greens fried down hard in mustard oil with dried chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ka jhur tyrso basyied ba eh ha ka tulsi jaiur bad ka sohmynken basyiar

method.en: Wash in three changes of water and shake dry; eighteen kilos cooks down to fifteen.
method.l: Sait lai sien bad pynduh um; shi phew phra kilo ki long shi phew san kilo.

method.en: Chop short and take the thickest stems out; a stem takes twice as long as a leaf.
method.l: Ot lyngkot bad kyllon noh ïa ki jrong bakhraw tam; ka jrong ka donkam ar sien ka por jong ka sla.

method.en: Smoke the mustard oil and let it cool a little before the chilli goes in.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka tulsi jaiur haduh ba ka rngi bad ai ïa ka syiar khyndiat shuwa ba buh ka sohmynken.

method.en: Raw mustard oil is bitter, and that bitterness is what a hall calls badly cooked greens.
method.l: Ka tulsi jaiur bathymmai ka khaw, bad kata ka jingkhaw ka dei kaba khot ka iing jhur babym bha.

method.en: Work in five-kilo lots on a high flame, uncovered, until the water has gone.
method.l: Thung ha ki bynta san kilo ha ka ding bakhraw, khlem khang, haduh ba ka um ka duh.

recipes.why: Tyrso is on every Khasi terrace through the cold months at ₹22 a kilo, and it is the green this state actually eats rather than the one a menu writer expects. Cooked open it stays dark green; covered it goes the colour of hay.
recipes.why_l: Ka tyrso ka don ha baroh ki lyngkha Khasi lyngba ki bnai basyiar ha ₹22 shi kilo, bad kane ka dei ka jhur kaba ka ri ka bam shisha. Lada thung khlem khang ka sah bathang; lada khang ka long kum ka phlang basngai.

recipes.name: Phan bad Nei-iong
recipes.sub: Potato tossed dry in ground black sesame — the Khasi flavour without meat
recipes.sub_l: Ki phan basumar bad ka nei-iong badup — ka jingsngew Khasi khlem doh

method.en: Parboil the potato seven minutes, drain it, and let it steam off ten minutes.
method.l: Pynkhlaw lyngkot ïa ka phan hynniew minit, pynduh um, bad ai ïa ka pynduh lyer shi phew minit.

method.en: Fry it in the oil until the outsides are set and dry, working in lots.
method.l: Syied ïa ka ha ka tulsi haduh ba ka bar ka eh bad ka sngai, ha ki bynta.

method.en: Stir the ground sesame in off the fire, not on it.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka nei badup hadien ba pynsngiah na ka ding, ym halor ka ding.

method.en: Sesame held on the flame past a minute turns bitter and eighteen kilos are lost.
method.l: Ka nei kaba shong halor ka ding slem khan na shi minit ka khaw bad shi phew phra kilo ki duh.

method.en: Toss until every cube is coated grey-black and serve within the hour.
method.l: Sumar haduh ba man ka tylli ka long ba iong bad ai bam hapoh shi por.

recipes.why: Doh-neiiong — pork in black sesame — is the dish this state is known for, and this is the same flavour built on potato instead. It is the page to cook when a Khasi guest is eating in the temple for the first time.
recipes.why_l: Ka doh-neiiong — ka doh sniang bad ka nei-iong — ka dei ka jingbam kaba tip ïa kane ka ri, bad kane ka dei kata ka jingsngew halor ki phan. Kane ka kot ka dei ban thung lada u nongwan Khasi u bam ha ka iing blei ha ka sien banyngkong.

recipes.name: Rymbai ba Syied
recipes.sub: Fresh beans snapped by hand and cooked dry with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai bathymmai babrop da ka kti, bathung basngai bad ka sying

method.en: String the beans and snap them by hand rather than cutting them.
method.l: Kyllon noh ïa ki thied bad brop ïa ki da ka kti, ym ot da ka waitlam.

method.en: A snapped bean tears along its own line and takes the seasoning; a cut one stays sealed.
method.l: Ka rymbai babrop ka ïai lyngba ka lynti jong ka hi bad ka shim ïa ka masala; kaba ot ka sah bakhang.

method.en: Fry the potato first until the edges colour, then lift it out.
method.l: Syied ïa ka phan shuwa haduh ba ki lieng ki saw, nangta kyllon noh.

method.en: Crackle the chilli and ginger, add the beans, and cover eight minutes with no water.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sohmynken bad ka sying, buh ïa ki rymbai, bad khang phra minit khlem um.

method.en: Return the potato, season, and toss it open until it is dry.
method.l: Wallam ïa ka phan, buh ïa ka masala, bad sumar khlem khang haduh ba ka sngai.

recipes.why: Beans climb the maize in every Khasi and Garo field and come in by the sack from August. The dish holds four hours without going grey, so it is the dry jhur to send with a travelling party.
recipes.why_l: Ki rymbai ki kiew halor ka riewbah ha baroh ki lyngkha Khasi bad Garo bad ki wan da ki bori na August. Ka jingbam ka shong saw por khlem long ba iong, kumta ka dei ka jhur basngai ban phah bad ki briew kiba leit jngai.

recipes.name: Bandakobi Basngai
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded and fried dry until the edges catch
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi ba la ot bad la syied basngai haduh ba ki snier ki duh

method.en: No water at any point. Fourteen kilos of bandakobi gives up three litres in the first ten minutes and that is all it needs.
method.l: Ym don ka um hangno hangno. Ki 14 kilo bandakobi ki ai lai litar ha ki khadar minit banyngkong, bad kata ka dei baroh kaba donkam.

method.en: Two batches in a wide kadai. Fourteen kilos at once steams in its own water and a steamed cabbage smells through the hall.
method.l: Ar sien ha ka kadai bakhraw. Ki 14 kilo lang ki stem ha ka um jong ki, bad ka bandakobi bastem ka sngi lyngba ka iing.

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. That caught edge is the whole difference between a bandakobi basngai and a boiled cabbage.
method.l: Shah ia ki snier ban duh shaphang ba kylla. Kata ka snier baduh ka dei ka jingpher baroh hapdeng ka bandakobi basngai bad ka bandakobi bapyndih.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It is what makes fourteen kilos of cabbage taste like something a cook decided on.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Kata ka dei kaba pynlong ia ki 14 kilo bandakobi ban sngew kum kaei kaba u nongshet u la jubab.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head. Bandakobi keeps ten days in a Shillong store room where a green leaf keeps two, and fourteen kilos is a dry sabji for a hundred.
recipes.why_l: Shiphew tyngka ha u briew. Ka bandakobi ka sah khadshiphew sngi ha ka dep Shillong ha kaba ka sla bathiang ka sah ar, bad ki 14 kilo ki long ka jhur basngai na u shispah briew.

recipes.name: Pathaw Basngai
recipes.sub: Pumpkin fried dry until the edges catch and go sweet
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la syied basngai haduh ba ki snier ki duh bad ki long basngai

method.en: No water at any point. Sixteen kilos of pathaw gives up all the water it needs in the first ten minutes.
method.l: Ym don ka um hangno hangno. Ki 16 kilo pathaw ki ai baroh ka um ba ki donkam ha ki khadar minit banyngkong.

method.en: Cook it in two batches in a wide kadai. Sixteen kilos at once steams in its own water and a steamed pathaw is a wet dish with no name.
method.l: Syied ia ka ar sien ha ka kadai bakhraw. Ki 16 kilo lang ki stem ha ka um jong ki, bad ka pathaw bastem ka long ka jingbam baum ym bad ka kyrteng.

method.en: Let the edges catch before it is turned. That caught edge is where the sweetness comes from and one turned every minute has none.
method.l: Shah ia ki snier ban duh shaphang ba kylla. Kata ka snier baduh ka dei ka jaka ba ka jingsngai ka mih, bad kaba la kylla ha ka minit baroh ka ym don.

method.en: No sugar. A Risaw pathaw is already sweet and one that has caught at the edges is sweeter still.
method.l: Ym don ka chini. Ka pathaw u Risaw ka la long basngai shu mynta, bad kaba ki snier ki la duh ka long basngai shuh.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head, the cheapest dry sabji in this book. In Risaw a Ri Bhoi field gives more pathaw than the kitchen can use.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, ka jhur basngai kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot. Ha u Risaw ka rep Ri Bhoi ka ai ka pathaw ba bun ban kaba ka rukom shet ka lah pyndonkam.

recipes.name: Usoi Basngai
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot boiled once and fried dry with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ka usoi ba la pyndih shi sien bad la syied basngai bad ka nei

method.en: Boil the usoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka usoi shi sien ha ka um basngai bad thoh noh ia kata ka um. Ka um banyngkong ka rah ia ka jingsngewthiang kaba lada ym kan rah noh ia ka thyllieh.

method.en: Cut it in strips along the grain and never across. Cut across, the shoot falls into short pieces and there is nothing to pick up.
method.l: Ot ia ka bariw ïa ka snier, ym shym pyrshah. Haba la ot pyrshah, ka usoi ka pat sha ki jingot barit, bad ym don kaei ban pdiang.

method.en: No water and no lid after the boiling. Under a lid ten kilos steams and a steamed usoi is a wet thing that nobody will eat.
method.l: Ym don ka um bad ka jingkhap ynda ka jingpyndih. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ki 10 kilo ki stem, bad ka usoi bastem ka long ka jingbam baum kaba ym don uno uno ban bam.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. Sesame boiled with the usoi for twenty minutes tastes of nothing at all.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Ka nei ba la pyndih lang bad ka usoi ar phew minit ka sngew ym kaei kaei.

recipes.why: Fourteen rupees a head. In Lber the shoot comes off the Ri Bhoi slope for the cutting and ten kilos is a dry sabji for a hundred.
recipes.why_l: Khadsaw tyngka ha u briew. Ha u Lber ka usoi ka mih na ka lum Ri Bhoi na ka dam jong ka jingot, bad ki 10 kilo ki long ka jhur basngai na u shispah briew.

recipes.name: Sohphlang Basngai
recipes.sub: Sohphlang tossed raw with mustard oil, chilli and salt
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohphlang baiar ba la kylla bad ka tyrso um, ka sohmynken bad ka mluh

method.en: No fire under this at all. Sohphlang cooked in any way loses everything it is dug for and twelve kilos is wasted.
method.l: Ym don ka ding harud kane ei ei. Ka sohphlang ba la shet ha ka rukom hangno hangno ka duh baroh kaba ka shah kynshew na ka bynta ka, bad ki 12 kilo ki duh.

method.en: Peel it with the fingers and not a knife. The skin comes away in one piece if it is fresh and a knife takes the flesh with it.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka da ki kti, ym da u wait. Ka snier ka mih shi jingot lada ka long bathymmai, bad u wait u rah noh ia ka doh lang bad u.

method.en: Roast the chilli on the flame and crush it in the hand. A powder gives heat only; the pieces are what is looked for on the plate.
method.l: Em ia ka sohmynken halor ka ding bad nam ia ka ha ka kti. Ka badup ka ai tang ka jingsngewpoh; ki jingot ki dei kiba ki briew ki wad halor ka plet.

method.en: Salt at the counter and not before. Twelve kilos of salted sohphlang gives up two litres in half an hour and the tray is a white water.
method.l: Buh ka mluh ha ka jaka ba ai, ym shaphang. Ki 12 kilo sohphlang bad ka mluh ki ai ar litar ha shynna por, bad ka tre ka long ka um basaw.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head, no fire and no kadai. Sohphlang is dug on the Khasi slopes in Nohprah and this is the dish a Khasi guest will name before any other on the shelf.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka ding bad ka kadai. Ka sohphlang ka shah kynshew ha ki lum Khasi ha u Nohprah, bad kane ka dei ka jingbam kaba u nongwan Khasi u kyrteng shaphang ka baroh bapher halor ka jaka.

recipes.name: Phulkobi Basngai
recipes.sub: Cauliflower broken into florets and fried dry with its stalk
recipes.sub_l: Ka phulkobi ba la pynpra bad la syied basngai lang bad ka mrad jong ka

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water and lift them out. There is more in a Nohprah cauliflower than cauliflower and the salt brings it to the surface.
method.l: Buh ki jingot ha ka um bad ka mluh khadar minit bad rah noh ia ki. Don kaei kaei shuh ha ka phulkobi u Nohprah ban ka phulkobi, bad ka mluh ka pynmih ia ka halor.

method.en: Peel the stalk and cut it in with the florets. The stalk is a third of the weight and a kitchen that throws it is throwing five kilos.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka mrad bad ot ia ka lang bad ki jingot. Ka mrad ka dei ka lai bynta jong ka jingjrong, bad ka rukom shet kaba shah bred noh ia ka ka shah bred noh san kilo.

method.en: No water and no lid, and cook it in two batches. Sixteen kilos under a lid steams and a steamed cauliflower smells through the hall.
method.l: Ym don ka um bad ka jingkhap, bad syied ia ka ar sien. Ki 16 kilo ha khnong ka jingkhap ki stem, bad ka phulkobi bastem ka sngi lyngba ka iing.

method.en: Take it off while a floret still snaps. A cauliflower cooked through is one nobody looks at twice on the plate.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka katba ka jingot ka dang pat. Ka phulkobi ba la shet biang ka dei kaba ym don uno uno ba khmih ar sien halor ka plet.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, and in Nohprah the phulkobi is thirty rupees a kilo at Iewduh. The stalk goes in, so sixteen kilos is sixteen kilos.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, bad ha u Nohprah ka phulkobi ka long lai phew tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh. Ka mrad ka dep lang, kum kata ki 16 kilo ki long 16 kilo.

recipes.name: Tungrymbai ka Jhur
recipes.sub: The fermented bean pounded with sesame and cooked into a thick gravy
recipes.sub_l: Ka tungrymbai badup bad ka nei bad bathung ban long ka um bakhraw

method.en: Pound the tungrymbai coarse in a mortar with the ground sesame.
method.l: Dup bakhraw ïa ka tungrymbai ha ka thlong bad ka nei badup.

method.en: Fry that paste in the oil six full minutes before anything else joins it.
method.l: Syied ïa kata ka badup ha ka tulsi hynriew minit baroh shuwa ba buh ki kiwei.

method.en: Frying is what turns the ferment smell into a taste; unfried, it scents the whole hall.
method.l: Ka jingsyied ka pynkylla ïa ka rngi jingmuriaw ban long ka jingsngew; khlem syied, ka rngi ka dap ka iing baroh.

method.en: Add ginger, chilli, turmeric and the potato, then water to just cover.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sying, ka sohmynken, ka shynrai bad ka phan, nangta ka um ban khang tang.

method.en: Simmer twenty-five minutes until the potato edges break and thicken it.
method.l: Pynkhlaw sngur shi phew san minit haduh ba ki lieng jong ka phan ki brop bad ki pynkhraw ïa ka um.

recipes.why: Tungrymbai is the dish a Khasi would name first, and it is nearly always cooked with pork. Built on the ferment and the sesame alone it is still the same dish, and it is the cheapest festival page here at ₹12 a head.
recipes.why_l: Ka tungrymbai ka dei ka jingbam kaba u Khasi u khot shuwa, bad ka thung tang bad ka doh sniang. Lada ieng halor ka jingmuriaw bad ka nei marwei, ka dang long kata ka jingbam, bad ka dei ka kot bakhraw bakhyndiat dam tam hangne, ₹12 ha uwei u ngut.

recipes.name: Usoi bad Phan
recipes.sub: Soured bamboo shoot and potato in a thin sharp gravy
recipes.sub_l: Ka usoi bamuriaw bad ki phan ha ka um bajem bad batyngkai

method.en: Rinse the soured shoot in two changes of water to take the sharpest edge off.
method.l: Sait ïa ka usoi bamuriaw ar sien ban pynduh ïa ka jingtyngkai bakhraw tam.

method.en: Fry the shoot alone in the oil for six minutes before anything else goes in.
method.l: Syied ïa ka usoi marwei ha ka tulsi hynriew minit shuwa ba buh ki kiwei.

method.en: Unfried shoot puts the smell of the jar into the whole pot and it does not come out.
method.l: Ka usoi babym syied ka buh ka rngi jong ka khiew ha ka jingbam baroh bad ka ym mih shuh.

method.en: Add tomato, ginger and turmeric, then the potato, then the water over everything.
method.l: Buh ïa ka soh khlaw, ka sying bad ka shynrai, nangta ka phan, nangta ka um halor baroh.

method.en: Simmer thirty minutes until the potato edges break and the gravy thickens by itself.
method.l: Pynkhlaw sngur lai phew minit haduh ba ki lieng jong ka phan ki brop bad ka um ka khraw da lade.

recipes.why: The sour wet dish that a Khasi plate expects beside plain rice, and the reason the pickle shelf matters in February. Shoot cut in July is what makes this possible in the months it cannot be cut.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam baum bamuriaw kaba ka ding Khasi ka ap ha ka lieng jong ka ja, bad ka daw ba ka iing achar ka dei ha February. Ka usoi baba ot ha July ka dei kaba pynlah ïa kane ha ki bnai ba ka ym lah ot.

recipes.name: Jhur Shynrai
recipes.sub: Mixed vegetables in a Lakadong gravy thickened with rice flour
recipes.sub_l: Ki jhur baiasumar ha ka um Lakadong bakhraw da ka badup ja

method.en: Cut everything to one size and sort it into hard and soft before the fire is lit.
method.l: Ot ïa ki baroh kum shi rukom bad bret ha kiba eh bad kiba jem shuwa ba pynding.

method.en: Bloom the turmeric in the hot oil twenty seconds before any vegetable goes in.
method.l: Buh ïa ka shynrai ha ka tulsi bashyiap shi phew second shuwa ba buh shi tylli jhur.

method.en: Give the hard vegetables eight minutes covered before the soft ones join them.
method.l: Ai ïa ki jhur baeh phra minit bakhang shuwa ba ki bajem ki wan.

method.en: Slake the rice flour in cold water and stir it in to thicken at the end.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka badup ja ha ka um basyiar bad sumar hapoh ban pynkhraw ha kaba kut.

method.en: Flour dropped in dry lumps and the whole pot has to be strained.
method.l: Ka badup babuh basngai ka jam bad ka khiew baroh ka dei ban sait.

recipes.why: Rice flour rather than cream or cashew, because rice flour is what this state has and it costs a tenth as much. The turmeric is doing the work here, so use the real Lakadong and use it early.
recipes.why_l: Ka badup ja, ym ka cream lymne ka soh sniang, naba ka badup ja ka dei kaba don hangne bad ka dam shi bynta shi phew. Ka shynrai ka trei ïa ka kam hangne, kumta pyndonkam ïa ka Lakadong shisha bad buh ïa ka lyngkot.

recipes.name: Rymbai bad Phan
recipes.sub: Beans and potato cooked thin with sesame and chilli
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai bad ki phan ba la shet bariw bad ka nei bad ka sohmynken

method.en: Soak the rymbai twelve hours and cook them half done before the phan goes in. Started together, the potato is paste while the bean is still a bead.
method.l: Buh ia ki rymbai ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ki shynna shaphang ba ki phan ki dep. Haba la sdang lang, ka phan ka long ka jingnam katba ka rymbai ka dang kum ka symbai.

method.en: Break the phan by hand and do not cut it. A knife-cut potato holds its edges and the vessel never thickens on its own.
method.l: Pynkhih ia ki phan da ka kti, ym dei ban ot ia ki. Ka phan ba la ot da u wait ka bat ia ki snier jong ka, bad ka blang kan ym long bajrong da ka lade.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a rymbai hardens and two hours more will not open it.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ka rymbai ka long baduna. Haba la buh bathuh, ka rymbai ka long bajrong, bad ar por shuh kin ym pynkhang ia ka.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It is what thickens twenty-six litres with no flour anywhere in it.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Kata ka dei kaba pynlong ia ki 26 litar bajrong ym bad ka badup hangno hangno.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head. Three kilos of rymbai and five of phan gives a hundred people the protein of a meal in one vessel.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew. Ki lai kilo rymbai bad ki san kilo phan ki ai ia u shispah briew ka bha jong ka jingbam ha shi blang.

recipes.name: Pathaw Baum
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down in a thin gravy with tomato
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la shet ha ka jhur bariw bad ka jaiur

method.en: Roast the jaiur on the flame and peel it before it goes in. The skin in a gravy rolls up into strings and every devotee finds one.
method.l: Em ia ki jaiur halor ka ding bad pynhiar ia ki shaphang ba ki dep. Ka snier ha ka jhur baum ka kup lade sha ki jingbat bariw, bad u nongbam baroh u shem shi tylli.

method.en: Cut the pathaw large and keep the skin on. A small dice dissolves and twenty-six litres is an orange water with nothing to find.
method.l: Ot ia ka pathaw bakhraw bad pynsah ia ka snier. Ki jingot barit ki duh, bad ki 26 litar ki long ka um basaw ym bad kaei ban shem.

method.en: Keep it thin. A pathaw baum is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one is a mash in the wrong vessel.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw. Ka pathaw baum ka shah dih na ka plet ha kaba dep ka jingbam, bad kaba bajrong ka long ka jingnam ha ka blang bapher.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It does the work a cream would do in a plains gravy and it costs a fifth as much.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Ka leh ia ka kam ba ka cream kan leh ha ka jhur bri, bad ka dam tang ka san bynta jong ka.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head. In Risaw the pathaw costs the carrying and the nei is the only thing bought for this vessel.
recipes.why_l: Khadar tyngka ha u briew. Ha u Risaw ka pathaw ka dam tang ka jingbah, bad ka nei tang ka dei kaba thied na kane ka blang.

recipes.name: Bandakobi Baum
recipes.sub: Cabbage and peas in a thin gravy with tomato
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi bad ki matar ha ka jhur bariw bad ka jaiur

method.en: Cut the bandakobi in wide pieces and not shreds. A shredded cabbage in a gravy disappears and twenty-six litres is a green water.
method.l: Ot ia ka bandakobi ha ki jingot bakhraw, ym bariw. Ka bandakobi ba la ot bariw ha ka jhur baum ka duh, bad ki 26 litar ki long ka um bathiang.

method.en: The peas go in with the fire off. Cooked twenty minutes they are grey and two kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Ki matar ki dep haba la pynjot ia ka ding. Haba la shet ar phew minit ki long barongkhraw, bad ki ar kilo matar barongkhraw ki shah shem na ka jingkhang.

method.en: Cook it uncovered. Under a lid ten kilos of cabbage steams and the smell reaches the far end of the hall.
method.l: Shet ia ka ba la khang ym. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ki 10 kilo bandakobi ki stem, bad ka jingsngi ka poi sha ka bneng iing.

method.en: Take it off while a piece still holds. Cabbage cooks for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka katba ka jingot ka dang bat. Ka bandakobi ka shet khadar minit ynda la pynjot ia ka ding, bad kaba beit ha ka rukom shet ka long ka jingnam ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head. Bandakobi keeps ten days in a store room where a green leaf keeps two, and two kilos of peas make it a dish and not a filler.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynniew tyngka ha u briew. Ka bandakobi ka sah khadshiphew sngi ha ka dep ha kaba ka sla bathiang ka sah ar, bad ki ar kilo matar ki pynlong ia ka kum ka jingbam ym kum ka jingpyndap.

recipes.name: Phulkobi bad Phan
recipes.sub: Cauliflower and potato in a light gravy with cumin
recipes.sub_l: Ka phulkobi bad ki phan ha ka jhur baduna bad ka jeera

method.en: The phan goes in twelve minutes before the phulkobi. Started together, the cauliflower is pulp while the potato is still raw in the middle.
method.l: Ki phan ki dep khadar minit shaphang ba ka phulkobi. Haba la sdang lang, ka phulkobi ka long ka jingnam katba ka phan ka dang iar ha ka dohnud.

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water first. There is more in a Nohprah cauliflower than cauliflower.
method.l: Buh ki jingot ha ka um bad ka mluh khadar minit shaphang. Don kaei kaei shuh ha ka phulkobi u Nohprah ban ka phulkobi.

method.en: Keep it just wet and no more. This is not a soup; the gravy should cling to the pieces and not stand around them.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka baum tang biang, ym shuh. Kane kam dei ka soup; ka jhur baum ka dei ban shet ha ki jingot, ym ban ïeng ha ka jingkhor jong ki.

method.en: Take it off while a floret still holds. Both cook for ten minutes after the fire is out and one that is right in the kitchen is a mash in the hall.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka katba ka jingot ka dang bat. Ki ar tylli ki shet khadar minit ynda la pynjot ia ka ding, bad kaba beit ha ka rukom shet ka long ka jingnam ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head, and it is the guest dish for a Nohprah day when no paneer has come up the road. Seven kilos each fills twenty-eight litres.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew tyngka ha u briew, bad ka dei ka jingbam nongwan na ka sngi u Nohprah haba ym don ka paneer ba la wan lyngba ka lynti. Ki hynniew kilo shi tylli shi tylli ki pyndap ia ki 28 litar.

recipes.name: Paneer ka Jhur
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and sesame gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: Ka paneer ha ka jhur jaiur bad nei, ym don ka piaz bad ka lasun

method.en: Roast the nei and grind it with the tomato and the cashew. Between them they do the whole job an onion base would do and the nei costs a fifth of the cashew.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad kroh ia ka lang bad ki jaiur bad ki kaju. Hapdeng ki ki leh ia ka kam baroh ba ka piaz kan leh, bad ka nei ka dam tang ka san bynta jong ki kaju.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of sugar hides it for a minute only.
method.l: Shet ia ka jingnam jaiur ar phew san minit shaphang ba ka ghee ka dep. Ka jaiur ba ym la shet biang ka sngewthiang, bad ka spun chini ka khap ia ka shi minit tang.

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray five kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka paneer ba la ot ha ka um bakhraw bad ka mluh haduh ba ka jhur baum ka biang. Haba la pynsah basngai halor ka tre, ki san kilo ki long bajrong ha ki snier ha shi por.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Ka paneer ka dep saw minit shaphang ba ai, ym bathuh. Ki san kilo ba la pyndih ha ka jhur baum ki long san kilo rabar ha ka jaka ba ai.

recipes.why: Fifty-three rupees a head, the dearest wet dish in this book. Paneer comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for Shad Suk Mynsiem and a wedding.
recipes.why_l: San phew lai tyngka ha u briew, ka jhur baum kaba dam jrong tam ha kane ka kot. Ka paneer ka wan lyngba ka lynti bad ka shem ha ka dam; kum kata kane ka dei na ka Shad Suk Mynsiem bad ka jingiakhun.

recipes.name: Soup Usoi
recipes.sub: Clear bamboo shoot broth, lightly thickened and very hot
recipes.sub_l: Ka soup usoi bakhuid, bakhraw khyndiat bad bashyiap eh

method.en: Boil the fresh shoot fifteen minutes in open water and throw that water away.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka usoi bathymmai shi phew san minit ha ka um kaba plie bad thok noh ïa kata ka um.

method.en: Fresh shoot is never cooked from raw in this kitchen. The first water carries what disagrees.
method.l: Ka usoi bathymmai ka ym shym thung na ba thymmai ha kane ka iing. Ka um banyngkong ka bah kaba ym bha.

method.en: Shred it fine and simmer it in the fresh water twenty minutes with the ginger.
method.l: Ot lyngkot ïa ka bad pynkhlaw sngur ha ka um bathymmai shi phew minit bad ka sying.

method.en: Slake the rice flour cold and stir it in; the broth should stay clear, not milky.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka badup ja ha ka um basyiar bad sumar hapoh; ka soup ka dei ban sah bakhuid, ym ba lieh.

method.en: Pepper off the fire and serve it hotter than it seems it should be.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sohmynken iong hadien ba pynsngiah bad ai bam bashyiap khan na kaba pyni bha.

recipes.why: Shillong is cold nine months of the year and this is what goes out before the plate does. It costs ₹9 a bowl and needs no dairy, no dal and no stock.
recipes.why_l: Ka Shillong ka syiar khyndai bnai jong ka snem bad kane ka dei kaba mih shuwa ba ka ding ka mih. Ka dam ₹9 ha ka kop bad ka ym donkam dud, ym dal bad ym stock.

recipes.name: Dohkhlieh Sohphlang
recipes.sub: The Khasi salad built on the tuber instead of the meat
recipes.sub_l: Ka dohkhlieh Khasi baieng halor ka sohphlang, ym halor ka doh

method.en: Wash the tubers three times and scrape the skin off with a knife.
method.l: Sait ïa ka sohphlang lai sien bad kher noh ïa ka snieh da ka waitlam.

method.en: Cut them into rounds the thickness of a coin, never smaller.
method.l: Ot ïa ki ban long ki tylli bakhraw kum ka paisa, ym barit khan.

method.en: Crush the roasted sesame coarse and toss it through with chilli and ginger.
method.l: Dup bakhraw ïa ka nei basyied bad sumar bad ka sohmynken bad ka sying.

method.en: Dress it fifteen minutes before it is eaten and not a minute earlier.
method.l: Buh ïa ka masala shi phew san minit shuwa ba bam, bad ym shi minit lyngkot khan.

method.en: Dressed early the tuber weeps and the tray is water by the time it goes out.
method.l: Lada buh lyngkot, ka sohphlang ka ai um bad ka tray ka long um ha ba ka leit.

recipes.why: Dohkhlieh is the Khasi salad and is made with boiled pork head, which is why most visitors never meet it. Sohphlang takes the same dressing and the same plate, and it is a dish this state recognises immediately.
recipes.why_l: Ka dohkhlieh ka dei ka salad Khasi bad ka long bad ka khlieh sniang bakhlaw, kata ka daw ba ki nongwan ki ym shym ïohi ïa ka. Ka sohphlang ka shim kata ka masala bad kata ka ding, bad kane ka jingbam ka ri ka tip lyngkot.

recipes.name: Soup Jhur bad Sying
recipes.sub: Vegetable broth carrying half a kilo of ginger and nothing else
recipes.sub_l: Ka soup jhur kaba bah shi bynta ar kilo sying bad ym don ei ei pat

method.en: Slice everything thin so it gives its taste to the water inside twenty minutes.
method.l: Ot bajem ïa ki baroh ban ki ai ïa ka jingsngew sha ka um hapoh shi phew minit.

method.en: Fry the ginger in the ghee first until it stops smelling raw.
method.l: Syied ïa ka sying ha ka ghee shuwa haduh ba ka ym rngi bathymmai shuh.

method.en: Simmer, do not boil hard. A hard boil clouds the broth and greys the vegetables.
method.l: Pynkhlaw sngur, ym ba eh. Ka jingkhlaw ba eh ka pynlieh ïa ka soup bad ka pyniong ïa ki jhur.

method.en: Slake the rice flour in cold water and stir it in for body, not for thickness.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka badup ja ha ka um basyiar bad sumar hapoh ïa ka jingkhraw khyndiat, ym ban pynkhraw eh.

method.en: Pepper and salt at the very end, off the fire.
method.l: Ka sohmynken iong bad ka mluh ha kaba kut eh, hadien ba pynsngiah.

recipes.why: Ginger is grown across Meghalaya and costs ₹70 a kilo here against three times that off the hill. Six hundred grams in twenty litres is what makes this worth drinking rather than merely warm.
recipes.why_l: Ka sying ka bit lyngba ka Meghalaya bad ka dam ₹70 ha shi kilo hangne, bad lai sien kata ha bar jong ka lum. Hynriew phew gram ha shi phew litar ka dei kaba pynlong ïa kane ban dei ban dih, ym ban long bashyiap tang.

recipes.name: Soup Pathaw
recipes.sub: Pumpkin boiled soft and pressed through a sieve, no cream
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la pyndih baduna bad la sait, ym don ka cream

method.en: Peel it for a soup even though a wet dish keeps the skin. The skin will not go through a sieve and it is the one thing a devotee finds in a bowl.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka na ka soup la ka jingbam baum ka pynsah ia ka snier. Ka snier kan ym leit lyngba ka jingsait, bad ka dei ka shi kajuh ba u nongbam u shem ha ka kchu.

method.en: Roasted rice flour in place of a cream. Three hundred grams thickens twenty-two litres and a Khasi kitchen has it on the shelf anyway.
method.l: Ka badup ja baem ha ka jaka ka cream. Ki lai shiteph gram ki pynlong ia ki 22 litar bajrong, bad ka rukom shet Khasi ka don ia ka halor ka jaka lem.

method.en: Press it through a sieve and do not use a blender. A blended pumpkin holds air and twenty-two litres of it froths over in the vessel.
method.l: Sait ia ka lyngba ka jingsait, ym pyndonkam ka blender. Ka pathaw ba la blend ka bat ia ka lyer, bad ki 22 litar ki phuh noh na ka blang.

method.en: Black pepper and no chilli. This is the one dish in the book that goes to the sick room and a sohmynken in it defeats the purpose.
method.l: Ka sohmynken lang, ym ka sohmynken bathiang. Kane ka dei ka shi jingbam ha ka kot kaba leit sha ka kamra nongpang, bad ka sohmynken ha ka ka pynduh ia ka daw.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head, no cream and no dairy at all. In Risaw a Ri Bhoi field gives twelve kilos for the carrying, and this is the bowl that goes to whoever cannot take a full plate.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka cream bad ka dud ei ei. Ha u Risaw ka rep Ri Bhoi ka ai 12 kilo na ka dam jong ka jingbah, bad kane ka dei ka kchu kaba leit sha uno uno ba ym lah bam ka plet babiang.

recipes.name: Soup Rymbai
recipes.sub: Beans cooked to nothing and pressed through a sieve
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai ba la shet haduh ba ki duh bad la sait

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them until they break by themselves. A soup rymbai is meant to have nothing left to chew.
method.l: Buh ia ki ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ki haduh ba ki pat da ki lade. Ka soup rymbai ka dei ban ym don kaei kaba sah ban khait.

method.en: Press it through a sieve and keep what stays behind for a bora batter. Three kilos of bean leaves half a kilo of skin and it is not waste.
method.l: Sait ia ka lyngba ka jingsait bad pynsah kaba sah na ka bynta ka badup pakora. Ki lai kilo rymbai ki pynsah shynna kilo snier, bad kam dei ka jingduh.

method.en: Roast the cumin and crush it in at the end. Cumin boiled in a soup for an hour tastes of nothing and the bowl is a bean water.
method.l: Em ia ka jeera bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Ka jeera ba la pyndih ha ka soup shi por ka sngew ym kaei kaei, bad ka kchu ka long ka um rymbai.

method.en: Keep it thinner than it looks right. A rymbai soup thickens for twenty minutes off the fire and one that is right in the kitchen cannot be poured in the hall.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw shuh ban ka khmih babeit. Ka soup rymbai ka long bajrong ar phew minit na ka ding, bad kaba beit ha ka rukom shet ka ym lah ban thoh ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head. Three kilos of rymbai gives a hundred bowls with the protein of a meal in them, and it needs no dairy at all.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynsan tyngka ha u briew. Ki lai kilo rymbai ki ai u shispah kchu bad ka bha jong ka jingbam ha ki, bad ka ym donkam ka dud ei ei.

recipes.name: Soup Tyrso
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves boiled in plain water and drunk as a broth
recipes.sub_l: Ki jhur tyrso ba la pyndih ha ka um basngai bad la dih kum ka soup

method.en: No oil at any point and nothing else in the vessel. This is leaves and water and the whole art of it is not adding anything.
method.l: Ym don ka tyrso um hangno hangno bad ym don kaei kaei shuh ha ka blang. Kane ka dei ki sla bad ka um, bad ka jingstad baroh jong ka ka dei ba ym buh kaei kaei.

method.en: Twelve minutes and no more. Tyrso boiled twenty minutes gives a broth the colour of a wet road and the bitterness of a medicine.
method.l: Khadar minit tang, ym shuh. Ka tyrso ba la pyndih ar phew minit ka ai ka soup bad ka rong ka lynti baum bad ka jingsngewkhaw ka dawai.

method.en: Bruise the ginger and drop it in whole, then take it out. Grated ginger clouds the broth and a soup tyrso should be looked through.
method.l: Nam ia ka sying bad buh ia ka baroh, ynda rah noh ia ka. Ka sying ba la khriah ka pynduh ia ka jingshai jong ka soup, bad ka soup tyrso ka dei ban shah khmih lyngba.

method.en: Serve it hot and never reheated. A tyrso soup boiled a second time is bitter and twenty-two litres go back to the kitchen.
method.l: Ai ia ka bakhraw, ym shym pynbakhraw biang. Ka soup tyrso ba la pyndih ka ar sien ka sngewkhaw, bad ki 22 litar ki phai sha ka rukom shet.

recipes.why: Six rupees a head, the cheapest thing in this book. In Lber the tyrso is fifteen rupees a kilo and a bowl of it is what a Khasi house drinks instead of a sha.
recipes.why_l: Hynriew tyngka ha u briew, kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot. Ha u Lber ka tyrso ka long 15 tyngka ka kilo, bad ka kchu jong ka ka dei kaba ka iing Khasi ka dih ha ka jaka ka sha.

recipes.name: Dohkhlieh Bandakobi
recipes.sub: Cabbage shredded raw and tossed with sesame and black salt
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi baiar ba la ot bad la kylla bad ka nei bad ka mluh iong

method.en: Shred the bandakobi fine and do not chop it. A dohkhlieh is eaten with the fingers and a chunk of cabbage cannot be picked up with anything else on it.
method.l: Ot ia ka bandakobi bariw, ym dei ban ot bajrong. Ka dohkhlieh ka shah bam da ki kti, bad ka jingot bandakobi bakhraw ka ym shah pdiang lang bad kaei kaei shuh.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it coarse. It is the whole dressing and no oil goes into a dohkhlieh at all.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam bajrong. Kata ka dei ka jingai mynsaw baroh, bad ym don ka tyrso um kaba dep sha ka dohkhlieh ei ei.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter and not in the kitchen. Ten kilos of salted cabbage gives up two litres in half an hour and the tray is a soup.
method.l: Ka mluh bad ka soh niamtra ha ka jaka ba ai, ym ha ka rukom shet. Ki 10 kilo bandakobi bad ka mluh ki ai ar litar ha shynna por, bad ka tre ka long ka soup.

method.en: Toss with the hands and not a ladle. A dohkhlieh turned with a ladle bruises and the whole tray weeps within twenty minutes.
method.l: Kylla ia ka da ki kti, ym da ka kailoi. Ka dohkhlieh ba la kylla da ka kailoi ka nam, bad ka tre baroh ka pynum ha ar phew minit.

recipes.why: Ten rupees a head, no fire and no oil. Bandakobi keeps ten days in a store room where a green leaf keeps two, and a dohkhlieh is what a Khasi plate is not complete without.
recipes.why_l: Shiphew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka ding bad ka tyrso um. Ka bandakobi ka sah khadshiphew sngi ha ka dep ha kaba ka sla bathiang ka sah ar, bad ym bad ka dohkhlieh ka plet Khasi kam biang.

recipes.name: Dohkhlieh Soh Kaji
recipes.sub: Cucumber sliced thick with black salt and roasted cumin
recipes.sub_l: Ka soh kaji ba la ot bajrong bad ka mluh iong bad ka jeera baem

method.en: Slice it thick, a finger deep. A thin slice of soh kaji weeps in four minutes and twelve kilos of it is a bowl of water.
method.l: Ot ia ka bajrong, katba ka shi kti. Ka jingot soh kaji bariw ka pynum ha saw minit, bad ki 12 kilo ki long ka kchu um.

method.en: Taste the stem end before it goes in. One bitter soh kaji in twelve kilos is found by four devotees and remembered by all of them.
method.l: Sngew ia ka bneng mrad shaphang ba ka dep. Ka shi soh kaji bakhaw ha ki 12 kilo ka shah shem da ki saw nongbam, bad ka shah kynmaw da ki baroh.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter and never in the kitchen. Salted early, twelve kilos gives up three litres and there is nothing to pick up.
method.l: Ka mluh bad ka soh niamtra ha ka jaka ba ai, ym shym ha ka rukom shet. Haba la buh ka mluh bathuh, ki 12 kilo ki ai lai litar, bad ym don kaei ban pdiang.

method.en: Roast the cumin dry and crush it coarse. A powdered jeera disappears and the tray tastes of lemon and nothing else.
method.l: Em ia ka jeera basngai bad nam bajrong. Ka jeera babadup ka duh, bad ka tre ka sngew tang kum ka soh niamtra bad ym kaei kaei shuh.

recipes.why: Nine rupees a head, no fire and no oil. In Jymmang the soh kaji is twenty rupees a kilo at Iewduh and a cold tray on a hot day empties before the ja does.
recipes.why_l: Khyndai tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka ding bad ka tyrso um. Ha u Jymmang ka soh kaji ka long ar phew tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh, bad ka tre basyllok ha ka sngi bakhraw ka lotho shaphang ka ja.

recipes.name: Ja ka Kheer
recipes.sub: Rice reduced in milk with bay leaf and cardamom
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja bapynduh ha ka dud bad ka sla tejpat bad ka elaichi

method.en: Wash the rice, drain it, and fry it in the ghee two minutes before the milk goes on.
method.l: Sait ïa ka ja, pynduh um, bad syied ha ka ghee ar minit shuwa ba buh ka dud.

method.en: Boil the milk down by a fifth before the rice goes in, scraping the bottom throughout.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka dud shi bynta san shuwa ba buh ka ja, bad kher ïa ka khyndew lyngba ka por baroh.

method.en: Scrape every two minutes without exception. A burnt bottom cannot be lifted out again.
method.l: Kher man ar minit khlem sngiah. Ka khyndew batyllet ka ym lah kyllon noh biang.

method.en: Simmer forty-five minutes until the grain has broken and the milk coats a ladle.
method.l: Pynkhlaw sngur saw phew san minit haduh ba ka symbai ka brop bad ka dud ka ïai ha ka kiew.

method.en: Sugar only at the end; sugar in early stops the rice softening and it stays chalky.
method.l: Ka sini tang ha kaba kut; ka sini babuh lyngkot ka pynsngiah ïa ka ja ban jem bad ka sah kum ka maw.

method.en: Cardamom and fried nuts off the fire, and slacken with hot milk if it is held.
method.l: Ka elaichi bad ki soh basyied hadien ba pynsngiah, bad pynjem da ka dud bashyiap lada buh slem.

recipes.why: Milk is the one thing Shillong has cheaply that the plains do not, and this is the festival sweet a Meghalaya kitchen can afford at scale. Bay leaf rather than saffron, because the state grows the one and imports the other.
recipes.why_l: Ka dud ka dei ka jingdonkam marwei kaba ka Shillong ka don bakhyndiat dam ba ka madan ka ym don, bad kane ka jingbam basngai jong ka sngi bakhraw ka lah ka iing thung Meghalaya. Ka sla tejpat, ym ka saffron, naba ka ri ka bit ïa kawei bad ka thied ïa kawei pat.

recipes.name: Sohiong bad Dud
recipes.sub: Black cherry crushed through sweetened hung curd
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohiong badup ha ka dud bakyrtong basngai

method.en: Hang the curd four hours in a cool room; do not press or squeeze the cloth.
method.l: Kyrtong ïa ka dud saw por ha ka iing basyiar; wat pyllet lymne dup ïa ka jaiñ.

method.en: Simmer the sohiong ten minutes with a cup of water and pull the stones out by hand.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka sohiong shi phew minit bad shi kop um bad kyllon noh ïa ki symbai da ka kti.

method.en: Cool that pulp completely. Warm fruit in curd splits the whole tray.
method.l: Pynsyiar bha ïa kata ka doh. Ka soh bashyiap ha ka dud ka pynïai ïa ka tray baroh.

method.en: Beat the ground sugar into the hung curd until it holds a peak.
method.l: Pyllun ïa ka sini badup hapoh ka dud bakyrtong haduh ba ka ieng ba jrong.

method.en: Ripple the cold pulp through it rather than mixing it in; the colour is the dish.
method.l: Buh ïa ka doh basyiar lyngba ka dud, ym sumar baroh; ka rong ka dei ka jingbam.

recipes.why: Sohiong falls in August and is gone in three weeks, and it stains everything it touches a deep purple that no other fruit here gives. It needs no fire, which matters on a festival morning when every burner is spoken for.
recipes.why_l: Ka sohiong ka hap ha August bad ka jah hapoh lai taiew, bad ka pyniong ïa baroh kaba ka shim ha ka rong ba iong-saw ba ym don kawei pat ka soh ka ai. Ka ym donkam ding, kaba dei ha ka step jong ka sngi bakhraw ba baroh ki ding ki la don kam.

recipes.name: Halwa Ja
recipes.sub: Rice flour roasted long in ghee and brought together with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup ja basyied slem ha ka ghee bad bapynlang bad ka gur

method.en: Roast the rice flour in the ghee on a low flame twenty-five minutes, stirring throughout.
method.l: Syied ïa ka badup ja ha ka ghee ha ka ding bakhyndiat shi phew san minit, bad pyllun lyngba ka por baroh.

method.en: It is ready when it smells of biscuit and moves as one mass in the pan.
method.l: Ka la biang lada ka rngi kum ka biskut bad ka kylla kum shi tylli ha ka tawa.

method.en: Under-roasted flour tastes of paste however much jaggery goes in afterwards.
method.l: Ka badup babym syied bha ka rngi kum ka badup jam lada buh bun gur hadien ruh.

method.en: Melt the jaggery in the water, strain it through a cloth, and keep it hot.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka gur ha ka um, sait da ka jaiñ, bad buh ba shyiap.

method.en: Pour the hot syrup into the hot flour in a thin stream, stirring hard the whole time.
method.l: Kynshew ïa ka um gur bashyiap sha ka badup bashyiap ha shi lynti bajem, bad pyllun ba eh lyngba ka por.

method.en: Cold syrup into hot flour lumps at once and the pan cannot be saved.
method.l: Ka um gur basyiar sha ka badup bashyiap ka jam mynta bad ka tawa ka ym lah pyllait.

recipes.why: Rice flour rather than semolina, because semolina is bought in and rice flour is not. It holds three days covered, which makes it the sweet to cook the day before a large programme.
recipes.why_l: Ka badup ja, ym ka suji, naba ka suji ka dei ban thied na bar bad ka badup ja ka ym. Ka shong lai sngi bakhang, kata ka pynlong ïa ka ban long ka jingbam basngai ban thung ha ka sngi shuwa jong ka kam bakhraw.

recipes.name: Halwa Sooji
recipes.sub: Semolina roasted long in ghee and cooked in a hot syrup
recipes.sub_l: Ka sooji ba la em slem ha ka ghee bad la shet ha ka um chini bakhraw

method.en: Roast the sooji in the ghee twenty-five minutes on a low flame. This is the whole dish; a fifteen-minute halwa tastes of raw semolina whatever is added after.
method.l: Em ia ka sooji ha ka ghee ar phew san minit halor ka ding basuk. Kane ka dei ka jingbam baroh; ka halwa jong ki khadhynsan minit ka sngew kum ka sooji baiar, la la buh kaei kaei ynda.

method.en: The syrup goes in boiling and never cold. Cold syrup on hot sooji seizes and twenty kilos is lumps that no ladle will break.
method.l: Ka um chini ka dep kaba pyndih, ym shym basyllok. Ka um chini basyllok halor ka sooji bakhraw ka bat, bad ki 20 kilo ki long ki jingbat kiba ym don ka kailoi ban pynkhih.

method.en: Two parts syrup to one of sooji by weight. Less and the halwa is dry by the time the vessel crosses the yard.
method.l: Ar bynta um chini ha shi bynta sooji da ka jingjrong. Lada ka duna, ka halwa ka long basngai haduh ba ka blang ka pyrshah ia ka kper.

method.en: Off the fire, lid on, ten minutes. A halwa that has not stood is gritty at the centre and twenty kilos cannot be recooked.
method.l: Na ka ding, buh ka jingkhap, khadar minit. Ka halwa kaba ym la shong ka long kum ka mawsiang ha ka dohnud, bad ki 20 kilo ki ym lah ban shet biang.

recipes.why: Thirty-two rupees a head, and the ghee is most of it. It is the sweet for a Shad Suk Mynsiem; on an ordinary day a pumaloi carries the hall for eleven.
recipes.why_l: Lai phew ar tyngka ha u briew, bad ka ghee ka dei ka bun jong ka. Ka dei ka jingbam basngai na ka Shad Suk Mynsiem; ha ka sngi basngai ka pumaloi ka bah ia ka iing ha khadhynriew.

recipes.name: Kheer Semiya
recipes.sub: Vermicelli roasted in ghee and cooked in reduced milk
recipes.sub_l: Ka semiya ba la em ha ka ghee bad la shet ha ka dud ba la pynduna

method.en: Roast the semiya in ghee until it is the colour of a bay leaf. Unroasted, a kilo and a half turns twenty-two litres to glue.
method.l: Em ia ka semiya ha ka ghee haduh ba ka long kum ka rong ka sla tejpatta. Haba ym la em, ka shi kilo bad shynna ka pynlong ia ki 22 litar kum ka jingshet.

method.en: A kilo and a half in sixteen litres and no more. Semiya swells to four times its weight and two kilos is a vessel that cannot be poured.
method.l: Shi kilo bad shynna ha 16 litar, ym shuh. Ka semiya ka heh saw sien ka jingjrong jong ka, bad ki ar kilo ki long ka blang kaba ym lah ban thoh.

method.en: The semiya goes in only after the milk has reduced by a fifth. Added to full milk it swells before the milk has thickened.
method.l: Ka semiya ka dep tang ynda ka dud ka la duna da ka san bynta. Haba la buh ha ka dud babiang ka heh shaphang ba ka dud ka long bajrong.

method.en: Take it off looser than it should be. Semiya drinks for twenty minutes in the vessel and a kheer that is right in the kitchen is a pudding in the hall.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka bariw shuh ban ka dei. Ka semiya ka dih ar phew minit ha ka blang, bad ka kheer kaba beit ha ka rukom shet ka long ka pudding ha ka iing.

recipes.why: Thirty-five rupees a head. A kilo and a half of semiya does what four kilos of ja would, and it is ready in half the time a ja kheer takes.
recipes.why_l: Lai phew san tyngka ha u briew. Ka shi kilo bad shynna semiya ka leh kaba ki saw kilo ja kin leh, bad ka biang ha shynna ka por ba ka kheer ja ka lam.

recipes.name: Halwa Pathaw
recipes.sub: Pumpkin grated, fried dry in ghee and cooked down with milk
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la khriah, la syied basngai ha ka ghee bad la shet bad ka dud

method.en: Grate it and fry it dry in ghee until the raw smell is gone before any milk. Grated straight into milk it curdles five litres.
method.l: Khriah ia ka bad syied basngai ha ka ghee haduh ba ka jingsngi baiar ka duh, shaphang ba don ka dud. Haba la khriah shu sha ka dud ka pynpat ia ki san litar.

method.en: Squeeze the grated pathaw dry before it goes in the ghee. Twelve kilos gives up two litres and that water is why a halwa refuses to thicken.
method.l: Hiar ia ka pathaw ba la khriah basngai shaphang ba ka dep ha ka ghee. Ki 12 kilo ki ai ar litar, bad kata ka um ka dei ka daw ba ka halwa kam kwah ban long bajrong.

method.en: No sugar until the pathaw is completely soft. Sugar early and the pumpkin stays in shreds and never becomes a halwa.
method.l: Ym don ka chini haduh ba ka pathaw ka long baduna babiang. Ka chini bathuh bad ka pathaw ka sah bariw bariw bad kan ym long ka halwa.

method.en: Stir the bottom every four minutes once the milk is in. Grated pumpkin sinks and five litres of milk burns under it with no smell reaching the cook.
method.l: Kylla ia ka khlieh rud ha ka saw minit baroh ynda ka dud ka dep. Ka pathaw ba la khriah ka shong harud, bad ki san litar dud ki duh ha khnong ka ym bad ka jingsngi ban poi sha u nongshet.

recipes.why: Twenty-four rupees a head. Twelve kilos of pathaw takes the place of four kilos of sooji and a kilo of sugar, and in Risaw it costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew saw tyngka ha u briew. Ki 12 kilo pathaw ki dep ha ka jaka ki saw kilo sooji bad ka shi kilo chini, bad ha u Risaw ki dam tang ka jingbah.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
recipes.sub: Milk powder balls fried slow and soaked in a thin syrup
recipes.sub_l: Ki jingnam badup dud ba la syied basuk bad la buh ha ka um chini bariw

method.en: Bind the dough and fry it inside twenty minutes. A milk powder dough left standing goes slack and the balls flatten in the ghee.
method.l: Bat ia ka jingnam bad syied ia ka ha ki ar phew minit. Ka jingnam badup dud ba la pynsah ka long baduna, bad ki jingnam ki long bariw ha ka ghee.

method.en: Fry on the lowest flame that will keep them moving. A hot ghee browns the outside in a minute and the centre is raw milk powder at the counter.
method.l: Syied halor ka ding kaba suk tam kaba pynsah ia ki ban iaid. Ka ghee bakhraw ka pynsaw ia shabar ha shi minit, bad ka dohnud ka long ka badup dud baiar ha ka jaka ba ai.

method.en: The syrup is one thread and no more. A thick syrup will not go into the jamun and six hundred of them sit in it dry.
method.l: Ka um chini ka long shi snier tang, ym shuh. Ka um chini bajrong kan ym dep sha ka jamun, bad ki hynriew shiteph ki shong ha ka basngai.

method.en: The syrup must be warm and the jamun hot when they meet. Cold syrup on a hot jamun and the skin closes; nothing goes in after that.
method.l: Ka um chini ka dei ban long bakhraw bad ka jamun bakhraw haba ki ïatiew. Ka um chini basyllok halor ka jamun bakhraw bad ka snier ka khang; ym don kaei kaba dep ynda kata.

recipes.why: Fifty-seven rupees a head. Every ingredient comes up the road and it shows in the price, so this is for a Shad Suk Mynsiem and a wedding and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: San phew hynniew tyngka ha u briew. Ka jingbuh baroh ka wan lyngba ka lynti bad ka shem ha ka dam; kum kata kane ka dei na ka Shad Suk Mynsiem bad ka jingiakhun tang.

recipes.name: Barfi Dud
recipes.sub: Milk reduced to a solid, set in a tray and cut in squares
recipes.sub_l: Ka dud ba la pynduna haduh ba ka long bajrong, la buh ha ka tre bad la ot

method.en: Twenty-four litres of milk gives eight kilos of barfi and no more. A kitchen that expects ten has not reduced it far enough.
method.l: Ki 24 litar dud ki ai phra kilo barfi, ym shuh. Ka rukom shet kaba ap shiphew ka ym la pynduna ia ka biang.

method.en: Stir the bottom without stopping for the last forty minutes. Milk at that stage burns in ninety seconds and twenty-four litres is lost in one look away.
method.l: Kylla ia ka khlieh rud ym bad ka jingthang na ki saw phew minit baneh. Ka dud ha kata ka jaka ka duh ha khyndai phew second, bad ki 24 litar ki duh ha shi jingkhmih bapher.

method.en: Sugar only in the last fifteen minutes. Added early it browns the whole vessel and a brown barfi is a burnt one to whoever eats it.
method.l: Ka chini ha ki khadhynsan minit baneh tang. Haba la buh bathuh ka pynsaw ia ka blang baroh, bad ka barfi basaw ka long kaba duh ia uno uno ba bam ia ka.

method.en: Pour it into a greased tray and cut it while it is still warm. A barfi cut cold cracks across every square.
method.l: Thoh ia ka ha ka tre batyrso bad ot ia ka katba ka dang bakhraw. Ka barfi ba la ot basyllok ka pat lyngba ka jingot baroh.

recipes.why: Forty-three rupees a head and it keeps four days without a fridge. A Shillong dairy sells twenty-four litres for the price of six kilos of khoya and this is better than any khoya bought.
recipes.why_l: Saw phew lai tyngka ha u briew, bad ka sah saw sngi ym bad ka fridge. Ka iing dud Shillong ka die ki 24 litar ha ka dam ki hynriew kilo khoya, bad kane ka bha ban ka khoya baroh kaba la thied.

recipes.name: Nei ka Laddu
recipes.sub: Black sesame and jaggery rolled hot, keeps a month in a tin
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei-iong bad ka gur babiang ha ba shyiap, bashong shi bnai ha ka tin

method.en: Roast the sesame in one-kilo lots on a low flame, moving it without stopping.
method.l: Syied ïa ka nei ha ki bynta shi kilo ha ka ding bakhyndiat, bad pyllun khlem sngiah.

method.en: It burns about twenty seconds after it colours, so take it off early.
method.l: Ka tyllet shi phew second hadien ba ka saw, kumta pynsngiah lyngkot.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the water and ghee and boil it to the soft-ball stage, 118°C.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka gur bad ka um bad ka ghee bad pynkhlaw haduh 118°C.

method.en: Test a drop in cold water; short of the stage the laddus will not hold their shape.
method.l: Kylli shi thop ha ka um basyiar; lada em, ki laddu ki ym kem ïa ka rukom jong ki.

method.en: Take it off the fire, stir the sesame and cardamom in, and roll at once with oiled palms.
method.l: Pynsngiah na ka ding, sumar ïa ka nei bad ka elaichi, bad biang mynta da ki kti batulsi.

method.en: You have four minutes before it sets in the pan. Have six people ready to roll.
method.l: Phi don saw minit shuwa ba ka kem ha ka tawa. Buh hynriew ngut kiba biang ban dang ap.

recipes.why: Black sesame is the flavour this state knows best and jaggery is the cheapest sugar on the hill. It keeps a month without a fridge, so it is the sweet to carry to an outstation programme.
recipes.why_l: Ka nei-iong ka dei ka jingsngew kaba kane ka ri ka tip bha tam bad ka gur ka dei ka sini bakhyndiat dam tam ha ka lum. Ka shong shi bnai khlem fridge, kumta ka dei ka jingbam basngai ban bah sha ka kam ha bar.

recipes.name: Ja Muri ka Chikki
recipes.sub: Puffed rice set in hard jaggery and broken into sheets
recipes.sub_l: Ka ja muri bakem ha ka gur ba eh bad babrop ban long ki tylli

method.en: Crisp the puffed rice on a dry tawa two minutes and keep it warm beside the fire.
method.l: Pynsngai ïa ka ja muri ha ka tawa basngai ar minit bad buh ba shyiap hakhmat ka ding.

method.en: Cold puffed rice pulls the heat out of the syrup and it sets before it is mixed.
method.l: Ka ja muri basyiar ka shim ïa ka jingshyiap na ka gur bad ka kem shuwa ba sumar.

method.en: Melt the jaggery with the ghee and boil it to the hard-crack stage, 145°C.
method.l: Pynduh ïa ka gur bad ka ghee bad pynkhlaw haduh 145°C.

method.en: A drop in cold water must shatter, not bend. Softer than that and the tin sticks together.
method.l: Shi thop ha ka um basyiar ka dei ban brop, ym ban kynjah. Lada bajem, ka tin baroh ka ïai lang.

method.en: Stir the rice, sesame and salt in and pour onto an oiled steel table at once.
method.l: Sumar ïa ka ja, ka nei bad ka mluh bad kynshew mynta halor ka tebul batulsi.

method.en: Roll thin, score it warm, and break it only when it is cold.
method.l: Biang bajem, ot ki rekord ha ba dang shyiap, bad brop tang lada ka la syiar.

recipes.why: The cheapest thing in this book that can be handed to a person rather than served on a plate, at ₹10 a piece. It keeps six weeks sealed and is what goes out at a gate programme.
recipes.why_l: Kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot kaba lah ai ha ka kti jong u briew, ym ban ai ha ka ding, ₹10 ha shi tylli. Ka shong hynriew taiew bakhang bad kane ka dei kaba mih ha ka kam ha ka ksuid.

recipes.name: Sohphie ka Titaura
recipes.sub: Bay berry pulped, sweetened and dried into sour lozenges
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohphie badup, basngai bad basngai ha ka sngi ban long ki tylli bamuriaw

method.en: Simmer the berries in just enough water until the skins split, about fifteen minutes.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ki soh ha ka um bakhyndiat haduh ba ki snieh ki ïai, shi phew san minit.

method.en: Rub the pulp off the stones through a coarse sieve by hand.
method.l: Shet noh ïa ka doh na ki symbai lyngba ka chalni bakhraw da ka kti.

method.en: Never use a machine; a cracked stone puts in a bitterness no sugar will cover.
method.l: Wat pyndonkam mesin; ka symbai baïai ka buh ka jingkhaw ba ym don sini ban khang.

method.en: Cook the pulp with sugar and salt until it leaves the pan as one sheet.
method.l: Thung ïa ka doh bad ka sini bad ka mluh haduh ba ka phah ïa ka tawa kum shi tylli.

method.en: Spread a finger thick on oiled trays, score it into squares, and dry three days in the sun.
method.l: Kynshew shi kti bakhraw ha ki tray batulsi, ot ki rekord, bad pynsngai lai sngi ha ka sngi.

method.en: Bring the trays in every evening; a night of dew undoes a whole day of sun.
method.l: Wallam ïa ki tray hapoh man ka miet; shi miet ka um miet ka pynbylla ïa ka sngi baroh.

recipes.why: Sohphie is sold on every roadside for two weeks in May and then not seen for a year. Dried into titaura it keeps that fortnight's picking on the shelf until the following May.
recipes.why_l: Ka sohphie ka die ha man ka lynti ar taiew ha May bad nangta ka ym ïohi shuh shi snem. Lada pynlong titaura, ka jingpyrduh jong kata ar taiew ka shong ha ka ïing haduh ka May kaba wan.

recipes.name: Nei-iong ka Laddu
recipes.sub: Black sesame roasted and pressed into jaggery by hand
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei-iong ba la em bad la nam sha ka gur da ka kti

method.en: Roast the nei-iong until the seeds jump and take it off at once. Black sesame past that point is bitter and four kilos cannot be salvaged.
method.l: Em ia ka nei-iong haduh ba ki symbai ki iar bad rah noh mynta. Ka nei-iong ba palat kata ka sngewkhaw, bad ki saw kilo ki ym lah ban pynim biang.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it. Field gur carries sand and grit in a laddu is what is remembered of it.
method.l: Pynduh ia ka gur bapher bad sait ia ka. Ka gur rep ka rah ka mawsiang, bad ka mawsiang ha ka laddu ka dei kaba shah kynmaw jong ka.

method.en: A pinch of salt and the whole thing tastes of sesame instead of jaggery. Thirty grams in seven and a half kilos is the measure.
method.l: Ka mluh khyndiat bad ka jingbam baroh ka sngew kum ka nei ym kum ka gur. Lai phew gram ha ki hynniew bad shynna kilo ki dei ka jingbishar.

method.en: Press each one in the fist and do not roll it in the palm. A nei-iong laddu has to be squeezed to hold and a rolled one is dust in the tin by the morning.
method.l: Nam ia ka shi tylli ha ka kti bakhang, ym dei ban pynwir ia ka ha ka kti. Ka laddu nei-iong ka dei ban shah nam ban bat, bad kaba la pynwir ka long ka mawsiang ha ka tin haduh ka step.

recipes.why: Nineteen rupees a head and it keeps three weeks in a tin. Nei-iong grows on the Jaintia slopes where nothing else will, and this is the sweet that puts a hill crop on a temple plate.
recipes.why_l: Khadkhyndai tyngka ha u briew, bad ka sah lai taiew ha ka tin. Ka nei-iong ka mih ha ki lum Jaintia ha kaba ym don kaei kaei bapher ba mih, bad kane ka dei ka jingbam basngai kaba buh ka rep lum halor ka plet mandir.

recipes.name: Nei ka Chikki
recipes.sub: White sesame set in a hard jaggery syrup and cut in a tray
recipes.sub_l: Ka nei basaw ba la buh ha ka um gur bajrong bad la ot ha ka tre

method.en: Take the syrup to the hard crack and test it in cold water. A soft syrup gives a chikki that bends and seven kilos of it sticks together in the tin.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka um gur haduh ba ka pat bajrong bad pyndonkam ia ka ha ka um basyllok. Ka um gur baduna ka ai ka chikki kaba kup, bad ki hynniew kilo ki shet lang ha ka tin.

method.en: Warm the nei before it goes in the syrup. Cold sesame drops the temperature of the syrup and it sets before it can be spread.
method.l: Pynbakhraw ia ka nei shaphang ba ka dep ha ka um gur. Ka nei basyllok ka pynduna ia ka jingbakhraw jong ka um gur, bad ka bat shaphang ba ka lah ban pra.

method.en: Spread it on a greased stone and roll it thin at once. It sets in ninety seconds and a thick chikki cannot be bitten by anyone.
method.l: Pra ia ka halor u mawlain batyrso bad lan ia ka bariw mynta. Ka bat ha khyndai phew second, bad ka chikki bajrong ka ym shah khait da uno uno.

method.en: Score the squares while it is warm and break them when it is cold. Cut cold, seven kilos becomes a tray of shards.
method.l: Thoh ki jingot katba ka dang bakhraw bad pynpat ia ki haba ka long basyllok. Haba la ot basyllok, ki hynniew kilo ki long ka tre jingpat.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head and it keeps a month in a tin. Nei and gur are the two cheapest things a Khasi kitchen buys by the sack, and this is what they make together.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, bad ka sah shi bnai ha ka tin. Ka nei bad ka gur ki dei ki ar kajuh kiba khyndiat dam tam ba ka rukom shet Khasi ka thied da ka khaw, bad kane ka dei kaba ki pynlong lang.

recipes.name: Ja Badup ka Laddu
recipes.sub: Red rice flour roasted long in ghee and rolled with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup ja basaw ba la em slem ha ka ghee bad la pynwir bad ka gur

method.en: Roast the flour thirty minutes and not fifteen. This is the whole dish; under-roasted rice flour tastes raw and no jaggery covers it.
method.l: Em ia ka badup lai phew minit, ym khadhynsan. Kane ka dei ka jingbam baroh; ka badup ja ba ym la em biang ka sngew baiar, bad ym don ka gur ban khap ia ka.

method.en: The flame stays low the whole thirty minutes. A brown flour at fifteen minutes is a burnt flour and five kilos is thrown.
method.l: Ka ding ka sah basuk lyngba ki lai phew minit baroh. Ka badup basaw ha ki khadhynsan minit ka dei ka badup baduh, bad ki san kilo ki shah bred noh.

method.en: Melt the jaggery separately and strain it before it goes in. Field gur carries sand and grit in a laddu is what is remembered.
method.l: Pynduh ia ka gur bapher bad sait ia ka shaphang ba ka dep. Ka gur rep ka rah ka mawsiang, bad ka mawsiang ha ka laddu ka dei kaba shah kynmaw.

method.en: Roll them while the mix is still too hot for a bare hand. Cooled, rice flour and jaggery set into a slab that has to be broken with a ladle.
method.l: Pynwir ia ki katba ka jingiadei ka dang bakhraw shuh ban ka kti balotho. Haba la long basyllok, ka badup ja bad ka gur ki bat sha ka jingbat kaba dei ban pynpat da ka kailoi.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head and it keeps a fortnight in a tin. Red rice comes off a Khasi terrace and gur is the only thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: Khadphra tyngka ha u briew, bad ka sah ar taiew ha ka tin. Ka ja basaw ka mih na ka rep Khasi, bad ka gur tang ka dei kaba thied na ka.

recipes.name: Soh Niamtra ka Titaura
recipes.sub: Citrus peel boiled twice, sugared and dried three days in the sun
recipes.sub_l: Ka snier soh niamtra ba la pyndih ar sien, la buh ka chini bad la pynsngai lai sngi

method.en: Boil the peel twice in plain water and throw both waters. The first two waters carry the bitterness and a titaura made without that step cannot be eaten.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka snier ar sien ha ka um basngai bad thoh noh ki ar um baroh. Ki ar um banyngkong ki rah ia ka jingsngewkhaw, bad ka titaura ba la pynlong ym bad kata ka jingleh ka ym shah bam.

method.en: Scrape the white pith off the inside before it is sugared. The pith is the bitterness that two boilings do not take away.
method.l: Khriah noh ia ka bynta basaw shapoh shaphang ba buh ka chini. Kata ka bynta ka dei ka jingsngewkhaw kaba ki ar jingpyndih ki ym rah noh.

method.en: Three days in the sun and turn them every morning. A titaura dried in two days is soft in the middle and it moulds in the tin in a fortnight.
method.l: Lai sngi ha ka sngi bad kylla ia ki ha ka step baroh. Ka titaura ba la pynsngai ha ar sngi ka long baduna ha ka dohnud, bad ka mih ka jingdup ha ka tin ha ar taiew.

method.en: Bring them in every evening. A Shillong night is wet enough to undo a whole day of sun and by the third evening it shows.
method.l: Rah shapoh ia ki ha ka miet baroh. Ka miet Shillong ka long baum biang ban pynduh ia ka sngi babiang jong ka sngi, bad haduh ka miet balai ka shem.

recipes.why: Thirteen rupees a head and it keeps three months. The peel is what a kitchen throws after squeezing sixty litres of soh niamtra um, and six kilos of it costs nothing at all.
recipes.why_l: Khadlai tyngka ha u briew, bad ka sah lai bnai. Ka snier ka dei kaba ka rukom shet ka shah bred noh ynda la hiar ki 60 litar um soh niamtra, bad ki hynriew kilo ki ym dam ei ei.

recipes.name: Gohum ka Laddu
recipes.sub: Wheat flour roasted long in ghee and rolled with jaggery
recipes.sub_l: Ka badup gohum ba la em slem ha ka ghee bad la pynwir bad ka gur

method.en: Roast the gohum thirty-five minutes and not twenty. This is the whole dish; under-roasted flour tastes raw and no amount of gur covers it.
method.l: Em ia ka gohum lai phew san minit, ym ar phew. Kane ka dei ka jingbam baroh; ka badup ba ym la em biang ka sngew baiar, bad ka gur katno katno kan ym khap ia ka.

method.en: The flame stays low the whole thirty-five minutes. A brown gohum at fifteen minutes is a burnt gohum and five kilos is thrown.
method.l: Ka ding ka sah basuk lyngba ki lai phew san minit baroh. Ka gohum basaw ha ki khadhynsan minit ka dei ka gohum baduh, bad ki san kilo ki shah bred noh.

method.en: Melt the gur separately and strain it before it goes in. Field gur carries sand and a gritty laddu is remembered for that alone.
method.l: Pynduh ia ka gur bapher bad sait ia ka shaphang ba ka dep. Ka gur rep ka rah ka mawsiang, bad ka laddu bad ka mawsiang ka shah kynmaw tang na kata.

method.en: Roll them while the mix is still too hot for a bare hand. Cooled, gohum and gur set into a slab that has to be broken with a ladle.
method.l: Pynwir ia ki katba ka jingiadei ka dang bakhraw shuh ban ka kti balotho. Haba la long basyllok, ka gohum bad ka gur ki bat sha ka jingbat kaba dei ban pynpat da ka kailoi.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head and it keeps a fortnight in a tin. Gohum and gur are the two cheapest things a temple buys by the sack, and this is what they make together.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew tyngka ha u briew, bad ka sah ar taiew ha ka tin. Ka gohum bad ka gur ki dei ki ar kajuh kiba khyndiat dam tam ba ka mandir ka thied da ka khaw, bad kane ka dei kaba ki pynlong lang.

recipes.name: Phan Shynrai
recipes.sub: Potato cooked dry in Lakadong, made for boxing
recipes.sub_l: Ki phan bathung basngai ha ka Lakadong, bapynlong ban buh ha ka bakis

method.en: Cut every cube to the same size, two centimetres, and keep them even.
method.l: Ot ïa man ka tylli kum shi rukom, ar centimeter, bad buh ïa ki ba lang.

method.en: Parboil seven minutes, drain, and spread to steam off ten minutes before frying.
method.l: Pynkhlaw lyngkot hynniew minit, pynduh um, bad kynshew ban pynduh lyer shi phew minit shuwa ba syied.

method.en: Bloom the turmeric in the hot oil before the potato joins it.
method.l: Buh ïa ka shynrai ha ka tulsi bashyiap shuwa ba ka phan ka wan.

method.en: Fry on a high flame until the outsides are set and dry, not soft.
method.l: Syied ha ka ding bakhraw haduh ba ki bar ki eh bad ki sngai, ym bajem.

method.en: Take it off dry and spread it on trays rather than heaping it in the pot.
method.l: Kyllon noh ba sngai bad kynshew ha ki tray, ym khreh ha ka khiew.

catering.en: Cool on open trays to below 30°C before boxing; a warm lid gives fifteen minutes of steam and the cubes collapse in transit.
catering.l: Pynsyiar ha ki tray baplie haduh hapoh 30°C shuwa ba buh ha ka bakis; ka jingkhang bashyiap ka ai shi phew san minit lyer bad ki tylli ki brop ha ka lynti.

recipes.why: The dry jhur this kitchen sends out most often, because potato holds its shape four hours in a box and turmeric holds its colour. It carries no gravy, so a leaking container cannot spoil the rest of the load.
recipes.why_l: Ka jhur basngai kaba kane ka iing thung ka phah bun tam, naba ka phan ka kem ïa ka rukom saw por ha ka bakis bad ka shynrai ka kem ïa ka rong. Ka ym bah um, kumta ka bakis kaba tuid ka ym lah pynbylla ïa ki kiwei.

recipes.name: Bandakobi bad Gajor
