recipes.sub: Cabbage and carrot cooked short, still firm when the box is opened
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi bad ka gajor bathung lyngkot, dang ba eh lada plie ka bakis

method.en: Shred the cabbage a centimetre wide; fine shreds turn to water in a transport box.
method.l: Ot ïa ka bandakobi shi centimeter ka jingsan; kaba ot lyngkot eh ka long um ha ka bakis.

method.en: Cut the carrot in batons rather than rounds so it keeps some bite for four hours.
method.l: Ot ïa ka gajor bajrong, ym barit baroh, ban ka dang eh saw por.

method.en: Give the carrot three minutes in the oil before the cabbage joins it.
method.l: Ai ïa ka gajor lai minit ha ka tulsi shuwa ba ka bandakobi ka wan.

method.en: Cook uncovered on a high flame and stop while the cabbage is still loud when bitten.
method.l: Thung khlem khang ha ka ding bakhraw bad sngiah lada ka bandakobi ka dang riam ha ba bam.

method.en: Undercooking is the point; the box goes on cooking it another twenty minutes.
method.l: Ka jingthung lyngkot ka dei ka jingmut; ka bakis ka dang thung ïa ka shi phew minit pat.

catering.en: Salt draws water for the whole journey, so keep it light and send a small pot of salt separately with the box.
catering.l: Ka mluh ka shim um lyngba ka lynti baroh, kumta buh khyndiat bad phah shi tylli kop mluh ba lang bad ka bakis.

recipes.why: Cabbage and carrot are the two cheapest vegetables in Shillong all winter and both travel sound. Cooked short and salted late, this is the only leafy jhur here that survives being boxed.
recipes.why_l: Ka bandakobi bad ka gajor ki dei ki jhur bakhyndiat dam tam ha Shillong lyngba ka por basyiar bad ki ar ki lah leit jngai bha. Lada thung lyngkot bad buh mluh lyngkot, kane marwei ka jhur sla kaba lah shong ha ka bakis.

recipes.name: Pathaw ka Jhur
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked with the skin on so the cube holds
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw bathung bad ka snieh ban ka tylli ka kem

method.en: Take a firm ripe pumpkin and cut it in three-centimetre cubes with the skin left on.
method.l: Shim ïa ka pathaw ba eh bad ot ha ki tylli lai centimeter bad ai ïa ka snieh ban sah.

method.en: The skin is what holds the cube together in a box; peeled pumpkin arrives as purée.
method.l: Ka snieh ka dei kaba kem ïa ka tylli ha ka bakis; ka pathaw bakhih ka poi kum ka badup.

method.en: Crackle the fenugreek and chilli in the oil until the fenugreek is one shade darker.
method.l: Syied ïa ka methi bad ka sohmynken ha ka tulsi haduh ba ka methi ka long ba iong khyndiat.

method.en: Fenugreek taken past that is bitter, and here there is nothing for it to hide behind.
method.l: Ka methi kaba syied slem khan na kata ka khaw, bad hangne ym don ei ei ban khang ïa ka.

method.en: Add the pumpkin, cover, and cook fifteen minutes on a low flame with no water at all.
method.l: Buh ïa ka pathaw, khang, bad thung shi phew san minit ha ka ding bakhyndiat khlem um shi tylli.

method.en: Stir twice at most, with a flat paddle under the cubes rather than a ladle through them.
method.l: Pyllun bakhraw tam ar sien, da ka dieng bachep hapoh ki tylli, ym da ka kiew lyngba ki.

catering.en: Box it in a shallow layer, never more than three cubes deep — the weight of a full pot crushes the bottom layer into a gravy this dish does not have.
catering.l: Buh ha ka bakis ba jem, ym jrong khan na lai tylli — ka jingkhraw jong ka khiew badap ka pyllet ïa ka bynta ha khyndew ban long um kaba kane ka jingbam ka ym don.

recipes.why: Pumpkin keeps two months whole in a store room without a fridge, so this is the dish to have in reserve for a programme confirmed at short notice. It is also the one sweet-tasting jhur here.
recipes.why_l: Ka pathaw baroh ka shong ar bnai ha ka iing jingbuh khlem fridge, kumta kane ka dei ka jingbam ban buh ïa ka kam kaba ong lyngkot. Kane ruh ka dei ka jhur marwei kaba rngi basngai hangne.

recipes.name: Paneer bad Matar
recipes.sub: Paneer and green peas in a light tomato gravy
recipes.sub_l: Ka paneer bad ki matar bathiang ha ka jhur jaiur baduna

method.en: Peas in the last four minutes and never at the start. A pea cooked twenty minutes is grey and four kilos of grey peas is seen from the door.
method.l: Ki matar ha ki saw minit baneh, ym shym ha kaba sdang. Ka matar ba la shet ar phew minit ka long barongkhraw, bad ki saw kilo matar barongkhraw ki shah shem na ka jingkhang.

method.en: Only six hundred grams of cashew here, not the kilo a butter masala takes. A paneer bad matar should be thin enough to see the peas through.
method.l: Hynriew shiteph gram kaju tang hangne, ym ka shi kilo ba ka butter masala ka lam. Ka paneer bad matar ka dei ban long bariw biang ban shem ki matar lyngba ka.

method.en: Hold the cut paneer in warm salted water until the gravy is ready. Left dry on a tray four kilos hardens at the edges within the hour.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka paneer ba la ot ha ka um bakhraw bad ka mluh haduh ba ka jhur baum ka biang. Haba la pynsah basngai halor ka tre, ki saw kilo ki long bajrong ha ki snier ha shi por.

method.en: Take the vessel off before the paneer has been in five minutes. It goes on cooking in the gravy all the way to the hall.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka blang shaphang ba ka paneer ka la sah san minit ha ka. Ka dang shet ha ka jhur baum lyngba ka lynti baroh sha ka iing.

recipes.why: Forty-nine rupees a head. It is the guest dish a kitchen makes when a butter masala is beyond the day's money, and four kilos of peas does the work of two of paneer.
recipes.why_l: Saw phew khyndai tyngka ha u briew. Ka dei ka jingbam nongwan kaba ka rukom shet ka pynlong haba ka butter masala ka palat ka pisa jong ka sngi, bad ki saw kilo matar ki leh ia ka kam ki ar kilo paneer.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy, no onion and no garlic
recipes.sub_l: Ka paneer ha ka jhur jaiur bad kaju, ym don ka piaz bad ka lasun

method.en: Soak the cashew an hour and grind it with the tomato. The cashew does the whole job an onion base would do and there is no honest substitute cheaper than this.
method.l: Buh ki kaju ha ka um shi por bad kroh ia ki lang bad ki jaiur. Ki kaju ki leh ia ka kam baroh ba ka piaz kan leh, bad ym don ka jinglap bashisha kaba khyndiat dam ban kane.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the butter goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and a spoon of sugar only hides it for a minute.
method.l: Shet ia ka jingnam jaiur ar phew san minit shaphang ba ka butter ka dep. Ka jaiur ba ym la shet biang ka sngewthiang, bad ka spun chini ka khap ia ka shi minit tang.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Six kilos boiled in gravy is six kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Ka paneer ka dep saw minit shaphang ba ai, ym bathuh. Ki hynriew kilo ba la pyndih ha ka jhur baum ki long hynriew kilo rabar ha ka jaka ba ai.

method.en: Cream off the fire and stirred in from the side. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-eight litres cannot be brought back.
method.l: Ka cream na ka ding bad la kylla na ka liang. Ka cream sha ka jhur baum kaba pyndih ka pat, bad ki 28 litar ki ym lah ban pynwan phai.

recipes.why: Sixty-five rupees a head, the dearest dish in this book. Paneer, cashew, butter and cream all come up the road, so this is for a wedding and for a Shad Suk Mynsiem and nothing else.
recipes.why_l: Hynriew phew san tyngka ha u briew, ka jingbam kaba dam jrong tam ha kane ka kot. Ka paneer, ki kaju, ka butter bad ka cream baroh ki wan lyngba ka lynti; kum kata kane ka dei na ka jingiakhun bad ka Shad Suk Mynsiem tang.

recipes.name: Rajma ka Jhur
recipes.sub: Kidney beans cooked soft in a tomato gravy with ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ki rajma ba la shet baduna ha ka jhur jaiur bad ka sying

method.en: Soak the rajma twelve hours and cook it in fresh water. The soaking water is what makes a rajma hard on the stomach and it costs nothing to throw.
method.l: Buh ia ki rajma ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ki ha ka um bathymmai. Ka um kaba la buh ia ki ka dei kaba pynlong ia ka rajma bajrong ha ka kpoh, bad kam dam ei ei ban thoh noh ia ka.

method.en: Cook it until a quarter of the beans break by themselves. That quarter thickens thirty litres and no flour is wanted in a rajma.
method.l: Shet ia ka haduh ba ka saw bynta jong ki rajma ki pat da ki lade. Kata ka saw bynta ka pynlong ia ki 30 litar bajrong, bad ym donkam ia ka badup ha ka rajma.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a rajma hardens and two more hours on the fire will not save it.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ka rajma ka long baduna. Haba la buh bathuh, ka rajma ka long bajrong, bad ar por shuh halor ka ding kin ym pynim ia ka.

method.en: Plenty of ginger, more than seems right. In a kitchen with no onion and no garlic the sying is the whole base of the gravy.
method.l: Ka sying ba bun, bun shuh ban kaba khmih babeit. Ha ka rukom shet kaba ym don ka piaz bad ka lasun, ka sying ka dei ka basan baroh jong ka jhur baum.

recipes.why: Thirty-three rupees a head. It is the dish a Shillong temple puts out when north Indian guests are on the list, and five kilos of rajma holds a hall longer than any other vessel here.
recipes.why_l: Lai phew lai tyngka ha u briew. Ka dei ka jingbam kaba ka mandir Shillong ka ai haba ki nongwan bri ki don halor ka dienjat, bad ki san kilo rajma ki bat ia ka iing baslem ban ka blang baroh bapher hangne.

recipes.name: Chana ka Jhur
recipes.sub: White chana cooked soft in a tomato gravy with tea leaf for colour
recipes.sub_l: Ki chana basaw ba la shet baduna ha ka jhur jaiur bad ka sla sha na ka rong

method.en: Tie forty grams of tea leaf in a cloth and boil it with the chana. It is the whole colour of a chana jhur and it costs four rupees.
method.l: Bat saw phew gram sla sha ha ka jaiñ bad pyndih ia ka lang bad ki chana. Kata ka dei ka rong baroh jong ka jhur chana, bad ka dam saw tyngka.

method.en: Soak them twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water with the cloth in it. Fresh water gives a pale vessel however much tea is used.
method.l: Buh ia ki ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ki ha kata ka um lang bad ka jaiñ ha ka. Ka um bathymmai ka ai ka blang basaw, la la pyndonkam ka sha katno katno.

method.en: Amchur and not lemon. Lemon in a chana jhur goes flat within the hour; amchur holds the sourness until the vessel is empty.
method.l: Ka amchur, ym ka soh niamtra. Ka soh niamtra ha ka jhur chana ka long basngai ha shi por; ka amchur ka bat ia ka jingsngewthiang haduh ba ka blang ka lotho.

method.en: Salt only after the chana is soft. Salted early it hardens and no amount of time on the fire brings it back.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ki chana ki long baduna. Haba la buh bathuh ki long bajrong, bad ka por katno katno halor ka ding kan ym pynwan phai ia ki.

recipes.why: Twenty-nine rupees a head. Chana is the cheapest thing on this shelf that a north Indian guest recognises, and five kilos holds a hall to the evening.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew khyndai tyngka ha u briew. Ki chana ki dei kaba khyndiat dam tam halor kane ka jaka kaba u nongwan bri u tip, bad ki san kilo ki bat ia ka iing haduh ka miet.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
recipes.sub: Paneer and gram flour balls dropped into a cashew gravy
recipes.sub_l: Ki jingnam paneer bad badup chana ba la buh sha ka jhur kaju

method.en: Grate the paneer and knead it with the besan until it takes a ball without a crack. A cracked kofta opens in the ghee and five kilos of paneer is in the kadai.
method.l: Khriah ia ka paneer bad nam ia ka bad ka badup chana haduh ba ka pdiang ka jingnam ym bad ka jingpat. Ka kofta bapat ka pynkhang lade ha ka ghee, bad ki san kilo paneer ki dep ha ka kadai.

method.en: Fry the kofta on a medium flame and never hot. A hot ghee browns the outside while the besan inside is still raw.
method.l: Syied ki kofta halor ka ding bahapdeng, ym shym bakhraw. Ka ghee bakhraw ka pynsaw ia shabar katba ka badup chana shapoh ka dang iar.

method.en: The kofta go into the gravy at the counter and not in the kitchen. Five minutes in the vessel and they are gone; there is nothing left to serve.
method.l: Ki kofta ki dep sha ka jhur baum ha ka jaka ba ai, ym ha ka rukom shet. San minit ha ka blang bad ki duh; ym don kaei kaba sah ban ai.

method.en: Cream off the fire. Cream into a boiling gravy splits and twenty-six litres of it cannot be brought back.
method.l: Ka cream na ka ding. Ka cream sha ka jhur baum kaba pyndih ka pat, bad ki 26 litar ki ym lah ban pynwan phai.

recipes.why: Sixty-two rupees a head. It is the one dish in this book that needs a cook standing at a kadai for an hour, and a Khasi wedding is the only day that hour is available.
recipes.why_l: Hynriew phew ar tyngka ha u briew. Ka dei ka shi jingbam ha kane ka kot kaba donkam u nongshet ban ïeng ha ka kadai shi por, bad ka jingiakhun Khasi tang ka dei ka sngi ba kata ka por ka don.

recipes.name: Pathaw bad Nei-iong
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked down in ground black sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw bad ka nei-iong badup

method.en: Roast the sesame until the seeds begin to jump and take it off then. A minute more and the whole vessel turns bitter.
method.l: Syied ïa ka nei haduh ba ka kynjah, bad pynsngiah. Shi minit shuh bad ka long ka bakhia.

method.en: Grind it warm with a little water to a loose black paste.
method.l: Dup ïa ka da ka um khyndiat haduh ba ka long ka masala baiong.

method.en: Cook the pumpkin with the tomato, chilli and salt covered, with no water at all.
method.l: Pyllait ïa ka pathaw bad ka sohkhlia, sohmynken bad mluh, khang, khlem um.

method.en: Stir the sesame paste in when the pumpkin gives, and simmer ten minutes. There is no ghee and no milk in this — the sesame is the fat.
method.l: Buh ïa ka masala nei-iong ha ba ka pathaw ka jem, bad pyllait shi phew minit. Ym don ghee, ym don dud — ka nei ka dei ka jingthiah.

recipes.why: Doh-neiiong is what the state is known for, and the black sesame in it is doing all the work. On pumpkin the same paste gives a full dish for four hundred rupees less, and there is nothing in it a vegan devotee has to leave.
recipes.why_l: Ka nei-iong ka dei kaba trei baroh ha ka doh-neiiong. Halor ka pathaw kata kata ka masala ka ai ka jingbam babha da ka dam bakhyndiat, bad ym don ei ei ba dei ban leh noh.

recipes.name: Usoi bad Rymbai
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot and fresh beans, cooked dry in oil
recipes.sub_l: Ka usoi bad ki rymbai, basngai ha ka tulsi

method.en: Boil the fresh shoot twice in fresh water, twenty minutes each time, and throw both waters away. This is not a step to shorten.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ïa ka usoi ar sien ha ka um bathymmai, bad theh noh ïa ka um baroh ar. Kane kam dei ban pynkhyndiat.

method.en: Snap the beans by hand rather than cutting them, so they tear along their own line and take the seasoning.
method.l: Brop ïa ki rymbai da ka kti, ym ot da ka waitlam, kumta ki shim ïa ka masala.

method.en: Fry the shoot in oil on a high flame until the edges colour, then put the beans in.
method.l: Syied ïa ka usoi ha ka tulsi haduh ba ka bar ka saw, nangta buh ïa ki rymbai.

method.en: Add tomato, chilli and salt, cover four minutes, then dry it off and finish with the roasted sesame.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sohkhlia, sohmynken bad mluh, khang saw minit, pynsngai, bad buh ïa ka nei-iong basyied.

recipes.why: Bamboo shoot is the cheapest vegetable on these hills for four months and a Khasi kitchen has never put dairy near it. Beans come in by the sack from August, so this is a full protein dish at a price nothing else on the menu matches.
recipes.why_l: Ka usoi ka long ka jhur kaba dam khyndiat tam ha ki lum shibun bnai, bad ym shuh don dud ha ka. Ki rymbai ki wan da ki bori na August, kumta ka dam ka long kaba khyndiat tam.

recipes.name: Jhur Kper
recipes.sub: Whatever the garden gave, boiled and dressed with sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ki jhur na ka kper, bapyllait bad ka nei

method.en: Cut everything to one size and put the hard vegetables in the water first. A Khasi pot is boiled, not fried, and everything has to finish together.
method.l: Ot baroh kum shi ruh bad buh ïa ki jhur bakhia hangno. Ka khiew Khasi ka pyllait, kam syied.

method.en: Boil in salted water with the whole chillies until a piece breaks under the thumb.
method.l: Pynkhlaw ha ka um mluh bad ki sohmynken haduh ba ka jem.

method.en: Add the mustard greens for the last two minutes only, or they go grey.
method.l: Buh ïa ka jhur tyrso tang ar minit hakhatduh, ym ka long kaba dum.

method.en: Drain, dress with raw oil and coarsely crushed sesame while it is hot, and serve at once.
method.l: Pynduh um, buh ïa ka tulsi bad ka nei badup ha ba ka shai, bad ai ban bam mynta.

recipes.why: This is what a Khasi household eats on an ordinary evening: boiled, salted, and dressed with sesame. It costs less than any other dish in this book, it uses whatever came out of the kper that day, and nothing about it needs milk.
recipes.why_l: Kane ka dei kaba bam ha iing Khasi mynmiet: bapyllait, bamluh, bad bad ka nei. Ka dam ka long kaba khyndiat tam, bad ym don dud ha ka.

recipes.name: Tungrymbai bad Phan
recipes.sub: Fermented soybean crushed with potato and sesame, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Ka tungrymbai banam bad ki phan bad ka nei, ym don ka dud

method.en: Crush half the tungrymbai and leave half whole. The crushed half carries through twenty kilos and the whole half is what a Khasi looks for on the plate.
method.l: Nam ia shynna ka tungrymbai bad pynsah shynna baroh. Ka shynna banam ka poi lyngba ki 20 kilo, bad ka shynna baroh ka dei kaba u Khasi u wad halor ka plet.

method.en: Boil the phan in the skin and break it by hand. A knife-cut potato holds its edges and the tungrymbai never takes hold of it.
method.l: Pyndih ia ki phan bad ka snier bad pynkhih ia ki da ka kti. Ka phan ba la ot da u wait ka bat ia ki snier jong ka, bad ka tungrymbai kan ym pdiang ia ka.

method.en: Cook it uncovered from the moment the tungrymbai goes in. Under a lid three kilos of it will empty a hall.
method.l: Shet ia ka ba la khang ym na ka por ba ka tungrymbai ka dep. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ki lai kilo jong ka kin pynlotho ia ka iing.

method.en: Taste before the salt goes in. A tungrymbai is salted in the jar and a hundred and eighty grams is already more than some jars want.
method.l: Sngew shaphang ba ka mluh ka dep. Ka tungrymbai ka don ka mluh ha ka jar, bad ki shiteph phra phew gram ki la long shuh ban kiba don ki jar ki kwah.

recipes.why: Twenty rupees a head, no dairy at all. Three kilos of tungrymbai gives a hundred people what a kilo of paneer would at four times the price.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka dud ei ei. Ki lai kilo tungrymbai ki ai ia u shispah briew kaba ka shi kilo paneer kan ai ha saw sien ka dam.

recipes.name: Jhur Tyrso bad Nei
recipes.name_l: Ki Jhur Tyrso bad ka Nei
recipes.sub: Mustard leaves wilted and turned through with roasted sesame
recipes.sub_l: Ki jhur tyrso ba la pynduna bad la kylla bad ka nei baem

method.en: No water at all. Twelve kilos of tyrso gives up two litres in the first four minutes and that is all the vessel needs.
method.l: Ym don ka um ei ei. Ki 12 kilo tyrso ki ai ar litar ha ki saw minit banyngkong, bad kata ka dei baroh kaba ka blang ka donkam.

method.en: Cut the stalk in and do not throw it. The stalk is a third of the weight and it goes in eight minutes before the leaf.
method.l: Ot ia ka mrad lang bad ym dei ban shah bred noh. Ka mrad ka dei ka lai bynta jong ka jingjrong, bad ka dep phra minit shaphang ba ka sla.

method.en: Eight minutes on the leaf and no more. Tyrso cooked twenty minutes is the colour of a wet road and sixteen kilos of it comes back.
method.l: Phra minit halor ka sla tang, ym shuh. Ka tyrso ba la shet ar phew minit ka long kum ka rong ka lynti baum, bad ki 16 kilo ki phai.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It is the fat of this dish and there is no ghee anywhere in it.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Kata ka dei ka jingtyrso jong kane ka jingbam, bad ym don ka ghee hangno hangno ha ka.

recipes.why: Twelve rupees a head, no dairy and no ghee. In Lber the tyrso is fifteen rupees a kilo at Iewduh and the nei is the only thing bought for it.
recipes.why_l: Khadar tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka dud bad ka ghee. Ha u Lber ka tyrso ka long 15 tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh, bad ka nei tang ka dei kaba thied na ka.

recipes.name: Rymbai bad Sying
recipes.sub: Beans cooked with a great deal of ginger and no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai ba la shet bad ka sying kaba bun bad ym don ka dud

method.en: Seven hundred grams of ginger in twenty-four litres and it is not a mistake. In a vessel with no dairy and no onion the sying is all the base there is.
method.l: Hynniew shiteph gram sying ha ki 24 litar, bad kam dei ka jingpyrshah. Ha ka blang kaba ym don ka dud bad ka piaz, ka sying ka dei ka basan baroh kaba don.

method.en: Half the ginger goes in at the start and half at the end. The first half is the base and the second is the smell that reaches the hall.
method.l: Shynna ka sying ka dep ha kaba sdang bad shynna ha kaba dep. Ka shynna banyngkong ka dei ka basan, bad ka banar ka dei ka jingsngi kaba poi sha ka iing.

method.en: Soak the rymbai twelve hours and cook them in the soaking water. That dark water is half the colour of the finished vessel.
method.l: Buh ia ki rymbai ha ka um khadar bad ar por bad shet ia ki ha kata ka um. Kata ka um baiong ka dei shynna ka rong jong ka blang ba la dep.

method.en: Salt only after the bean is soft. Salted early, a rymbai hardens and no amount of time brings it back.
method.l: Buh ka mluh tang ynda ka rymbai ka long baduna. Haba la buh bathuh, ka rymbai ka long bajrong, bad ka por katno katno kan ym pynwan phai ia ka.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head, no dairy and no ghee. Four kilos of rymbai gives a hundred people the protein of a meal and the ginger is the only other thing bought.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynniew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka dud bad ka ghee. Ki saw kilo rymbai ki ai ia u shispah briew ka bha jong ka jingbam, bad ka sying tang ka dei kaba thied shuh.

recipes.name: Sohphlang bad Sohmynken
recipes.sub: Sohphlang tossed raw with roasted chilli and mustard oil
recipes.sub_l: Ka sohphlang baiar ba la kylla bad ka sohmynken baem bad ka tyrso um

method.en: No fire under this at all. Sohphlang cooked in any way loses everything it is dug for and twelve kilos is wasted.
method.l: Ym don ka ding harud kane ei ei. Ka sohphlang ba la shet ha ka rukom hangno hangno ka duh baroh kaba ka shah kynshew na ka bynta ka, bad ki 12 kilo ki duh.

method.en: Roast the chilli on a flame and crush it in the hand. This dish has four things in it and the chilli is three of them.
method.l: Em ia ka sohmynken halor ka ding bad nam ia ka ha ka kti. Kane ka jingbam ka don saw kajuh ha ka, bad ka sohmynken ka dei lai na ki.

method.en: Raw mustard oil and never heated. Heated oil on raw sohphlang cooks the surface and the whole tray goes soft in twenty minutes.
method.l: Ka tyrso um baiar, ym shym bakhraw. Ka tyrso um bakhraw halor ka sohphlang baiar ka shet ia shabar, bad ka tre baroh ka long baduna ha ar phew minit.

method.en: Salt and lemon at the counter. Twelve kilos of salted sohphlang gives up two litres in half an hour and the tray is a white water.
method.l: Ka mluh bad ka soh niamtra ha ka jaka ba ai. Ki 12 kilo sohphlang bad ka mluh ki ai ar litar ha shynna por, bad ka tre ka long ka um basaw.

recipes.why: Twenty-two rupees a head, no fire, no dairy and no kadai. Sohphlang is dug on the Khasi slopes in Nohprah and this is the dish a Khasi guest names before any other.
recipes.why_l: Ar phew ar tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka ding, ka dud bad ka kadai. Ka sohphlang ka shah kynshew ha ki lum Khasi ha u Nohprah, bad kane ka dei ka jingbam kaba u nongwan Khasi u kyrteng shaphang ka baroh bapher.

recipes.name: Pathaw bad Usoi
recipes.sub: Pumpkin and bamboo shoot cooked thin with sesame, no dairy
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw bad ka usoi ba la shet bariw bad ka nei, ym don ka dud

method.en: Boil the usoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off, and ten kilos of pathaw cannot hide it.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka usoi shi sien ha ka um basngai bad thoh noh ia kata ka um. Ka um banyngkong ka rah ia ka jingsngewthiang kaba lada ym kan rah noh ia ka thyllieh, bad ki 10 kilo pathaw ki ym lah lonsiew ia ka.

method.en: The usoi goes in first and the pathaw ten minutes after. A pathaw in usoi water from the start dissolves and the vessel is an orange soup.
method.l: Ka usoi ka dep shaphang bad ka pathaw khadar minit ynda. Ka pathaw ha ka um usoi na kaba sdang ka duh, bad ka blang ka long ka soup basaw.

method.en: Keep it thin. This is a vessel that is drunk off the plate at the end of the meal and a thick one is a mash.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw. Kane ka dei ka blang kaba shah dih na ka plet ha kaba dep ka jingbam, bad kaba bajrong ka long ka jingnam.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It is the fat of this vessel and it costs a fifth of what a cream would.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Kata ka dei ka jingtyrso jong kane ka blang, bad ka dam tang ka san bynta jong kaba ka cream kan dam.

recipes.why: Sixteen rupees a head, no dairy at all. In Lber the usoi comes off the Ri Bhoi slope for the cutting and the pathaw costs the carrying.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, ym don ka dud ei ei. Ha u Lber ka usoi ka mih na ka lum Ri Bhoi na ka dam jong ka jingot, bad ka pathaw ka dam tang ka jingbah.

recipes.name: Jain Rymbai bad Pathaw
recipes.name_l: Ki Rymbai bad ka Pathaw Jain
recipes.sub: Beans and pumpkin, nothing that grew underground
recipes.sub_l: Ki rymbai bad ka pathaw, ym don ei ei na khyndew

method.en: Put the asafoetida and dry ginger into the hot oil first. A Khasi pot usually starts with onion; here these two start it.
method.l: Buh ïa ka hing bad ka sying basngai ha ka tulsi bashai hangno. Ka khiew Khasi ka sdang bad u shyrmit; hangne kine ar ki sdang.

method.en: Add the beans and fry them five minutes before the pumpkin goes in — the bean takes twice as long.
method.l: Buh ïa ki rymbai bad syied san minit hapoh ba ka pathaw ka wan — ka rymbai ka kwah ar sien ka por.

method.en: Add tomato, chilli and salt, cover, and cook without water until the pumpkin falls and binds the dish.
method.l: Buh ïa ka sohkhlia, sohmynken bad mluh, khang, bad pyllait khlem um haduh ba ka pathaw ka jem.

method.en: Finish with the crushed sesame off the fire.
method.l: Buh ïa ka nei badup ha ba ka sngiah na ka ding.

recipes.why: A Jain guest in Shillong can eat almost nothing off an ordinary Khasi menu — potato, sohphlang and bamboo shoot are in every second dish. Beans climb the maize in every field here and pumpkin keeps two months, so this one is cookable any week of the year.
recipes.why_l: Ha Shillong u nongwan Jain um lah ban bam katto katne na ka menu Khasi — ka phan, ka sohphlang bad ka usoi ki don ha baroh. Ki rymbai bad ka pathaw ki don shi snem baroh.

recipes.name: Jain Bandakobi bad Rymbai
recipes.name_l: Ka Bandakobi bad ki Rymbai Jain
recipes.sub: Cabbage and beans, dry, with no carrot and no root
recipes.sub_l: Ka bandakobi bad ki rymbai, ym don gajor

method.en: Shred the cabbage and leave it out to lose some water while the beans are strung.
method.l: Ot ïa ka bandakobi bad ai ban sah ha ba dang kyllon ki rymbai.

method.en: Fry cumin, asafoetida and dry ginger in oil and put the beans in first.
method.l: Syied ïa ka jeera, hing bad sying basngai ha ka tulsi, buh ïa ki rymbai hangno.

method.en: Add the cabbage and salt on a high flame and keep the vessel uncovered. Covered, cabbage goes to water.
method.l: Buh ïa ka bandakobi bad mluh ha ka ding babha, khlem khang. Lada khang, ka bandakobi ka long um.

method.en: Fry until the edges brown, then take it off and add the crushed black sesame.
method.l: Syied haduh ba ka bar ka saw, pynsngiah, bad buh ïa ka nei-iong badup.

recipes.why: The cabbage dish this book already has is made with carrot, which is a root and puts it out of a Jain plate for the sake of colour. Beans do the same job and are on every hill field from August.
recipes.why_l: Ka jingbam bandakobi ha kane ka kot ka don gajor, kaba dei ka tyllit na khyndew. Ki rymbai ki trei kata kata ka kam bad ki don ha baroh ki lyngkha na August.

recipes.name: Jain Dal Nei-iong
recipes.sub: Split moong finished with black sesame, no onion or ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ka dal moong bad ka nei-iong, ym don shyrmit ne sying

method.en: Roast the dal dry before washing it. Roasted, it holds its shape in the pot instead of going to a paste.
method.l: Syied ïa ka dal basngai hapoh ba ban sait. Kumta ka sah, kam long ka masala.

method.en: Boil it soft and keep the water.
method.l: Pynkhlaw haduh ba ka jem bad shim ïa ka um.

method.en: Fry cumin, asafoetida, dry ginger and chilli in oil, add tomato and cook it down.
method.l: Syied ïa ka jeera, hing, sying basngai bad sohmynken ha ka tulsi, buh ïa ka sohkhlia bad pyllait.

method.en: Stir the ground sesame in at the end. It thickens the dal and does the work the fried onion does in an ordinary Khasi pot.
method.l: Buh ïa ka nei-iong badup hakhatduh. Ka pynshlur ïa ka dal bad ka trei ïa ka kam jong u shyrmit.

recipes.why: A Khasi dal starts with onion and often finishes with a bamboo shoot, and neither is open to a Jain guest. Ground black sesame gives the pot the same weight and is what this state has in every kitchen anyway.
recipes.why_l: Ka dal Khasi ka sdang bad u shyrmit bad ka khatduh bad ka usoi, bad kine ar kim dei ïa u Jain. Ka nei-iong badup ka ai kata kata ka jingshlur, bad ka don ha baroh ki iing.

recipes.name: Jain Pathaw ka Jhur
recipes.sub: Pumpkin cooked thin with asafoetida and dry ginger, no root
recipes.sub_l: Ka pathaw ba la shet bariw bad ka hing bad ka sying basngai, ym don ka rud

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, and ninety grams is the measure. Dry ginger is four times the strength of the fresh root and a heavy hand makes a Jain plate taste of medicine.
method.l: Ka sying basngai, ym kaba bathymmai; bad ki khyndai phew gram ki dei ka jingbishar. Ka sying basngai ka long saw sien ka bor jong kaba bathymmai, bad ka kti bajrong ka pynlong ia ka plet Jain ban sngew kum ka dawai.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering and a pinch is enough. In a Jain vessel it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: Ka hing ha ka jingem, bad ka khyndiat ka biang. Ha ka blang Jain kata tang ka dei kaba ïeng ha ka jaka ba ka piaz kan ïeng.

method.en: Keep the skin on if it is a hill pathaw. The skin is what stops fourteen kilos collapsing into a single orange mass.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka snier lada ka long ka pathaw lum. Ka snier ka dei kaba pynthang ia ki 14 kilo na kaba long tang shi jingnam basaw.

method.en: Roast the nei and crush it in at the end. It thickens twenty-six litres and there is no root and no flour anywhere in the vessel.
method.l: Em ia ka nei bad nam ia ka ha kaba dep. Ka pynlong ia ki 26 litar bajrong, bad ym don ka rud bad ka badup hangno hangno ha ka blang.

recipes.why: Eleven rupees a head, the cheapest Jain dish in this book. In Risaw the pathaw costs the carrying and there is no root anywhere in it, so a Jain guest is not given a separate plate.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynriew tyngka ha u briew, ka jingbam Jain kaba khyndiat dam tam ha kane ka kot. Ha u Risaw ka pathaw ka dam tang ka jingbah, bad ym don ka rud hangno hangno ha ka; kum kata u nongwan Jain u ym pdiang ka plet bapher.

recipes.name: Jain Usoi Basngai
recipes.sub: Bamboo shoot fried dry with dry ginger and asafoetida
recipes.sub_l: Ka usoi ba la syied basngai bad ka sying basngai bad ka hing

method.en: Boil the usoi once in plain water and throw that water. The first water carries the sourness that would otherwise take the tongue off.
method.l: Pyndih ia ka usoi shi sien ha ka um basngai bad thoh noh ia kata ka um. Ka um banyngkong ka rah ia ka jingsngewthiang kaba lada ym kan rah noh ia ka thyllieh.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in eighteen kilos. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: Ka sying basngai, ym kaba bathymmai; shiteph gram ha ki 18 kilo. Ka long saw sien ka bor jong ka sying bathymmai.

method.en: Cut it in strips along the grain and never across. Cut across, the shoot falls into short pieces and there is nothing to pick up.
method.l: Ot ia ka bariw ïa ka snier, ym shym pyrshah. Haba la ot pyrshah, ka usoi ka pat sha ki jingot barit, bad ym don kaei ban pdiang.

method.en: No water and no lid after the boiling. Under a lid ten kilos steams and a steamed usoi is a wet thing nobody will eat.
method.l: Ym don ka um bad ka jingkhap ynda ka jingpyndih. Ha khnong ka jingkhap ki 10 kilo ki stem, bad ka usoi bastem ka long ka jingbam baum kaba ym don uno uno ban bam.

recipes.why: Fifteen rupees a head. The usoi comes off the Ri Bhoi slope for the cutting in Lber, and there is no root anywhere in it, so a Jain guest eats the same dry sabji as the hall.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynsan tyngka ha u briew. Ka usoi ka mih na ka lum Ri Bhoi na ka dam jong ka jingot ha u Lber, bad ym don ka rud hangno hangno ha ka; kum kata u nongwan Jain u bam ia ka jhur basngai kajuh bad ka iing.

recipes.name: Jain Phulkobi Basngai
recipes.sub: Cauliflower fried dry with asafoetida and no root at all
recipes.sub_l: Ka phulkobi ba la syied basngai bad ka hing bad ym don ka rud ei ei

method.en: Soak the florets ten minutes in salted water and lift them out. There is more in a Nohprah cauliflower than cauliflower, and a Jain kitchen looks at that harder than anyone.
method.l: Buh ki jingot ha ka um bad ka mluh khadar minit bad rah noh ia ki. Don kaei kaei shuh ha ka phulkobi u Nohprah ban ka phulkobi, bad ka rukom shet Jain ka khmih ia kata bakhraw ban uno uno.

method.en: Peel the stalk and cut it in with the florets. The stalk is a third of the weight and it is not a root.
method.l: Pynhiar ia ka mrad bad ot ia ka lang bad ki jingot. Ka mrad ka dei ka lai bynta jong ka jingjrong, bad kam dei ka rud.

method.en: Asafoetida in the tempering, sixty grams in twenty kilos. In a Jain kitchen it is the only thing standing where an onion would.
method.l: Ka hing ha ka jingem, hynriew phew gram ha ki 20 kilo. Ha ka rukom shet Jain kata tang ka dei kaba ïeng ha ka jaka ba ka piaz kan ïeng.

method.en: Take it off while a floret still snaps. A cauliflower cooked through is one nobody looks at twice on the plate.
method.l: Rah noh ia ka katba ka jingot ka dang pat. Ka phulkobi ba la shet biang ka dei kaba ym don uno uno ba khmih ar sien halor ka plet.

recipes.why: Seventeen rupees a head. In Nohprah the phulkobi is thirty rupees a kilo at Iewduh, the stalk goes in, and a Jain guest gets the same dry sabji as the hall.
recipes.why_l: Khadhynniew tyngka ha u briew. Ha u Nohprah ka phulkobi ka long lai phew tyngka ka kilo ha Iewduh, ka mrad ka dep lang, bad u nongwan Jain u pdiang ka jhur basngai kajuh bad ka iing.

recipes.name: Jain Paneer ka Jhur
recipes.sub: Paneer in a tomato and cashew gravy with dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ka paneer ha ka jhur jaiur bad kaju bad ka sying basngai

method.en: Soak the cashew an hour and grind it with the tomato. In a Jain gravy the cashew does the work of both an onion and a garlic and there is no cheaper honest way.
method.l: Buh ki kaju ha ka um shi por bad kroh ia ki lang bad ki jaiur. Ha ka jhur Jain ki kaju ki leh ia ka kam jong ka piaz bad ka lasun baroh, bad ym don ka lynti bashisha kaba khyndiat dam shuh.

method.en: Cook the tomato paste twenty-five minutes before the ghee goes in. Under-cooked tomato is sour and no sugar can be added to a Jain vessel to hide it.
method.l: Shet ia ka jingnam jaiur ar phew san minit shaphang ba ka ghee ka dep. Ka jaiur ba ym la shet biang ka sngewthiang, bad ym lah ban buh ka chini ha ka blang Jain ban khap ia ka.

method.en: Dry ginger and not fresh, a hundred grams in twenty-six litres. It is four times the strength of the fresh root.
method.l: Ka sying basngai, ym kaba bathymmai; shiteph gram ha ki 26 litar. Ka long saw sien ka bor jong ka sying bathymmai.

method.en: The paneer goes in four minutes before serving and no earlier. Five kilos boiled in gravy is five kilos of rubber at the counter.
method.l: Ka paneer ka dep saw minit shaphang ba ai, ym bathuh. Ki san kilo ba la pyndih ha ka jhur baum ki long san kilo rabar ha ka jaka ba ai.

recipes.why: Fifty-five rupees a head. It is the dish that lets a Jain guest sit at a wedding plate and be given the same festival gravy as everybody else, with no root and no fresh ginger in it.
recipes.why_l: San phew san tyngka ha u briew. Ka dei ka jingbam kaba shah ia u nongwan Jain ban shong ha ka plet jingiakhun bad ban pdiang ka jhur kumhei kajuh bad ki briew baroh, ym bad ka rud bad ka sying bathymmai ha ka.

recipes.name: Jain Dal Shynrai
recipes.sub: Moong dal cooked thin with Lakadong turmeric and dry ginger
recipes.sub_l: Ka dal moong ba la shet bariw bad ka shynrai Lakadong bad ka sying basngai

method.en: A hundred and twenty grams of Lakadong in twenty-four litres and no more. It carries seven per cent curcumin against two in an ordinary turmeric and a heavy hand makes the vessel undrinkable.
method.l: Shiteph ar phew gram Lakadong ha ki 24 litar, ym shuh. Ka rah hynniew shispah bad ka curcumin, ha ka hyndrei ar shispah ha ka shynrai basngai, bad ka kti bajrong ka pynlong ia ka blang kaba ym lah dih.

method.en: Roast the moong dry five minutes before it is washed. It is what keeps three kilos from going to a single paste and it costs nothing.
method.l: Em ia ka moong basngai san minit shaphang ba sait ia ka. Kata ka dei kaba pynsah ia ki lai kilo na kaba long tang shi jingnam, bad kam dam ei ei.

method.en: Dry ginger and asafoetida in the tempering and nothing else. A Jain dal has four things in it and every one of them is tasted.
method.l: Ka sying basngai bad ka hing ha ka jingem, bad ym don kaei kaei shuh. Ka dal Jain ka don saw kajuh ha ka, bad ka baroh ka shah sngew.

method.en: Keep it thin enough to drink. A thick Jain dal on a Khasi plate is eaten with the fingers and nobody finishes it.
method.l: Pynsah ia ka bariw biang ban dih. Ka dal Jain bajrong halor ka plet Khasi ka shah bam da ki kti, bad ym don uno uno ba pynlait ia ka.

recipes.why: Eighteen rupees a head and it is on the counter in forty minutes. There is no root and no fresh ginger in it, so a Jain guest and the hall are served from the same vessel.
recipes.why_l: Khadphra tyngka ha u briew, bad ka don ha ka jaka ba ai ha saw phew minit. Ym don ka rud bad ka sying bathymmai ha ka; kum kata u nongwan Jain bad ka iing ki pdiang na ka blang kajuh.
